Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
MSNBC: Jamie Raskin thinks the Electoral College threatens democracy. He's right. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=091725_2&amount=25]
There's no greater defender of our democracy than Congressman Jamie Raskin -- and he knows the score, friend. Here's what he had to say:
“ I think that the Electoral College now, which has given us five popular vote losers as president in our history, twice in this century alone, has become a danger not just to democracy, but to the American people . It was a danger on January 6th, 2021. There are so many curving byways and nooks and crannies in the Electoral College that there are opportunities for a lot of strategic mischief. ”
The Electoral College isn’t just a vestige of the past; it is a ticking time bomb for exploitation in our democratic system. Congressman Raskin knows this, which is why he wanted the Jan. 6th Committee to propose getting rid of it. They didn't all agree, so it didn't make their list of final recommendations to Congress.
We know the vote suppressors will do anything in order to win. We have to remove this danger once and for all -- chip in $5, $15, $25 or more to help us end the Electoral College >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=091725_2&amount=25]

We don’t necessarily have to wait for Congress to act, either. Movements like the one in favor of the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) -- an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia -- might end the Electoral College without a constitutional amendment.
16 states plus DC have already joined the NPVIC, accounting for 206 electoral votes and 76% of the states needed to essentially make the popular vote the law of the land. Maine is also moving a bill through their state legislature to join.
Whether it's the NPVIC or something else, it's clear that the Electoral College needs to go.

Peter,

The nation mourns the tragic assassination of Charlie Kirk, gunned down on September 10, 2025, at Utah Valley University for daring to speak truth to power. His fearless voice—championing freedom, faith, and the American Dream—was silenced in a brazen act of political violence that has shaken us all to our core. Charlie fought hate with educated debate, not guns, using sharp wit and unyielding principle to challenge radical agendas. **Yet, he was punished with a bullet for his courage to speak.**

My name is Adam Schwarze. **I’m a former Navy SEAL running for the United States Senate in Minnesota, and Charlie Kirk is an inspiration to me.** Over the course of my career, I’ve met some very special men and women willing to put their lives on the line for God and country in some of the most inhospitable places imaginable.

**_I never had the pleasure of meeting Charlier Kirk, but as a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran, I can say with authority that he has to be one of the bravest individuals ever to champion the values of the United States of America._**

Charlie’s candor, professionalism, and respect for everyone he encountered will stick with me as I work to earn the support of every Minnesotan voter during this campaign. **Charlie’s life should serve as an example to my opponents on the other side of the aisle on how to treat political opponents and people who share different viewpoints, with respect.**

I joined the Marine Corps after 9/11, served in over 70 countries, and fought chaos and extremism. I know what it takes to serve something bigger than yourself—just like Charlie did with every debate, every speech, every stand he took. This Senate race is my most challenging mission yet. Minnesota hasn’t gone red since 1976. I’m the underdog. _**[But with your support, we can honor Charlie’s legacy by stopping the radicals who enabled this tragedy](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=13db77b8abdb4ec7a02d6e382d00993e&_e=MFILowaMCFBqQKJiiA55FQeVNi9SBx3oS2eijAxjyNDwSw2ODvgc7m9KjytqtGbAcQOMdvYYtwuStNIZ8yCWexfjIJLFAzokyqf2QkgHhbBa7egutIdowl4zPZdWWnqsrjKlLCIfYUsCQJyDLePfpLbJnRIdp3RgFRroQQyPxNIs5E8bi4OHmQnnFxt4JAtZQ26K-RcaSD8NnSyMcNj-Ug96Ss-q3pzR-X1xS8J2R_KMOcPC_TRosE0NLW7jgYMw4qLcX6J7jeoa_tx1aWCfSXjsKjess1L3fGDZickEk4JjBbnOCL9qTANP-N3oq7EHYeGACY7SJ4cHj6l4DLyudOJNMHgjlpthPzizi9y2pBXyKVYdb8zgHUah4shRs12nW1bGnoVoDPiZjlfRKRa4kqsOQ5yrNyvzDX3mG-9cZ251-la3eLelgV0sq4TohEDMzu2vlvRd3Lgw5f4YIiOCYDG9K407Iv_j8PLZ59c_-dQP2zAmLDia9EAkCaOxdqZ6UU2CXX2pAsG6XE5oNigjnARZh4ALL8kFjPQsE1cg20aPkxjllfx6e1yXQoplvj88HXzOQJaRPQcraxAHU8CREPbIoHdmN5DEsbBM7SQPiSdKdikAATo_xn-VIh0SBZCVgjFvubpQY_5aO08tAUcP2mrTOG3ejDy1_sZsMcBHsZfylGncMM1d6hq3oDwEyGVerDExgWVlPcgSV49r1YxXO83aTPXUWIJPgeYHKBMsbOfKmNT8HYeAl7ac1cIE68aXK26ZJnzvmAxl0jcbmezLTVBzYtXpFnnLXp3t6sJ63UM%3D)**_.

_[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=13db77b8abdb4ec7a02d6e382d00993e&_e=MFILowaMCFBqQKJiiA55FQeVNi9SBx3oS2eijAxjyNDwSw2ODvgc7m9KjytqtGbAcQOMdvYYtwuStNIZ8yCWexfjIJLFAzokyqf2QkgHhbBa7egutIdowl4zPZdWWnqsrjKlLCIfYUsCQJyDLePfpLbJnRIdp3RgFRroQQyPxNIs5E8bi4OHmQnnFxt4JAtZQ26K-RcaSD8NnSyMcNj-Ug96Ss-q3pzR-X1xS8J2R_KMOcPC_TRosE0NLW7jgYMw4qLcX6J7jeoa_tx1aWCfSXjsKjess1L3fGDZickEk4LCTFRl5MOKVoG3_H3ckmYVwGkkt2nCD-br01U5sNrTo23KLA1-hHjzsnBI6ztekh_ZvUL6h6_DjHOqSjxFVYlJwAjHfp_OfZ6GnubwCxlmrRacEVSEWbL3Uayame2etibUvBYFedxFrfUHhGCkbJOOc95H42GLxhaRbNwrcnOZixWTG93kx4Au3o_1zKdD7W6Q8ZWm8RuwEfM-XvXdvxayLL8EnI4LrSiBEMEYYj9W_y1VUlXjWoocIgSXxr6gwjgQpki5S_ZNzPoq2VDrLpgZkmvK_CI5DEQKM9mIJOQ_hDkqXZRP5ErPjuIEEkFtoCN__gtOuVfltDI-wGNzWwf8r07n0Y9MA7U9Ov7zgh8YU_dV3k-Z2tx7OzGGHYGaZHJovJBdClGIEtY-G0Kc7DQWVrLLJKPyUXu371Y1FK04GvJg8FdN0rr-Ri7x6s3BSUrDPLcuSQ80KDIpYtEGGWty3n1IC2wkuCmeVZhYQlON3YTrDJBV3I4HfuyT3lCfWZg%3D)_
[**FIGHT FOR CHARLIE
**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=13db77b8abdb4ec7a02d6e382d00993e&_e=MFILowaMCFBqQKJiiA55FQeVNi9SBx3oS2eijAxjyNDwSw2ODvgc7m9KjytqtGbAcQOMdvYYtwuStNIZ8yCWexfjIJLFAzokyqf2QkgHhbBa7egutIdowl4zPZdWWnqsrjKlLCIfYUsCQJyDLePfpLbJnRIdp3RgFRroQQyPxNIs5E8bi4OHmQnnFxt4JAtZQ26K-RcaSD8NnSyMcNj-Ug96Ss-q3pzR-X1xS8J2R_KMOcPC_TRosE0NLW7jgYMw4qLcX6J7jeoa_tx1aWCfSXjsKjess1L3fGDZickEk4J3fFzav91sYcSrKX-HXqz5H7Oae-vOgeUwPFtDuncsbCEVUQGtaLWY3A8W342KS-8ALq8ctry_2MrOCz-_eNLJKK8YO_ZFde7_UZC4qx3sJUVd389Eu3MPmRVe_iV-Rp3Yajl44FtLPcs4JffOC4cYh5OxhcyhNbKFGyEUfq0dCtwHysn8H8NSIGOVcgve7sDRB1TZLvzlXswsWZfjrKOGtx_8q_HJ87xblrnO0HBsdJml8BiKxjMALBO6ZKbQ-RWQWPeG55Jk5UY7D-CvRj1d4-Zgks6lVUKcvIKy0KsI_CmiWmYulhaqkfOXWe_t9CCy-VBTgEOwZDSDdGXlyx_ctpsIg0G_IJRi29TpNf701-bYE-tgfYfWyQpROUU2-W2VpG5E0OhFh7MJ4kxyWm6n8GzM5Xk7WjObInqJEGLDlQx6MCvb-MscU8GqsMCvZABYPrxG37VjVXnABbXxZsov_dzwqRicpZ553XwhCqPdsEUAZ7dRnEjyGUoX5p1SFr4%3D)
Unfortunately, I’m running against Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, who, like her boss, shares a long history of inflammatory rhetoric.

Days before Charlie’s untimely death, Tim Walz, speaking in front of constituents at a political rally, lamented that President Trump hadn’t yet died, making his scripted condolences for Charlie’s family ring all the more hollow as he _**failed to disavow the extremists celebrating this tragedy online.**_

_**I thank God that President Trump defeated Kamala Harris last November.**_****

**Can you imagine a vice president with so little moral clarity that he would tolerate the hatred that led to Charlie’s murder?** **
**
I can’t.

Tim Walz and my opponent in this Senate race personify everything Charlie Kirk stood against: **arrogance, deceit, and a progressive agenda that sees conservatives not as opponents, but as enemies to be crushed.** Their party’s years of demonizing voices like Charlie’s set the stage for this violence. Their silence on the specifics of this tragedy speaks louder than their words.

They both push to disarm law-abiding Minnesotans while radicals run rampant. They both pander with land acknowledgments, dividing us further. They both view Republicans as threats to be eliminated, just as Charlie was targeted for his beliefs. **The woman in the photo below is my opponent, by the way.**

name: Adam Schiff
subject: I just introduced a Constitutional Amendment to overturn Citizens United
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
|
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=8985%2E5257348%2EUw7pvK)
Derek, earlier today, I introduced a Constitutional Amendment to overturn the Supreme Court’s ruling in _Citizens United_ , to protect our elections from unrestrained spending by wealthy donors and corporations, and to allow for public financing of elections.
**[Add your name as a citizen co-sponsor today.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20250917-citizens-united.GBx6Hj&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_PET_AC90_20250917_PM2_V1_S1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&t=4&akid=8985%2E5257348%2EUw7pvK)**
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20250917-citizens-united.GBx6Hj&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_PET_AC90_20250917_PM2_V1_S1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&t=5&akid=8985%2E5257348%2EUw7pvK)
---
Of all the challenges to our country and our democracy, unfettered corporate spending is among the most pernicious. Derek, I'm working to fix this. [
](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/5307?refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_PET_AC90_20250917_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=8985%2E5257348%2EUw7pvK)
Let me explain:
The Supreme Court's decision in _Citizens United_ opened the door for corporations to pour billions of dark money dollars into elections.
Upending our democratic process by anonymous and unrestricted spending weakens our democracy.
_We’ve seen how damaging this has been for our elections._
**This amendment will keep big money out of politics and bring back power to the American people – protecting the right to vote freely.**
Our democracy is broken under this system. Drowning out or diminishing a voter’s voice with the power of large corporate spending is at odds with how our system is supposed to work.
**[Derek, add your name and become a citizen co-sponsor of my Constitutional Amendment to overturn _Citizens United_ and reject the corrupting influence of dark money in our elections. ](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20250917-citizens-united.GBx6Hj&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_PET_AC90_20250917_PM2_V1_S1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&t=7&akid=8985%2E5257348%2EUw7pvK)**
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20250917-citizens-united.GBx6Hj&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_PET_AC90_20250917_PM2_V1_S1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&t=8&akid=8985%2E5257348%2EUw7pvK)
---
Our democracy is fragile, and with leaders like Donald Trump trying to further bend and break the rules, it’s more important than ever that we preserve and defend our values.
Thank you for adding your support to our Constitutional Amendment, Derek.
— Adam

name: Marie Gluesenkamp Perez
subject: Washingtonians are facing higher costs
body:
| | Peter, I deeply understand the struggles working families in Southwest Washington face – because I’ve faced them myself.

Before I was elected to Congress, my husband Dean and I could only afford health insurance for our son, because the additional $1200 a month to cover ourselves was simply out of our budget.

Programs like the Affordable Care Act (ACA) have allowed millions of Americans to obtain health insurance and care they previously couldn’t afford.

But because partisan extremists allowed ACA premium tax credits to expire, **thousands of Washingtonians will soon be forced to pay an average of 21% more per month for the same health care coverage they’re already getting.**

That’s just not feasible for most families and small businesses, Peter – especially when the cost of living is already sky-high and Americans everywhere are struggling to make ends meet.

[I’m working to find bipartisan solutions to prevent the rug from being pulled out from underneath hardworking families. name: Deborah Zierten
subject: Tell Us Why You Love the Redwoods 🌲📖
body:
https://savetheredwoods.org [https://savetheredwoods.org]
Hi Peter,
Do you remember the first time you saw the redwoods? Maybe you were a child on a family trip long ago, or perhaps as an adult on a more recent adventure. Whatever your experience, we'd love for you to take a moment and reflect on why the redwoods matter to you.
https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/digital-renewals-em1-redwoods-story-survey [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/digital-renewals-em1-redwoods-story-survey]
Photo Credit: Vivian Chen
In my work as the League’s education manager, I get to watch as children are struck with awe by the redwoods—often for the first time. These moments not only enrich the lives of young people but also help us develop tomorrow’s stewards of these wonderful giants.
We want to hear from you! [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/digital-renewals-em1-redwoods-story-survey] As someone who supports our vision to safeguard the redwoods and its inhabitants, we invite you to share your thoughts and memories of the redwoods.What would you tell your younger self about the redwoods? What do you think kids will be curious about when they visit the redwoods?
Submit Your Response Here [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/digital-renewals-em1-redwoods-story-survey]
Your responses will help us shape future outreach, including educational programs and field trips. As we introduce more people to the wonder of redwoods, we inspire the next generation to care about and protect these ancient giants.
Did you know that some redwoods can live for over 2,000 years? Imagine all the stories they could tell!
But... since the trees can’t speak for themselves, we’d be so grateful if you’d take a few minutes to share your reflections on what the redwoods mean to you.
Thank you for your continued support and ensuring these magnificent trees will stand tall for generations.
Together, we’re making a lasting impact on the landscape and the legacy it holds.

Deborah Zierten

# Stephanie, Charlie, and the Culture of Bulls*t
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a2ebcbdb-1c47-4eef-9c79-60c4f57299c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### The Comedy of Errors Before the Comedy of Politics
If you know Cliff Schecter, then you know it wouldn't be a Cliff Schecter show without some live-streaming hell breaking loose. It almost feels like a brand.
Before Stephanie Miller even joined the show, Cliff was challenging his tech setup to a duel, promising to worship any deity that could get the camera working, and railing against "the communists" for sabotaging the stream.
You know, those guys taking over Intel. As one does...if their name is Yuri Andropov.
Seven minutes of not-Heaven later, Stephanie appeared, David Schuster popped in, and suddenly we had an Emmy winner, a liberal radio legend, and Cliff making self deprecating jokes.
He compared himself to everyone from a Kardashian--whom we hear is a family who do some shows on tv--to a Carpathian. Whom we hear...does not.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/69b03b07-ec2e-4018-b279-aa893155a7c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Vigo, everyone 's favorite painted Carpathian from Ghostbusters II, who comes from the same region as the late Ivanka Trump. We think there may be a familial connection there._
### Titanic Jokes, MAGA Lawlessness, and the Infamous Bag of D*ks
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd52c5de-4dd1-4068-8710-a6a67d07bb12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
What, did you expect a show with Cliff, Stephanie and David to be profanity-free!?
Moving on, the banter flew fast: Stephanie compared herself to the Titanic's old lady which she correctly pointed out had some serious small "MAGA energy." What with Rose not letting Jack on the the big piece of wood. Cliff surmised it was "probably because Jack was vaccinated."
Then Stephanie told a story about MAGA-hatters parking in disabled spots and red zones during her bike ride to a rest stop near Pepperdine College, ignoring cops. Classic Trumpism: laws are for the rest of us.
Stephanie called MAGA a bag of d*ks. Cliff pointed out it was "unwashed d*ks" and David made clear it was a "limp bag of d*ks." Which of the three was it?
The answer you're looking for here is "yes."
### Kash Patel's Ass-Kicking and the Epstein File Circus
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.pq6gsegGWTJrX9cnP08prj7_PaTR8k-L9MTIv2LPmYw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=173862729)
The crew dug into Kash Patel's disastrous performance on Capitol Hill with Democrats including Dan Goldman and Jamie Raskin humiliating him.
They exposed his ~~vast wealth of knowledge~~ incredible reservoir of dumb-f*kery ("he didn't know who Dylann Roof was," or rules about witness testimony being shared outside court, and he was a GOP appointed prosecutor!). And his hypocrisy over Epstein files.
Patel tried a Biden-is-old joke about "autopen" while defending child rape coverups. All three agreed that his eyes may have even disagreed with each other as to how wise it was to try that one.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3ca5f6d2-c4ad-4c5a-b5d1-637124f25f87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Cliff framed it perfectly: Kash is a "Petri dish for stupid," a cosplay FBI director in a leather jacket who looks like "Buffalo Bill porn."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8bc7657f-7154-4aad-abcc-2a90fa702eba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Did ICE make him wear this in lieu of life in a San Salvador prison?
And returning to our hearing, Raskin caught Patel in his own trap: _If you say the FBI has Epstein files, and you 're the FBI Director, why don't you release them?_ [Patel had no answer.](https://substack.com/redirect/70cafdff-a46c-4935-9939-070d88ca3813?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Or, alternatively, he was the first person in recorded history to suddenly go mute due to no known medical condition.
### Violence, Guns, and the Right's Projection Game
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3fbcc3ab-2379-4ede-b69d-99cec884a269?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The conversation then turned more serious.
Stephanie and David pointed out [how Pam Bondi and Trumpworld](https://substack.com/redirect/bf90c438-277f-4ad5-a4a2-ce7407281191?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are trying to weaponize "hate speech" against the left, while ignoring Laura Loomer and Nick Fuentes--_both of whom spewed vitriol about Charlie Kirk_ _just days before he stopped being alive_.
Therefore, per Bondi's proclamation, they are responsible and should be arrested.
They went on to discuss The Right's endless violent rhetoric, in general.
This has led to recent tragic attacks on Minnesota Democratic lawmakers and the CDC. Not to mention Jan 6th, bombs in abortion clinics, an Oklahoma City building, an Olympic festival in Atlanta, a Paul Pelosi hammer attack and the list goes on.
We're not even counting [their ghoulish behavior abroad (see Venezuela](https://substack.com/redirect/e5e72881-37b5-41a0-bacd-819ac3d9f208?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
Stephanie reminded everyone that the DOJ just deleted its own report showing _the vast majority of extremist violence comes from the far right_.
Cliff had the report's stats ready--as he'd intended to include them in a rant he'd planned for the beginning of the show if he hadn't screwed up all manner of technology in his office.
Your stats: since 1990, far-right extremists have committed **227 attacks killing 520+ people** --a rate **550% higher** than that of the left.
The trio ripped apart the narrative around Charlie Kirk's assassination. Stephanie: "nobody on the left celebrated it"--it shook everyone in public life. David: "the shooter came from a repressive MAGA household, obsessed with guns, raised in a culture of right-wing hate."
Cliff: our gun culture tells young white men guns are part of their identity. Then Republicans make guns easier to get than cold medicine (example: His grandfather gave him the gun as a gift; no background check, no psych evaluation, no required time on the range. This couldn't happen in any other advanced democracy).
The through line? Guns + violence-inciting disinformation + MAGA repression/mental health challenges = inevitable violence.
### The Media: From Watchdogs to Scarborough Daily
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.pq6gsegGWTJrX9cnP08prj7_PaTR8k-L9MTIv2LPmYw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=173862729)
[All three slammed corporate media.](https://substack.com/redirect/0897ebcc-20a3-4099-86ba-a3ccb50864e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Karen Attiah was fired from The Washington Post _for simply quoting Charlie Kirk_. Matthew Dowd was canned from MSNBC for answering a question their anchor asked him, and doing it gently.
Rumors are swirling that Barry Weiss may take over CBS editorial. Cliff called MSNBC "the Scarborough Daily" and corporate media a whitewashing machine. David, a former Emmy winning anchor at both MSNBC and CNN, added: people now trust YouTube more than mainstream outlets--and they're right to.
### Trump Plays Golf While Kirk's Dead
Cliff dropped the kicker: while the right demanded "reverence" for Charlie Kirk, Trump skipped the Kennedy Center vigil for him to play golf. When asked if he was still grieving about him a day or so later, he answered by bragging about his new gilded ballroom being built.
The man who tells us he's the only one who cares about America can't even fake mourning for his supposed protege for longer than 24 hours.
### Why This Matters
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82801537-8f50-4ea6-853c-5c936250bc30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The conversation wasn't just jokes (though there were plenty--bagels, Cox family names, Bengals vs. Rams and all three seemed to really enjoy the conversation).
But they then got to the **danger of asymmetry**.
Progressives don't call for violence; the right does it daily. Progressives get fired for quoting Kirk; right-wing extremists are amplified on Fox. Progressives pundits are at risk because they don't make the money right-wing grifters do, and can't afford the same level of security.
Stephanie summed it up: _There but for the grace of God goes any of us._
Cliff hammered the point: until we name the threat--[right-wing violence, enabled by guns and media cowardice](https://substack.com/redirect/a484ccf0-724c-4b06-9495-82035d8d90b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--we'll keep watching more Charlie Kirks die, Melissa Hortmans and policemen protecting the CDC die, and we'll keep burying teachers, [and, worst of all, our children](https://substack.com/redirect/8a1d3435-8ce8-42d2-a92e-5518d397f705?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
### Ellie Leonard Joins!
After Stephanie left the show, researcher and brilliant writer, Ellie Leonard joined, as she is an expert transcriber and has done this for much of the Epstein Files out there, including the infamous Donald Trump signed 50th b-day party for Epstein. Leonard was witty, informed and was a great addition to the show. You'll be seeing more of her.
Thank you for all the support you've given us as usual. None of this happens without you.
Cliff

* **TOP NEWS**

**“Abbott signs bill allowing Harris County law enforcement to contract with HOAs without commissioners’ OK,”** Texas Tribune's **Alex Nguyen** \-- "Gov. **Greg Abbott** on Wednesday signed two bills that focus solely on Harris County law enforcement agencies’ contracting and funding, which were added to the second special session’s agenda late last month. The laws will take effect on Dec. 4, 2025.

Currently, sheriffs and constables in Harris County can contract with homeowner associations, school districts and municipal utility districts to provide additional policing for them. Both the county and contracting groups have to sign off on the contract, and they split portions of the cost depending on the amount of time the deputies spend in the area.

The more prominent of the two proposals, [House Bill 26](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.y1qQg7vX491TJbzrGLYTuEYT0yv_aZw1IceJac_-o0Y-UGIWKkPTFm9Kz5DRdvb_-aYU7NLaOywMgY5yceksY11R687IxggK7vT4AJtOCSTPC5f2-q2rvck2wsAM71XdsIReebgORR8fCGnVV1kfHQSHCqAXxVmkQOHz_F1vPNWuOUWyf0FIRTcNmWvShJfe5Vs3DzCMqApW2L2Q8a5jpoMdMcHiDg7Bh5i6upUnF3CfRQ_xoDiNXDmakRAi-yW0Ft6hMn2auxxMErOESAK7EyQUJFVwBvreClTCd3__f2y7OsqDScLK8ywfz-TvboOMFoF8yVkFRZv2eZ4HVl-0LL5i0PIlsfMImkZF-u8ow3NmL7Lg8f3N1kW98GYSKYVzcXYtyrJH4ZEmy5B2cGvqxVTbVjiJrsHCNe4gTQX7Ctvghlx8pvXURNsfndTuE1r-DStpCaWGAuw6Jpb1LZ-bV9ctXAjuCidvPmf1CvX7RLgOjdScnWp8Rsm-2rM5RYeT/4k0/UdqkFnZBTyOei3UugfJwxg/h13/h001.kdZ0syrixj4YaWIuONILdDHqMbqwEitZFxUsmZLvrVE), would allow these law enforcement agencies to enter into such contracts without the need for approval from the county’s commissioners court. Meanwhile, [House Bill 192](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.y1qQg7vX491TJbzrGLYTuEYT0yv_aZw1IceJac_-o0Y-UGIWKkPTFm9Kz5DRdvb_-aYU7NLaOywMgY5yceksY7fLGv9rC1vdTp0rN2BVKrj7h_W75BX-pFhL4eD_WYV28xtqa4cXgJ9kSYt7sNMiSmMsqZsP-f8zGTilUpbfTkA7hc8-VSy6hhS0g3BsscrD3ztvalvNUP4oUrMI6pUJJ1Zpb85MItx7qTOocqm8Ipmo1QkhqesXg78AMTy_w3r2LqbkcqYMQb0MkLUnMyIm2SMR_atdEEVjIClKbhCFHKHw8xX72m1eISjMCNYkEADQt3cI-v49yTbbyWfYZVMber2vLvE_v-0W3u8BlWw5EUdZCQ7yFeC6Xws7jiorP1ysSIS4XUWmL4eXss-5SPwM55DQW-rGL2HBzcLvviNL2R6hswMhgzW85uhqpzCkMTUnrUa3Dy0YeHtAN9lC9YDgGtzquivke2-7xppEwykm2Gz5oPYrda5FzhGN6ZGJZpSv/4k0/UdqkFnZBTyOei3UugfJwxg/h14/h001.zysP2OwTXzMddoXs-XOKwPVDLUNL1HC28Q6GA7xTVCk) would require the county to seek voter approval if it adopts a budget that reallocates unspent funding that was appropriated for law enforcement agencies or moves funding previously appropriated for a specific law enforcement position to another agency.

State Rep.**Tom Oliverson** , the Cypress Republican who carried both bills, and his backers said they are about protecting law enforcement including this popular deputy contract program.

Their critics, however, said the legislation would upend the county government’s checks and balances, as well as harm taxpayers.

Greg Abbott on Wednesday signed two bills that focus solely on Harris County law enforcement agencies’ contracting and funding, which were added to the second special session’s agenda late last month. The laws will take effect on Dec. 4, 2025. Currently, sheriffs and constables in Harris County can contract with homeowner associations, school districts and municipal utility districts to provide additional policing for them. Both the county and contracting groups have to sign off on the contract, and they split portions of the cost depending on the amount of time the deputies spend in the area. » The more prominent of the two proposals, , would allow these law enforcement agencies to enter into such contracts without the need for approval from the county’s commissioners court. Meanwhile, would require the county to seek voter approval if it adopts a budget that reallocates unspent funding that was appropriated for law enforcement agencies or moves funding previously appropriated for a specific law enforcement position to another agency. State Rep.Tom Oliverson , the Cypress Republican who carried both bills, and his backers said they are about protecting law enforcement including this popular deputy contract program. Their critics, however, said the legislation would upend the county government’s checks and balances, as well as harm taxpayers. “You already pay your taxes for a constable to patrol your neighborhoods. But now they want to go and bid a contract with your HOAs, to pay them, to contract with them, to patrol your neighborhood more often,” state Rep.Charlene Ward Johnson , D-Houston, said during a Texas House hearing about HB 26 on Wednesday. “That’s double taxation.” » The House then cleared HB 26 with a 88-49 vote and HB 192 with a 89-48 vote on Aug. 27 Hours later that day, the Texas Senate voted 21-5 to approve both bills. The votes came two days after Abbott added the items to the second special session’s agenda, saying that the legislation would improve public safety. Oliverson quickly thanked the governor in for “protecting neighborhood law enforcement contracts for the vast majority of unincorporated Harris County and ISD’s that depend on them.” Oliverson said the legislation is needed because the deputy contract program is under attack, despite its popularity and importance to unincorporated areas. The county also raising the contract’s costs for some groups in order to help cover constable pay raises, the Houston Chronicle reported. “Unfortunately, there’s a lot of friction going on between the law enforcement departments and Commissioners Court with regards to the terms and conditions of those contracts,” Oliverson said during a House committee hearing for HB 26 on Aug. 22." | FREE SUBSCRIPTIONS HAVE ENDED : As of July 11, 2022, we have moved to a paywall for free subscribers. I've long had a bug in my bonnet about holidays and days of commemoration that mean nothing, or better yet, celebrate twisted perversions of the principles for which they were originally established. Hypocrisy seems bad enough without being invited to ignore, and then celebrate it.
For instance, given the tragic history of the 13th Amendment, [Juneteenth](https://substack.com/redirect/36cb12fe-3d77-431a-bcd9-688d00f09c91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) offers an example of the first category. Meanwhile, [Independence Day](https://substack.com/redirect/3047c429-7dad-4ecd-8ab8-c7a8213cb855?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or [Thanksgiving](https://substack.com/redirect/7f6e2f09-fdde-430e-ae32-33cf187cb54a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) exemplify the second.
Thankfully, some holidays might offer contrasting examples of celebrations that tend to downplay the broader significance of their respective animating principles. [Christmas](https://substack.com/redirect/ced7a5e2-2979-4eb9-9d79-3bd344114786?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Mother's Day](https://substack.com/redirect/fcb97549-d0dd-40ad-914d-74817cffb858?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), for instance, both celebrate timeless principles far beyond the rituals--such as giving gifts, and flowers--to which they are widely reduced.

As our country comes to grips with the emerging autocracy that increasingly defines the federal government, thinking about [Constitution Day](https://substack.com/redirect/561a39af-869c-4075-a19d-6b784ca35918?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) feels a bit like being invited to a funeral.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d95a603b-5ca6-4024-a577-934dc6f7e3c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

### **What does patriotism mean?**
People who defined themselves as patriots in the [not-very-distant past](https://substack.com/redirect/180747fe-56ab-49f2-b008-3ffbabeb0e78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) would likely feel disturbed by those who parrot their words and hijack their symbols today.
Today's performative patriots cheer on the executive branch while it [lays rights to waste](https://substack.com/redirect/88cd3e91-19e0-4cf9-a1ee-68cac0917fd6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [decimates](https://substack.com/redirect/1a3f02c1-f7d8-46cb-971a-82b1cafabcdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the constitutional separation of powers. They prefer solemnly crying during the national anthem rather than considering--even for a moment--how any of the [principles](https://substack.com/redirect/47c09984-34e2-4cdc-84db-c6f94be0af62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) enshrined in our founding documents relates to the United States today. They regress into traditional gender roles, flexing a [fragile masculinity](https://substack.com/redirect/c940f584-b95b-40d6-a69e-81c7d25817c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the face of a world more complex than they imagine.
[Real](https://substack.com/redirect/53c4cf0a-d9e5-42f8-9bb5-123f2aa4d1a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Americans, in contrast, recognize the beauty in our country bringing together voices, foods, music, and perspectives from around the world. We have long understood that patriotism--in a constitutional Republic--involves critical thinking, concern for others, interrogating official narratives, and [holding power (i.e., our government) accountable](https://substack.com/redirect/b434605a-0d00-4394-90fb-8851242d755e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It requires activating the checks and balances enshrined in the Constitution to guard liberty and enable the pursuit of happiness.

### **What 's going on in Washington?**
While federal troops were [working](https://substack.com/redirect/72db9e5c-3fff-425f-a7e6-a18034951815?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as trash collectors and transit fare enforcers in our nation's capital, the theoretically-divided-but-in-fact-united branches of our government continued their assault on our country.
[Today's courts](https://substack.com/redirect/eb1d3e72-becd-4aa3-a8bd-dc1ff31d632c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are like a beached whale. After hundreds of years of seemingly thoughtful jurisprudence and rigorous reasoning, they have been reduced by the Supreme Court to a paving stone on the path of an aspiring dictator. They are an [embarrassment](https://substack.com/redirect/364cce5e-c710-4b6d-9bad-1ac6dde1d4ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the very concept of law, led by a politicized body of unelected right wing judicial activists with no concern for the future or the hundreds of millions of Americans forced to endure their decisions.
Meanwhile, Congress has long [reduced itself](https://substack.com/redirect/a1dfe8f5-18b3-4a24-99b6-998dc68a987a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to irrelevance, [bending](https://substack.com/redirect/11e1973b-112e-4680-853e-d4af6dc5ebf3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over backwards--even under the leadership of Democrats--to [accommodate](https://substack.com/redirect/165f0a51-0bcd-41f5-a2c0-547432ffc48a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) fascism and [abandon](https://substack.com/redirect/eeea0ba7-ba71-4b62-be84-97049b0fb6a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Americans to the lethal whims of Wall Street.
One of the most dangerous myths of this political moment is that Republicans are the only fascists in Washington. In fact, Democrats have [long embodied](https://substack.com/redirect/1f4cb674-35b3-4388-b2e9-8a457981f933?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the very same intersecting evils [decried](https://substack.com/redirect/5fae81d9-e88e-4c2b-b451-b44a4b7a1c86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.: racism, militarism, and capitalism.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=173910416&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTczOTEwNDE2LCJpYXQiOjE3NTgxNjk1MTQsImV4cCI6MTc2MDc2MTUxNCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.czmT19KVqJyAqh-IYOq9z6wLD6ZuRmuWO7dmCNWfQVU)
Like the Constitution itself, the constitutional crisis through which we are all living transcends ideology, going to the very structure of our government. It is the product of decisions and patterns [shared](https://substack.com/redirect/7d28a665-7de4-42c6-8311-a9179cd35a8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the leaders of both corporate political parties.
### **< Shrug>**
Having come to understand U.S. history better than I wish, I can't offer much by way of hope this Constitution Day. History tends to [rhyme](https://substack.com/redirect/b5a582f5-8d3e-4722-87f4-777ea4ae2fc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and while there are many [acts](https://substack.com/redirect/b83db606-becd-4f95-a283-5a1547d67b2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of worthy resistance that deserve our attention and support, I fear the future more than I welcome it.
At least we'll have plenty of holidays to enjoy.

America is under attack as never before. Our culture, our Judeo-Christian values, our traditions, our freedoms -- and our very country -- are all under attack. subject: Let’s Shame the Devil
body:
My life has changed since watching Charlie Kirk’s death. America has changed. An awakening occurred in an instant. With that, a bright line developed between good and evil. Pastor Signorelli wrote after Charlie Kirk’s passing, “The Devil overplayed his hand.”

| [****](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5cen6uccvv28k25mrv550773lni22tquk8s8v48_rp22sh2s8i6epb0shge9or7cjh2bs) [****](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdq64t5alh46c2i15q4fsqj2550bjto70a360ug0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0shge9or7cjh2bs) Dear Patriot,

My life has changed since watching Charlie Kirk's death.

America has changed. An awakening occurred in an instant.

With that, a bright line developed between good and evil. Pastor Signorelli wrote after Charlie Kirk's passing, "**The Devil overplayed his hand**."

Evil is exposed, out in the open, mocking us, and there is no better opportunity than now to Shame the Devil.

**In honor of Charlie Kirk, that 's exactly what we're going to do**. [**I ask that you join me in an unprecedented operation**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjvcjki7gaj1gsveutep250i14ckv3982kdb6tjo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0shge9or7cjh2bs) to **expose the wicked, evil, depraved, and wrathful souls who are grooming our high school and college students with their agendas of hate**.

The students who debated Charlie with indignant intolerance were educated by teachers and professors who were too cowardly to stand in front of Charlie Kirk themselves.

It's time for America to see who these educators are.
**Through our non-profit, the Citizen Journalism Foundation, we 'll be giving hidden camera equipment to students across the nation and providing them with the training, legal and ethics training they will need to do their part to Shame the Devil.**
[**Please, donate to help cover the costs of this massive operation**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmfn0lglu57hkbv238p5edqr98sg01p45nunfkhg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0shge9or7cjh2bs).
Our staff is booking the largest facility we can find in Arizona to train and equip students for **the day after Charlie Kirk 's funeral**.

This is where we start, and [**I cannot do this without you**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq1un4h9shehqhm3jhgd4korufr4qsdnf9g220b0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0shge9or7cjh2bs).
Some may believe that the Devil does not exist, but I think the following quote from an old movie:
**" The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist."**
The teachers, professors, and administrators we hope to expose are advancing an agenda that corrupts the minds of our youth, playing right into the Devil's hand.

This is our opportunity, "Shame the Devil" by exposing the playbook and the players behind it.

Millions of America's students are standing by. They want our direction. They want our guidance to do something that matters. **They want to do good**.

This is where I need to ask a favor of you. This campaign is going to conservatively cost $250,000 to get off the ground. We must equip, train, and prepare thousands of students for this to have the type of impact worthy of Charlie's legacy. [**I can 't do that without your help**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zungfuguaa5g9ivrl40ld9ql91mo5lo58krbg85o_rp22sh2s8i6epb0shge9or7cjh2bs).

[**Let 's give them the direction, equipment, and training, and unleash these young lions of truth**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0e81b7iaj0etg6ec07ik87fm4jjk7q7helcpu98_rp22sh2s8i6epb0shge9or7cjh2bs).

I appreciate anything you can do. Thank you for everything.

In Truth, James O'Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

name: Donald Trump, Jr.
subject: For Charlie For America
body:
His fire lit a movement. It's up to us to keep it burning.

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zaf4chlkuctfogrg1p6hokthhcs4oldnecu4nsno_rp22sh2s8i6epb0shiecoj6clh2bs)
---
Dear Friend, I don't even know how to begin to put into words the loss I am feeling... but this isn't about me. **Today, tomorrow, next week -- they're all about Charlie. ** Because Charlie was truly one of the best men I'll ever know. He changed the direction of this nation. He was a leader, a fighter, and a man whose character and conviction were rare. Too rare. He was an inspiration to millions around the world. **To me, Charlie was a little brother.** That honor I will carry with me forever.
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z9s635dni7mh9u33gfn03v2pq63knkbo7khoodfo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0shiecoj6clh2bs)
---
I'm heartbroken knowing his death will leave a hole in the heart of our nation.... and an even larger one in my life. Charlie may no longer stand beside me -- to remind me to push on when things get tough._But his memory will.__And I 'll make sure it does for this country he loved so well._Charlie led a life of courage, strength, and conviction. **Now it 's time for me, for you, and for every patriot to stand up and fight for everything Charlie stood for. **He poured every ounce of energy he had into saving this nation -- and he did that through Turning Point USA.No one fought harder than Charlie. It was his mission in life to give people the courage to speak up -- and he did that. And none of us will ever be silenced again.He fought for you and all America. Now we must fight for him.**Friend, it 's on us to keep his life's work alive...** so it can continue to reach young people, change lives, and embolden the American people.**As his friend, I ask that you help me make certain that Charlie 's voice is never silenced, stopped, or forgotten.** That it's heard across the nation... in every church, in every school, and in every home for generations._Let 's make the world remember him._**[Friend, the only way to do that is to make Turning Point USA the biggest thing America has ever seen... because Charlie's legacy doesn't end here.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zgcn4gk5akbtn7d830qlj5h2h68dn2t9j7b5vdtg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0shiecoj6clh2bs)**
---
[ **Give in Charlie's Honor**
**Support Turning Point USA**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zsvhijnb5jc9h3jnh30o1crkaovffir4c5voi63o_rp22sh2s8i6epb0shiecoj6clh2bs)
---
Charlie, we'll keep fighting the good fight. We'll carry forward the torch you lit... and we'll make sure it shines brighter than ever.**For you, we 'll save our great country.**Rest in peace, brother.**For Charlie,** Don Jr.
---

**Simply put, the radical Left is a sickness.**

**It’s truly a diabolical plot from the Left, but sadly, at this point, it should come as no surprise; they intend to JAIL me for the rest of my life.**

---

But even though the most powerful man in the country legally cannot step in to save me, the most powerful _force_ absolutely can: _THE AMERICAN PEOPLE_.

## Fed Cuts Interest Rates a Quarter Point
The Federal Reserve [cut interest rates by a quarter point](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uhDAYRE9jOpD9sWBTuEhDt2lTIv8Mi7M2rLCziNtH5AqpZ_RG877u092EGNbHp0nQZd6mFUeOKAX7NMO7n5J3U5CNdadZn_kZUsJEnLqaD7VQkzchntOt8noGCG0FLWSnhBoGxatF9xZWWPKtgzTWkRF9520nHSk_eOqqoC8aH4QSnPfEm1lI0ypprIK06MFuHD6UbW--t7CWBXM8tzf2xm2pinop5ZVZ-8FoZDQex9G41borZDReaEYjHxiNQjIaZ_j6OlR7uJDDttYZr4JksddXuVlKitWu_esIMYbcS3bjj2RC_Jsr_3L01vQbAAD___wIehc) on Wednesday, lowering its benchmark rate to a range of 4.00% to 4.25%.

Officials signaled two more cuts could come before the end of the year. Fed Chair Jerome Powell described the move as “risk management,” saying the decision places monetary policy in a more neutral position.

The vote was 11-to-1, with Governor Stephen Miran, newly appointed by President Trump, holding out for a deeper half-point cut.

Major U.S. banks quickly followed by lowering their prime lending rates. JPMorgan Chase, Citigroup, Wells Fargo, and Bank of America all reduced their prime rate to 7.25% from 7.50%. [Here's how it could affect personal finances.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O6yAUBOCnwR0WYGxDQXEbd7ntltbBHGI2_ESGJPLbr7yvsP1oRt983dYbhBjy_T8kNM2XNeOnRmwNj9Wj216tHtCwgt1OyI_6CCnhKpgYKdOUq9VBiOcqO2c8osChQ8PnUXGltWLdbqSW1jvGpFPArWNWaSXAaTu6YZyU7oK52pjmijM2CdZ7PsOgZrAKZ4sTEsnQhVaO_ruE3Hb08SxvPPqtpC6avbVnJcM_IhYiFh8y5A37E_ZSrgQRy0UiYnmWWoONSD06eqHo9mo0IWTKp4FJMQ5jv7cUu8O45yfEGOo0E8nuCUL8XWt_uuhtxE8AAAD__-FMerc)
## ABC Yanks Kimmel After Charlie Kirk Remarks
Disney-owned ABC-TV has pulled [_Jimmy Kimmel Live!_ off the air](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGP4yAQBeBfgzsiIHbABcU1dHvtldYYD5vZAI5gNiv_-5PzF7Z-0qf33r-P5QMoU_38CwU9p32p-NMzMmNbEm7xm3sDxg5rPKA--oNKwcUoM0k1S-2WDSgfyzhsPiEavA7otZ2cdvPs1HD3ytlJz86igqhGjOjSZJWCcU7XCVY7kD81NWunlboZdUnawtVZWB3aFW8oRoUb8d4uXztVvmPKx_7Cdol7GbK_Mz-7uP4RJggT6vHcO5-RMOGEhQlqFiZoK0zAytgYqBasLEyANcrnd85dflEph3yvyzLTCyXVDRNVYsyHhMTYZLxDy4TyQe0h415OpQsThua35w_lTP1mxag-C1B-1-Nfffry5n8AAAD__5DcjGk) and suspended Kimmel indefinitely after the comedian made controversial remarks about the killing of conservative activist Charlie Kirk. During his Sept. 15 monologue, [Kimmel accused the “MAGA gang”](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO6yAUheHVQOcIsDFQULzGXV47pYXhOtwxmAiYRNn9KNnC1Ef6pe98Xderw4Tn7b_LYPte1hOeLUHvUNcdgv_prboOzW3-5c6jHZgzrIIJOTAzcL0Gh-m1TjTYHUDASMFyJTXXxmhGo502UMZ5E9w2y3mUXnhvVGB-GjUHs1G07xozXHPGZsEuO1du1MptGtQGM5CJQcBe6uW74Nkj7OlVHlAvvmSabOz93sj4j4iFiKVHiJjSeyNiiSXDG0TEIiUzTJrhA0iDLznD2dvgo6sJYTiwHkQstNpwf2JK2GZFJnbLDj812v90z8OK3wAAAP__WgB5_g) of trying to spin Kirk’s murder for political gain, saying, _"We hit some new lows over the weekend with the MAGA gang trying to characterize this kid who killed Charlie Kirk as anything other than one of them."_ The decision came just minutes after Nexstar Media Group, the largest TV station group in the country, said its affiliate stations across the country would preempt _Jimmy Kimmel Live_ starting Wednesday evening over his comments. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) Chairman Brendan Carr also warned ABC and Disney about the remarks, [suggesting the FCC might take action](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSpiAQhJ9GMyxAf8GA4BKzvfRCa4RB50Tdgtnf8-2v3FfYuKu7-vv-fEwfQImO5Tfs6Die04FXSciMeYoY_BeXDIwFZn_DsZWN9h0nLfVLyEEoOwWgdE9dHVxE1NjW6JR5WWWHwcp6daCNantrtFZ2sBqD7doZB-PbQWn9sjW5Z00Oyiopey2bqAy01sBs0czYY9VJDMRnbv6edPCKMd3nG3Pjz71ObmX-LFX7q9Jjpcfrupp4_nsonrzS446BoNJj9F74FSiLhG9MRfCaEVjAAnQUFjB7EagceAuIjFl8oyZRvpYFC2N42jkRio3yJqAUKIUOscMCdXbh86KUqPSm6uSyA6Xvf_wjqW-n_wcAAP__AOSOrA) as well. _"They have a license granted by us at the FCC, and that comes with an obligation to operate in the public interest,"_ he said.
## Trump Concludes Historic UK State Visit
President Trump wraps up his historic second state [visit to the United Kingdom today](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uwzAMRk8jbwooxrHkQUMXb-na0aAjKlEj_8CiE_j2hXOFbgQe8Ij3_Vz7K6Wcpvs3jewlzv3E75JZhNc-crhtUlYSLjTcdpqe5ZnGkXsEvGhotXF9oJT3vq6Cj8zI54q9sRdnXNs6qB5-gAgEhoNztuGIOAQ0RNZZgzTUrkr-sEFrnAFoEE7RWDo7S4NjO3DDqgYOSeb19DunSR4c8z6_eD3d5rHK_iGyFHX-Utgp7KZ9mYscSGF3iBV20CrszHFtRR99CjtZt3HROb1Yb0s4Cj9EF15Em4s2jcKuWn1Y3innVBqrariPlPLnrfxrq5fHvwAAAP__JY578w), the first time a U.S. president has ever been formally invited for two full state visits by a British monarch. Over the past two days, Trump and First Lady Melania were welcomed with full pageantry at Windsor Castle, including a guard of honor, carriage procession, and a state banquet hosted by King Charles III. [See photos here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-OszAQBPCnMZ0jYwyYwsXX0OVrr0QbvIS9-A-yN4ny9ifuFa4e6Tea-bouV6BA6f4fIjre8pLwXQMyY1k29OuTawHGCrf1A-lRHxQjLlrpXqpJtnbxQOGzmMa7DVFj16Brx962dpqsanbXDxbNqvphMNrqAbfNjOgtmKlDpQ005E5NTa1tlRq0umztCJ0d4WZxvOGAwij0xLlcvjMl3nELn_zCcllzbILbmY8qun9Cz0LPvONOIZyZ0POeI56DhJ7BR0pUuQBTTkLPfa9s12vJ5RkPWRkY5YsqsXxT8jUXuULlgPLYM-eTaIrzx5tCoDqMwqh7BPptavhP172c_gkAAP__BuCEVQ). Guests at the banquet included Prime Minister Keir Starmer, Apple CEO Tim Cook, and U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio. Before heading home, Trump and Starmer are expected to finalize agreements on nuclear technology and trade.

America is under attack as never before. Our culture, our Judeo-Christian values, our traditions, our freedoms — and our very country — are all under attack. We saw this attack in the most vicious and bloody way with the **public assassination of Charlie Kirk**. Charlie Kirk was a conservative leader. But he was more. _He was a believing Christian._ In his own way he was an evangelist. Charlie Kirk's last published words — his final words — are the Foreword for the new book, **[Pagan Threat: Confronting America's Godless Uprising](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1117893/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsR0xkU0QxZw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMvdBg/s9g95097205)**. **[Pagan Threat](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1117893/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsR0xkU0QxZw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMvdBg/s9g95097205)** was written by Charlie's close friend Pastor Lucas Miles. Pastor Miles, the author of several bestselling books, served as a leader in Charlie's Turning Point Faith. Charlie told Pastor Miles he wanted to write this Foreword because **"America was in grave danger."** _**Charlie is right.**_ In his powerful Foreword, Charlie wrote: | "Because in today's America, the Christian faithful are faced with a _terrifying and broad array of dangers and threats_. "We are menaced not by new false gods, but _by the return of demons from long ago_. "In the Pagan world, **the individual human life was of no importance**."
---
These words are chilling, considering what happened in Utah.
**About the Author** **Lucas Miles** is a trusted voice on faith, politics, and culture. He hosts _The Lucas Miles Show_ on Faithwire, cohosts _The Church Boys_ podcast, and has interviewed guests like Sean Hannity and Jim Caviezel. A bestselling author (_Woke Jesus, Good God_), Lucas has appeared on Newsmax, Fox News, and CBN. An ordained pastor, he leads Nfluence Church and has served on global missions and at national events like the National Prayer Breakfast.
---
Now, in his boldest book yet — **[Pagan Threat: Confronting America's Godless Uprising](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1117893/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsR0xkU0QxZw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMvdBg/s9g95097205)** — Pastor Lucas Miles rips off the mask and reveals the shocking spiritual war happening right before our eyes.
The very same war in which Charlie was a soldier — _he was also a victim_.

## CPS Energy Buys Four Power Plants for $1.4B
CPS Energy, San Antonio’s municipally owned electricity and natural gas provider, has agreed to purchase four natural gas-fired power plants from Missouri-based ProEnergy for $1.39 billion. This will add [1,632 megawatts](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGy2yAURL8GdXjgSlhQUKShe2lTahC6WMzDRoHrh_33GfkXUu_Mnt3z52v58imnx-23v6OlVyzLA3vLSIR1ofJKoftGOM_dE9bqCff0jQsIUFwYLvWy-ZTfyzRsdhWbkQNaOSstzTgKNex2W6USckUdIqwQdJyjNitqbdbtOgk1JHuWCSO1lEJOcPGjVmOIalaIE2jDJoFbolIvtCPhy7eY3-UH6yWU-5DtTnQ0Nv5i4Bi43vvlu3k6QwbufMPA5RJ8ZuBOFAMnDAMnrwxcOBrHB9bbm1PhPvx9poo8lmflrTxpR9-If6D8KB0rP7J_UOOxVC7HlYEbqt2OnnJO7TqzSdzuPuXPNPo_oT8W_gUAAP__isOJ0w) of capacity to its portfolio—an increase of 30% and enough to power 408,000 homes daily. Located in Harris, Brazoria, and Galveston counties, the four plants were built between 2020 and 2024 and contain 34 generators capable of running on natural gas or hydrogen. The purchase price of $850 per kilowatt is [significantly less](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O2zAQRk8jdWOIf6ZYsHDjIIXTphTG4sgilhIFcry0bx94r5D2fcDDh_f3Nt0wprg__uBGnl9LnnZqNREzlYnzK84NK5O1DZlKQaY1ftEkB2lgcCDGKWBM70n3wd-H4ERPXlgzCqfUYPrVq2UeyZ6tc2Y0Qtgg5BLORit1V-hm7KP_yAYnRiEGoeUJ1WjUvBhriLQcXacHCpFzOfFKTC-sS3rnbyqnOW998ivzUTt16eS1k9fW2mmr-2fr5JV2eNYPJeSVSievnI_KuUT6YIQ1bwTlucN8VNjwiyoI0HcIhAk4w_35Bg078rNgggdWWGKhAEduVOBIuPOPqMDlIm6_6m_bFx-OFlOK9Ww7PTw2jOnnKv9f4G8v_wUAAP__WpyPsQ) than the $2,000-$2,500 per kilowatt for new facilities. This will add of capacity to its portfolio—an increase of 30% and enough to power 408,000 homes daily. Located in Harris, Brazoria, and Galveston counties, the four plants were built between 2020 and 2024 and contain 34 generators capable of running on natural gas or hydrogen. The purchase price of $850 per kilowatt is than the $2,000-$2,500 per kilowatt for new facilities. The deal aligns with the utility's goal of replacing older, less efficient plants with newer, more affordable energy generation sources. CPS Energy is set to retire two 50-year-old plants in Calaveras in 2027 and 2029, while the new plants could run for . "We are getting the best of both worlds by securing new infrastructure without delay while also strengthening the power supply for our community ," CEO and President Rudy Garza said. "It's just a home run for our community ,” he added. EPA Approves Toxic Waste Removal Plan The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency has to remove 230,000 tons of toxic waste from the San Jacinto River in far east Harris County. The site has been contaminated with dioxins since the 1960s from the byproducts of pulp bleaching at a nearby paper mill. The pollutants have been linked to in the area, and the EPA ordered International Paper Co. and a subsidiary of Houston-based Waste Management to clean up the in 2017. After the work is completed, the companies must provide samples from the river to demonstrate that all contamination has been removed. In a , the EPA characterized the requirement as "an essential step in the Superfund cleanup process." "This is a victory for all of the residents who have been pushing for the cleanup of this environmental hazard for so many years," , founder of the Texas Health and Environment Alliance. DFW, Love Field Among Nation's Best Airports DFW International Airport and Dallas Love Field rank among the , according to J.D. Power's annual rankings released yesterday. The study ranked airports on a 1,000-point scale and was based on 30,439 surveys completed by passengers over the past year. With a score of 620, DFW ranked fourth among "mega" airports—those with 33 million or more passengers per year—behind Minneapolis-Saint Paul, Detroit, and Phoenix. Michael Taylor, J.D. Power's managing director of travel, highlighted the airport's construction progress, retail and dining experience, and people-mover system. Dallas Love Field's score of 705 among large airports with 10 to 32.9 million passengers per year, trailing Orange County and Tampa. And in the end — Charlie gave it all.

No one can replace him. But all of us can carry forward with what he started.

Friend, we want to give you a glimpse into the legacy he left behind — and the calling that now belongs to us.

We made this tribute to honor the man who gave everything... And to remind the world that his mission will press on:

Fellow Patriot,

Did you know the Star Spangled Banner was written by a political prisoner?

Francis Scott Key was under guard by the British (_he knew too much_) when the victory of the American patriots at the Battle of Baltimore inspired him to write the lyrics.

_There is a reason that we January 6th hostages sang it while locked in the D.C. gulag._

**You see, I was one of the patriots arrested for being at the Capitol on January 6th. What we suffered through is an experience I will never forget.**

It's what inspired me to create Stand in the Gap, a non-profit that helps January 6th hostages and others who've been affected by our justice system succeed in their second chance at freedom and end the two-tiered system of justice in this country.

Before I tell you more about my experience, I have to ask for your support so Stand in the Gap can provide help, hope, and healing to these American patriots in need.

[Please click below to help us restore the promise of the American Dream today.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c2c3db54ff684b7e8e1817abb0c89972&_e=vF7wANW5nyAwIzV1LPRFPA-Ct7ydHDgH6CQGILGO3nTmXngJkBgpxlraU0ZXLngjRb8DvqbsIMZetgf7nSQ9P2gnZcKO8oixX7dnir2GkCy9y-2uDOSyyI5NeNgMD_67M4dduDhuqgfU2_ra9ZFW4BIwFMH8LMzbF1J2mSbLQ5uZLLIs0rDDLcPkkuVh2Cja5lN4q0PxNbPJxh4i-XhO36QjQVPXrPVWHnds-1a9vdfWVca98xfq96nUXb2HsKjKEonAaGZ0rS8AtLvP759CuNZDBIThNfELsGQ1QYOjWgwRT5A2jN7psK9An7qCHJrgRHiONcHFHfFm7CUwDYYfBm5DKubPZ-XLg9xkOiyZvvHDXwmdtRNXhQ0vgpE0M_evS67b7gKfK8hHC8yKCT03ex3rkRilNyI5CDvJCmpETcJO1p4qahlGYp1Vh1EZ3C4oQjvOMVWBEMXsDBvKN6cNm9xIxFhXBYszyqCNAWf3l_11jF-EmA_Ghl80kafsUVaKtpCiDQEXkRp4tS4vjit-p-5_2OEZ4w2daM351l88aKbudbJCY7ou2lFtiV9xUm8dIeQ5R85DaIO6YZUvWHjYRYRwwH80K2lpqtk8-b_b_Qe_hNypIy44luu4RYDQMpbm)

[Donate](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c2c3db54ff684b7e8e1817abb0c89972&_e=vF7wANW5nyAwIzV1LPRFPA-Ct7ydHDgH6CQGILGO3nTmXngJkBgpxlraU0ZXLngjRb8DvqbsIMZetgf7nSQ9P2gnZcKO8oixX7dnir2GkCy9y-2uDOSyyI5NeNgMD_67M4dduDhuqgfU2_ra9ZFW4BIwFMH8LMzbF1J2mSbLQ5toR7oo1EM7OCGP-OsAQqkRYBqkLxyYOSgnUYHIQC15PZWrlm5XmsGfaMxJpH2Wy1aymDxnrpcRKEGJkrlhF_OOkA7b3sQYANzw7sFuTeCKqNhhQvLN-OkeFRPODTI8wGJEeGJBMVUqI5Lm82T3ySSG7YokIxHqhp1pkKicE0W5hATQm9S4GLDu3OIRIVYdQdcC8j5tWyGkaJPr7Rt3MjE8BgMIzeA7F7CpLBkB50YESTFmOCcqTMC8Dg9TuLNS23ztqBPwZoSA6-LPb494ygGfZbQxnL3t6u-SbuklLDro_X_kGDivC2YKTZNEbTP12aG3a8ZGsqv6lOS75_PsCkBkxFFRJiwVd-pG-0py3tU3ldutf9N10bYN4LnaMLCv5QdyIP0uk7vSkE06_gq-pAgs00lwf7FJ5KK9mL6Z8_wJhrh7ltWjZE0XHgMBIck9oKOhWHBhRT9YLnJljfrLk98nm20c3CQ1oMVZWIhgC1TmeA%3D%3D)

_**" Oh, say can you see, by the dawn's early light"**_

I will never forget standing behind the bars of the DC jail on the Fourth of July, staring through a narrow window as fireworks burst over the Capitol.

It was a strange and surreal feeling to watch the glow of freedom while being caged by the very government that was supposed to defend it.

_**" What so proudly we hailed at the twilight's last gleaming"**_

Even in that dark place, even while they tried to strip away our rights, the spirit of America never left us.

On the Fourth of July, something powerful happened.

Men who came from every background stood shoulder to shoulder, pressing against those tiny windows.

**For a few moments, we were not inmates. We were Americans.**

Watching the night sky blaze with red, white, and blue.

_**" Whose broad stripes and bright stars, through the perilous fight"**_

Like my fellow January 6th hostages, I was in the fight of my life.

But even behind bars, even as the government tried to silence me, that banner still flew. A symbol that tyranny might try to break the body, but it cannot crush the spirit.

_**" O'er the ramparts we watched were so gallantly streaming"**_

We watched through concrete and steel as the fireworks filled the air. Proof that freedom still existed out there. That freedom still mattered.

It was a painful reminder that it had been taken from us, but also a promise that it could be reclaimed.

_**" And the rockets' red glare, the bombs bursting in air,
Gave proof through the night that our flag was still there."**_

That night in DC, those fireworks were more than a celebration. They were proof.

Proof that no matter how hard they tried to crush us, the flag was still there. _We were still there_.

_**" O say does that star-spangled banner yet wave,
O'er the land of the free and the home of the brave"**_

Even though we are now free, thanks to the grace of God and the bravery of President Trump, the fight is not over.

I want my fellow January 6th hostages to know that Stand in the Gap is still here to help them and their families rebuild what was stolen. From transitional housing to wellness programs, credit repair to employment help, we are proving that freedom is not just an idea. It is a reality worth fighting for.

clean_body: Fellow Patriot, Did you know the Star Spangled Banner was written by a political prisoner? Francis Scott Key was under guard by the British (he knew too much) when the victory of the American patriots at the Battle of Baltimore inspired him to write the lyrics. There is a reason that we January 6th hostages sang it while locked in the D.C. gulag. You see, I was one of the patriots arrested for being at the Capitol on January 6th. What we suffered through is an experience I will never forget. It's what inspired me to create Stand in the Gap, a non-profit that helps January 6th hostages and others who've been affected by our justice system succeed in their second chance at freedom and end the two-tiered system of justice in this country. Before I tell you more about my experience, I have to ask for your support so Stand in the Gap can provide help, hope, and healing to these American patriots in need. " Oh, say can you see, by the dawn's early light" I will never forget standing behind the bars of the DC jail on the Fourth of July, staring through a narrow window as fireworks burst over the Capitol. It was a strange and surreal feeling to watch the glow of freedom while being caged by the very government that was supposed to defend it. " What so proudly we hailed at the twilight's last gleaming" Even in that dark place, even while they tried to strip away our rights, the spirit of America never left us. On the Fourth of July, something powerful happened. Men who came from every background stood shoulder to shoulder, pressing against those tiny windows. For a few moments, we were not inmates. We were Americans. Watching the night sky blaze with red, white, and blue. " Whose broad stripes and bright stars, through the perilous fight" Like my fellow January 6th hostages, I was in the fight of my life. But even behind bars, even as the government tried to silence me, that banner still flew. A symbol that tyranny might try to break the body, but it cannot crush the spirit. " O'er the ramparts we watched were so gallantly streaming" We watched through concrete and steel as the fireworks filled the air. Proof that freedom still existed out there. That freedom still mattered. It was a painful reminder that it had been taken from us, but also a promise that it could be reclaimed. " And the rockets' red glare, the bombs bursting in air, Gave proof through the night that our flag was still there." That night in DC, those fireworks were more than a celebration. They were proof. Proof that no matter how hard they tried to crush us, the flag was still there. We were still there. " O say does that star-spangled banner yet wave, O'er the land of the free and the home of the brave" Even though we are now free, thanks to the grace of God and the bravery of President Trump, the fight is not over. I want my fellow January 6th hostages to know that Stand in the Gap is still here to help them and their families rebuild what was stolen. From transitional housing to wellness programs, credit repair to employment help, we are proving that freedom is not just an idea. It is a reality worth fighting for. Okay, let's say you're me. You use your smartphone a lot. You use social media a lot. When you wake up in the morning, the first thing you do is check your phone. You need to feel connected because people might be trying to reach you.
At the same time, you can kind of sense that it's not great for you. You feel drained sometimes after being on social media. You open an app to do something and then get distracted and think, "What was I doing again?" You don't pay as much attention to the people around you as you should when you're out to dinner.
Does this sound like you? Here are a few practices I've adopted that have helped me. Maybe they'll help you too.
1\. Don't sleep with your phone. The first thing is, don't sleep with your phone in the same room as you. The blue light emitted by phones suppresses melatonin, a hormone that tells your body it's time to sleep. Notifications might disturb you. There's some thought that electromagnetic radiation from your phone also might reduce sleep quality.
Now, some of you are thinking, "Then how will I wake up??" You can get something called an alarm clock. It's maybe twenty bucks and it also tells the time. Put your charger in your living room, and leave the phone there.
Screen time before bed also makes it harder to sleep. Try to avoid using your phone for an hour before bedtime. So what to do with that hour? Experts recommend books; no blue light, and if it's boring, hey it'll help you get to sleep.
2\. Adjust your notifications. "I need someone to be able to get in touch with me because it's an emergency." Okay . . . but what constitutes an emergency? Some rando on Instagram liking your avocado toast pic?
You can make it so that your loved ones can reach you in case there's something really going on, but not the borderline work contact or social media notification.
For iPhones: Go to Settings > Focus
For Androids: Go to Settings > Digital Wellbeing & Parental Controls > Focus Mode
For example, you can set 'Personal' mode so that all of your friends and family can call or text you, but your social media apps are muted. Problem solved. You can have 4 modes: Work, Personal, Do Not Disturb, and Sleep. It's up to you whether you want people to see those modes when they try reaching out to you. Silencing social media apps is the true godsend here.
This is awesome because if you do the settings once then you're good to go, and it can become a habit.
3\. Give yourself a break. Is there something you can do during the day during which maybe you can leave the phone off or at home? A workout comes to mind. If you go for a jog, do it without your phone. It can also be an hour of work focus time, or reading, or just relaxing. Or, dare I say it, a bathroom trip. What will you do in the bathroom without a phone? It's unknown and unknowable, it's just you in there.
I sometimes go for a quick walk without my phone just to get some air and let my mind reset. If you have a quick errand to run, maybe don't bring your phone with you from your apartment or office. It will still be there when you get back, unless you owe your roommate money.
4\. Phone-free meetings or lunch. Try this the next time you meet a friend for lunch; bust your phone out and scroll through it the whole time. Super rude, right? You would never do that. But will you check your phone when it buzzes during salad?
Studies have shown that we trust people more when their phone is not in evidence. Seriously. The reverse is true too - if your phone is out we think your attention is divided. So mute your phone during your next meeting or coffee and keep it out of sight. You might find that you do a better job catching up and the person likes you better.
5\. Give yourself some lag time. We often think getting back to someone right away shows that we're on top of something. But the truth is that 99.9% of things can wait 60 minutes. Heck, many communications chains will even benefit from a bit of breathing space. You can consider yourself reachable and able to respond to things but not necessarily moment-to-moment instantaneously. If you're out-of-pocket for 30 or 40 minutes, that's totally fine. Heck, maybe it will make you seem more important, like you're actually doing things or in the midst of high-impact meetings. You're very important and busy.
Look, I'm a heavy phone user. But I know there's too much of a good thing, and sometimes it seems like social media apps run on the power of human souls because I feel depleted after using them. We should all pursue balance in our lives, and most of us have a liiiiiiittttle bit too much screentime in our waking hours. Hopefully, these 5 things can make it a little bit better and they seem achievable. "Go to the can once a day without having your phone with you."
Now, most of you know I've started a new wireless company, Noble Mobile, that is trying to help by giving you money back to doomscroll less and live a little more. But regardless of which carrier you use, these tips might help you feel a bit less captive to what Hasan Minhaj called "our rectangles of sadness."
Let's look at our screens a little less and look up at the faces around us a little bit more. Oh yeah, that's what my kids look like.

The first thing is, don't sleep with your phone in the same room as you. The blue light emitted by phones suppresses melatonin, a hormone that tells your body it's time to sleep. Notifications might disturb you. There's some thought that electromagnetic radiation from your phone also might reduce sleep quality. Now, some of you are thinking, "Then how will I wake up??" You can get something called an alarm clock. It's maybe twenty bucks and it also tells the time. Put your charger in your living room, and leave the phone there. Screen time before bed also makes it harder to sleep. Try to avoid using your phone for an hour before bedtime. So what to do with that hour? Experts recommend books; no blue light, and if it's boring, hey it'll help you get to sleep. 2\. Adjust your notifications. "I need someone to be able to get in touch with me because it's an emergency." Okay . . . but what constitutes an emergency? Some rando on Instagram liking your avocado toast pic? You can make it so that your loved ones can reach you in case there's something really going on, but not the borderline work contact or social media notification. For iPhones: Go to Settings > Focus For Androids: Go to Settings > Digital Wellbeing & Parental Controls > Focus Mode For example, you can set 'Personal' mode so that all of your friends and family can call or text you, but your social media apps are muted. Problem solved. You can have 4 modes: Work, Personal, Do Not Disturb, and Sleep. It's up to you whether you want people to see those modes when they try reaching out to you. Silencing social media apps is the true godsend here. This is awesome because if you do the settings once then you're good to go, and it can become a habit. 3\. Give yourself a break. Is there something you can do during the day during which maybe you can leave the phone off or at home? A workout comes to mind. If you go for a jog, do it without your phone. It can also be an hour of work focus time, or reading, or just relaxing. Or, dare I say it, a bathroom trip. What will you do in the bathroom without a phone? It's unknown and unknowable, it's just you in there. I sometimes go for a quick walk without my phone just to get some air and let my mind reset. If you have a quick errand to run, maybe don't bring your phone with you from your apartment or office. It will still be there when you get back, unless you owe your roommate money. 4\. Phone-free meetings or lunch. Try this the next time you meet a friend for lunch; bust your phone out and scroll through it the whole time. Super rude, right? You would never do that. But will you check your phone when it buzzes during salad? Studies have shown that we trust people more when their phone is not in evidence. Seriously. The reverse is true too - if your phone is out we think your attention is divided. So mute your phone during your next meeting or coffee and keep it out of sight. You might find that you do a better job catching up and the person likes you better. 5\. Give yourself some lag time. We often think getting back to someone right away shows that we're on top of something. But the truth is that 99.9% of things can wait 60 minutes. Heck, many communications chains will even benefit from a bit of breathing space. You can consider yourself reachable and able to respond to things but not necessarily moment-to-moment instantaneously. If you're out-of-pocket for 30 or 40 minutes, that's totally fine. Heck, maybe it will make you seem more important, like you're actually doing things or in the midst of high-impact meetings. You're very important and busy. Look, I'm a heavy phone user. But I know there's too much of a good thing, and sometimes it seems like social media apps run on the power of human souls because I feel depleted after using them. We should all pursue balance in our lives, and most of us have a liiiiiiittttle bit too much screentime in our waking hours. Hopefully, these 5 things can make it a little bit better and they seem achievable. "Go to the can once a day without having your phone with you." Now, most of you know I've started a new wireless company, Noble Mobile, that is trying to help by giving you money back to doomscroll less and live a little more. But regardless of which carrier you use, these tips might help you feel a bit less captive to what Hasan Minhaj called "our rectangles of sadness." Let's look at our screens a little less and look up at the faces around us a little bit more. Oh yeah, that's what my kids look like. This week's in New York on September 18th has over 1,000 RSVPs! is off to a rousing start and people tell me that our first made them laugh. For my convo with Zach about starting Noble check out our podcast . | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | (C) 2025 Andrew Yang 111 Sutter Street, 7th Floor, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

subject: Charlie’s legacy must live on
body:
His fire lit a movement. It’s up to us to keep it burning.

| | | [](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)
---
Dear Patriot, I don’t even know how to begin to put into words the loss I am feeling... but this isn’t about me. **Today, tomorrow, next week — they’re all about Charlie.** Because Charlie was truly one of the best men I’ll ever know. He changed the direction of this nation. He was a leader, a fighter, and a man whose character and conviction were rare. Too rare. He was an inspiration to millions around the world. **To me, Charlie was a little brother.** That honor I will carry with me forever.
---
[](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)
---
I’m heartbroken knowing his death will leave a hole in the heart of our nation.... and an even larger one in my life. Charlie may no longer stand beside me — to remind me to push on when things get tough. _But his memory will._ _And I’ll make sure it does for this country he loved so well._ Charlie led a life of courage, strength, and conviction. **Now it’s time for me, for you, and for every patriot to stand up and fight for everything Charlie stood for.** He poured every ounce of energy he had into saving this nation — and he did that through Turning Point USA. No one fought harder than Charlie. It was his mission in life to give people the courage to speak up — and he did that. And none of us will ever be silenced again. He fought for you and all America. Now we must fight for him. **Patriot, it’s on us to keep his life’s work alive...** so it can continue to reach young people, change lives, and embolden the American people. **As his friend, I ask that you help me make certain that Charlie’s voice is never silenced, stopped, or forgotten.** That it’s heard across the nation... in every church, in every school, and in every home for generations. _Let’s make the world remember him._ **[Patriot, the only way to do that is to make Turning Point USA the biggest thing America has ever seen... because Charlie’s legacy doesn’t end here.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)**
---
[ **Give in Charlie's Honor**
**Support Turning Point USA** ](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)
---
Charlie, we’ll keep fighting the good fight. We’ll carry forward the torch you lit... and we’ll make sure it shines brighter than ever. **For you, we’ll save our great country.** Rest in peace, brother. **For Charlie,** Don Jr.

clean_body: His fire lit a movement. It’s up to us to keep it burning. | | | Dear Patriot, I don’t even know how to begin to put into words the loss I am feeling... but this isn’t about me. Today, tomorrow, next week — they’re all about Charlie. Because Charlie was truly one of the best men I’ll ever know. He changed the direction of this nation. He was a leader, a fighter, and a man whose character and conviction were rare. Too rare. He was an inspiration to millions around the world. To me, Charlie was a little brother. That honor I will carry with me forever. I’m heartbroken knowing his death will leave a hole in the heart of our nation.... and an even larger one in my life. Charlie may no longer stand beside me — to remind me to push on when things get tough. But his memory will. And I’ll make sure it does for this country he loved so well. Charlie led a life of courage, strength, and conviction. Now it’s time for me, for you, and for every patriot to stand up and fight for everything Charlie stood for. He poured every ounce of energy he had into saving this nation — and he did that through Turning Point USA. No one fought harder than Charlie. It was his mission in life to give people the courage to speak up — and he did that. And none of us will ever be silenced again. He fought for you and all America. Now we must fight for him. Patriot, it’s on us to keep his life’s work alive... so it can continue to reach young people, change lives, and embolden the American people. As his friend, I ask that you help me make certain that Charlie’s voice is never silenced, stopped, or forgotten. That it’s heard across the nation... in every church, in every school, and in every home for generations. Let’s make the world remember him. Charlie, we’ll keep fighting the good fight. We’ll carry forward the torch you lit... and we’ll make sure it shines brighter than ever. For you, we’ll save our great country. Rest in peace, brother. For Charlie, Don Jr. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044
