name: Tucker Carlson
subject: Our duty now: carry Charlie’s mission forward.
body:
Right now, Charlie would say, “Don’t you dare quit”

| | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bbBS/?__vbtrk=MzIwMTE2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzIwMTE2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend,
---
I don’t write emails like this often. But right now? After what happened to Charlie... _I can’t stay quiet._**Charlie Kirk was my friend.** Not just someone I admired, but someone I loved and respected deeply. Losing him was devastating.
---
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bbBS/?__vbtrk=MzIwMTE2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzIwMTE2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
In many ways, all of us share in this loss. Charlie fought every day of his life for each one of us... fighting to keep America as great, free, and prosperous. No one I know ever fought for that harder than Charlie.America won't ever be the same. **No one can ever replace him — but we can make sure his legacy continues on. **_We owe him that._ Because if you knew Charlie, you would know exactly what he would say to us right now: _**"Don’t you dare quit."**_ Charlie poured his heart into building a movement to save America. He believed in young people. He believed in ordinary Americans. And he believed that even in our darkest hours, America was the beacon of goodness, freedom, and truth.That’s what the Turning Point movement was all about — and Charlie gave everything he had to that fight.**And our task now is not only to protect what he built — it’s to grow it bigger, stronger, and bolder than anyone ever thought possible. ** More students. More churches. More families. More courage from everyday Americans to stand up and fight for what is right.Turning Point USA was Charlie’s vehicle to save America. **He didn’t just start a movement... _he started a revival. _**And now, friend,, we must carry that forward. If you share the same sense of responsibility that I do to honor Charlie’s work and press on with his vision...** _Then please join me in keeping his fight alive by making a gift to Turning Point USA today. _** **[Let’s make Turning Point USA the biggest thing that this nation has ever seen... bigger than Charlie ever thought possible. That’s how we honor him best.](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bbBS/?__vbtrk=MzIwMTE2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzIwMTE2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**
---
[ **Give in Charlie's Honor**
**Support Turning Point USA**](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bbBS/?__vbtrk=MzIwMTE2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzIwMTE2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Rest in peace, Charlie. We’ll carry the torch you lit from here.
---
**For Charlie,** Tucker Carlson

### "The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit." Psalm 34:18

---

Like a wave, the memory of what happened to Charlie--and how he responded, the look in his eyes, the sway of his body--washes over me again and again. It comes, it crashes, it recedes, and then it comes again. It is so very surreal.
I've been impacted by what took place last Wednesday at a deeper level than I could have ever imagined. For someone like me--having run my own campaign, traveled the nation with Vivek Ramaswamy, stepped into countless rooms and met people doing great work--you might think I would be hardened to moments like this. But I am not.
I shared a stage with Charlie early on in my public journey, at Liberty University. I remember meeting his wife back when she was still his girlfriend, traveling with the team. Beyond that, my interactions with Charlie were much like yours: watching from a distance, cheering him on. I did not know him personally. And yet, I never expected to be impacted the way I have been.
The very thought of what happened makes my voice shake, my heart ache, my eyes well with tears. I was surprised not only by the tragedy itself, but by my own response to it. At an event yesterday, I shared a bit of this, and a woman said to me: _" That's grief."_ And she was right. I am grieving.
Not only the loss of a young life--cut short in such a horrible way. Not only the loss of a husband, a father, a champion of our values. I am grieving something deeper: a loss for our nation, and a sadness for what our children will inherit.
Charlie was a bright light, filled with goodness and a desire to live out his purpose. Even if I didn't agree with every word, I admired his courage and conviction. His death leaves me with both personal sorrow and a national sadness for how far we've fallen.
But I still believe there is hope. My hope is not in man, but in Christ. _" He is my refuge and my fortress, my God in whom I trust." (Psalms 91:2) "Because He is my help, I can sing in the shadow of His wings." (Psalms 63:7)_
So let me encourage you, as I remind myself: **feel what you are feeling. Allow yourself to grieve. And let your grief remind you that we are made for more --that even in loss, God is near, and He is still our hope.**
Blessings...

name: Donald Trump, Jr.
subject: Charlie’s legacy must live on
body:
His fire lit a movement. It’s up to us to keep it burning.

| | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Dear Patriot, I don’t even know how to begin to put into words the loss I am feeling... but this isn’t about me. **Today, tomorrow, next week — they’re all about Charlie.** Because Charlie was truly one of the best men I’ll ever know. He changed the direction of this nation. He was a leader, a fighter, and a man whose character and conviction were rare. Too rare. He was an inspiration to millions around the world. **To me, Charlie was a little brother.** That honor I will carry with me forever.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
I’m heartbroken knowing his death will leave a hole in the heart of our nation.... and an even larger one in my life. Charlie may no longer stand beside me — to remind me to push on when things get tough. _But his memory will._ _And I’ll make sure it does for this country he loved so well._ Charlie led a life of courage, strength, and conviction. **Now it’s time for me, for you, and for every patriot to stand up and fight for everything Charlie stood for.** He poured every ounce of energy he had into saving this nation — and he did that through Turning Point USA. No one fought harder than Charlie. It was his mission in life to give people the courage to speak up — and he did that. And none of us will ever be silenced again. He fought for you and all America. Now we must fight for him. **Patriot, it’s on us to keep his life’s work alive...** so it can continue to reach young people, change lives, and embolden the American people. **As his friend, I ask that you help me make certain that Charlie’s voice is never silenced, stopped, or forgotten.** That it’s heard across the nation... in every church, in every school, and in every home for generations. _Let’s make the world remember him._ **[Patriot, the only way to do that is to make Turning Point USA the biggest thing America has ever seen... because Charlie’s legacy doesn’t end here.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
---
[ **Give in Charlie's Honor**
**Support Turning Point USA** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Charlie, we’ll keep fighting the good fight. We’ll carry forward the torch you lit... and we’ll make sure it shines brighter than ever. **For you, we’ll save our great country.** Rest in peace, brother. **For Charlie,** Don Jr.
---

---

As a former Navy SEAL, this isn’t the first battlefield death that I’ve seen - but it may be the most poignant | [](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=7bbc4b8d287e452bbfa4b84ca23a129e&_e=vZCGOusWCLE95wQCQUroZVfq03Mfj2Jr6EiGpbokGCAO3gLfqmZQpG4bSwEIk0Iryn_WJx8YC0QzruiezfAbcFfuQORMZ2ZnlNXlc928b4rLthmKqKD68UpKaNwV76RF3njKbyq_99QYNCIarFNu_o_JUc4hP3z1cyEclaSMRAeDfs-z76THQ-yiD_Nna4vMtxCYWwnCgN_I4dHmKsvpw-n1m4pnxD7WG3mqzFhGZypOhwrQFpJ72ZyPeXjl0_WxYZRzGugLnhxNnlV5qtW_NatXfGiU8MZhski5v2IPY-AnbsaxGT8e1pV55uC9MH2qq-jo2cxXd5Pgdqh0EGU1vhC0vfXzKF69RBRqw1GQduHFnJkOoCziraEMo_lVS2FNyMxNES4oO5JNbDo97xNP_DCc4BzxKcGFg9JVJ8m2bD3trbZaAXN6cWm_tUbxY2QTFiDdDmjYX8clg7Rl5NR1fd1YlpdKIVzPgLQndjiFOwjdzUTT5y836CXKO9kZIbkt7rHzOooZzlzJ3QmdGWEojTPB-In9Ku0BH9rimcJXxHVOXF5Nek1q2XkuiV5eweTTVLPKEIFGVqG1eQpJdV22F1f0Ysrnc9RqTVoHItMbU1YLU_2xQo1-02uET-3J50FVZYXGwEB-CoFEFeHFKNiaIcXDk53Z5JJYAKM4XG7QKAYrMk7pJR7wUYG5duynEPmDqsGrhb9cGd9HIcXRYglMcI4tWNCB40QXSYQCsNYbZ5HCsapURebgD20UMA5ygCvvwKKI8SOhlHSZsNQSp6Yf_ZGKPbdNP8QU3P_iUx3UWYk%3D)

---

Fellow Conservative,

The nation mourns the tragic assassination of Charlie Kirk, gunned down on September 10, 2025, at Utah Valley University for daring to speak truth to power. His fearless voice—championing freedom, faith, and the American Dream—was silenced in a brazen act of political violence that has shaken us all to our core. Charlie fought hate with educated debate, not guns, using sharp wit and unyielding principle to challenge radical agendas. **Yet, he was punished with a bullet for his courage to speak.**

My name is Adam Schwarze. **I’m a former Navy SEAL running for the United States Senate in Minnesota, and Charlie Kirk is an inspiration to me.** Over the course of my career, I’ve met some very special men and women willing to put their lives on the line for God and country in some of the most inhospitable places imaginable.

**_I never had the pleasure of meeting Charlier Kirk, but as a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran, I can say with authority that he has to be one of the bravest individuals ever to champion the values of the United States of America._**

Charlie’s candor, professionalism, and respect for everyone he encountered will stick with me as I work to earn the support of every Minnesotan voter during this campaign. **Charlie’s life should serve as an example to my opponents on the other side of the aisle on how to treat political opponents and people who share different viewpoints, with respect.**

I joined the Marine Corps after 9/11, served in over 70 countries, and fought chaos and extremism. I know what it takes to serve something bigger than yourself—just like Charlie did with every debate, every speech, every stand he took. This Senate race is my most challenging mission yet. Minnesota hasn’t gone red since 1976. | **Clemson University** confirmed Tuesday it has now fired three employees, including two professors, for posting inappropriate content on social media celebrating the assassination of Charlie Kirk.

At the **University of South Carolina** , one faculty member has been accused of posting disturbing comments online following Kirk’s assassination, according to multiple reports. Mace said these allegations demand a full investigation and consequences. USC has relieved this professor of his teaching duties but still employs the individual full time in their Union office, Disability Services department. At **Coastal Carolina University** , officials announced they have dismissed one employee and suspended another without pay after offensive social media posts tied to Kirk’s death. One of the posts allegedly suggested violence was “the only answer” and even implied that Nancy Mace could be assassinated next.

* **Champion Our Children’s Future** by ensuring South Carolina classrooms are safe from indoctrination, brainwashing and hate.

Fellow Patriot,

Did you know the Star Spangled Banner was written by a political prisoner?

Francis Scott Key was under guard by the British (_he knew too much_) when the victory of the American patriots at the Battle of Baltimore inspired him to write the lyrics.

_There is a reason that we January 6th hostages sang it while locked in the D.C. gulag._

**You see, I was one of the patriots arrested for being at the Capitol on January 6th. What we suffered through is an experience I will never forget.**

It's what inspired me to create Stand in the Gap, a non-profit that helps January 6th hostages and others who've been affected by our justice system succeed in their second chance at freedom and end the two-tiered system of justice in this country.

Before I tell you more about my experience, I have to ask for your support so Stand in the Gap can provide help, hope, and healing to these American patriots in need.

I want my fellow January 6th hostages to know that Stand in the Gap is still here to help them and their families rebuild what was stolen. * * *
# Media giant demands Jimmy Kimmel make a direct apology to Charlie Kirk's family for classless remarks
The media giant, which operates 40 ABC affiliates, announced it will keep "Jimmy Kimmel Live!" off its stations until Kimmel makes **[a "direct apology"](https://substack.com/redirect/dc5d4232-0e03-4d4b-9bff-e565d27291ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to Charlie Kirk's family and donates to Turning Point USA, calling ABC's indefinite suspension insufficient.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dc5d4232-0e03-4d4b-9bff-e565d27291ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **What did Kimmel say to get fired?:** "The MAGA Gang (is) desperately trying to characterize this kid who murdered Charlie Kirk as anything other than one of them and doing everything they can to score political points from it," Kimmel said. "In between the finger-pointing, there was grieving."

* **FCC Chairman supports regulatory action:** Trump appointee Brendan Carr praised Sinclair's move and told conservative podcasters the FCC would take action against Disney, encouraging local affiliates to preempt Kimmel's program and calling for "change" at the network.
* **Corporate interests may drive Disney's decision:** Industry observers suggest Disney CEO Robert Iger sacrificed Kimmel to avoid conflicts with the Trump administration while seeking approval for ESPN's multi-billion-dollar NFL deal and other pending business arrangements requiring federal approval.
* **Multiple broadcasters join boycott:** Nexstar Media Group, the largest local TV operator with 265 stations, also dropped Kimmel's show, while Sinclair plans to air a Charlie Kirk remembrance special during Kimmel's Friday timeslot across all its stations nationwide.
* **Hollywood unions condemn move as censorship:** SAG-AFTRA and the Writers Guild of America called the suspension "a dangerous precedent" and "blatant attack on creative freedom," while Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer termed it "outrageous," as Kimmel reportedly explores options to break from ABC.

* * *
# JD Vance hits back at Obama for accusing Trump admin of "exploiting" Charlie Kirk's death
Vice President JD Vance fired back at Barack Obama for suggesting the Trump White House was using Charlie Kirk's death to target political enemies, during an interview with Fox News' Jesse Watters.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/65d10afc-2d4c-44fd-a878-e84bb59a0ca3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Vance fires back:** Vance said, "We are not exploiting Charlie Kirk's death to do anything except seek justice!" Vance continued, "If he said that, that's absolutely disgusting!"

* **Obama criticizes[premature enemy identification:](https://substack.com/redirect/b52c461d-9b14-44aa-b6bf-69b7ce018d0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Obama criticized the Trump administration for suggesting they would "identify an enemy" before determining who the perpetrator was, and claiming that "extremist views" are within the White House.

subject: It's crazy that we're in this position in the first place.

body:
Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s "leadership" at the Department of Health and Human Services should have us all concerned, Peter.
Robert F. Kennedy Jr. 's leadership at the Department of Health and Human Services should have us all concerned, Peter.

He simply does not have the qualifications to do this job properly, and his long record of questioning vaccines should worry every American family.

Our government has a duty to protect the health and safety of the American people. That means making sure we’re prepared for the next pandemic, that children are fully protected before they head back to school, and that preventable diseases like measles and mumps don’t see the kind of resurgence we’re already beginning to witness— _including here in Kentucky._

As HHS Secretary, Kennedy should be strengthening our defenses against these threats. Instead, he is undermining trusted science and removing critical funding from the very programs that are designed to keep families safe. That’s not leadership, **it’s recklessness.** Real leadership means working to better the lives of those you serve. It means listening to experts, following the science, and putting people above politics.

But Peter, right now, it's clear that’s not what we’re getting. I'm calling on Robert F. Kennedy Jr. to use trusted science to guide healthcare decisions, restore the funding our communities depend on, and take real steps to protect Americans from the health challenges we face. | Letter from the Chair
---
The Role of the Nebraska Republican Party (NEGOP)
The Nebraska Republican Party (NEGOP) is often asked, "What do you do?" While candidates are visibly campaigning--knocking on doors, speaking to voters, and raising funds with the urgency of an election deadline--the NEGOP operates tirelessly, year-round, to provide the essential framework that supports Republican candidates and elected officials. As the "middle man" in the party structure, the NEGOP bridges the gap between national leadership, state operations, and grassroots efforts.
Our Role in the Republican Ecosystem At the top, President Donald J. Trump and Vice President JD Vance serve as the titular heads of the Republican Party, shaping its overall direction. The Republican National Committee (RNC) supports state parties like the NEGOP, which, in turn, empowers county parties. This interconnected structure ensures a unified effort to advance Republican values and elect candidates at all levels. The NEGOP is the backbone of this system in Nebraska, providing resources, strategy, and coordination to strengthen Republican campaigns. Unlike candidates with finite campaign cycles, our work is continuous, laying the groundwork for success in every election.
Preparing for the 2026 Election Cycle As we head into the fall of 2025, the NEGOP is focused on preparing for the 2026 election cycle. Our efforts include:
* Recruiting Candidates: Identifying and supporting strong Republican candidates for local, state, and federal offices.
* Fundraising: Securing the financial resources necessary to fuel effective campaigns.
* Strategic Planning: Developing comprehensive plans to maximize support for all GOP candidates.
* Voter Engagement: Driving voter registration and Get-Out-the-Vote (GOTV) initiatives to boost turnout.
* Campaign Resources: Providing campaigns with free tools, such as walk apps and data access, to enhance outreach and efficiency.

These efforts are designed to create a cohesive, well-supported network of Republican candidates who can compete and win.
The Power of County Parties County parties are the grassroots heart of the NEGOP. They play a critical role by:
* Organizing local Republicans to build community and momentum.
* Recruiting candidates for local races, ensuring strong representation at every level.
* Serving as a vital feedback loop, relaying the concerns and priorities of Nebraska voters to the state party.

Unity is Our Strength When the NEGOP, county parties, and candidates work together, we achieve our greatest success. Collaboration creates economies of scale, fosters synergy, and amplifies our impact, leading to more Republican victories. However, if we operate in silos, we risk inefficiency and missed opportunities. By uniting our efforts, sharing resources, and aligning our goals, the NEGOP ensures that Nebraska Republicans are positioned to win elections and advance our shared values. Together, we build a stronger, more effective party for the future.

Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party
---
| |

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair The Role of the Nebraska Republican Party (NEGOP) The Nebraska Republican Party (NEGOP) is often asked, "What do you do?" While candidates are visibly campaigning--knocking on doors, speaking to voters, and raising funds with the urgency of an election deadline--the NEGOP operates tirelessly, year-round, to provide the essential framework that supports Republican candidates and elected officials. As the "middle man" in the party structure, the NEGOP bridges the gap between national leadership, state operations, and grassroots efforts. Our Role in the Republican Ecosystem At the top, President Donald J. Trump and Vice President JD Vance serve as the titular heads of the Republican Party, shaping its overall direction. The Republican National Committee (RNC) supports state parties like the NEGOP, which, in turn, empowers county parties. This interconnected structure ensures a unified effort to advance Republican values and elect candidates at all levels. The NEGOP is the backbone of this system in Nebraska, providing resources, strategy, and coordination to strengthen Republican campaigns. Unlike candidates with finite campaign cycles, our work is continuous, laying the groundwork for success in every election. Preparing for the 2026 Election Cycle As we head into the fall of 2025, the NEGOP is focused on preparing for the 2026 election cycle. Our efforts include: Recruiting Candidates: Identifying and supporting strong Republican candidates for local, state, and federal offices. Fundraising: Securing the financial resources necessary to fuel effective campaigns. Strategic Planning: Developing comprehensive plans to maximize support for all GOP candidates. Voter Engagement: Driving voter registration and Get-Out-the-Vote (GOTV) initiatives to boost turnout. Campaign Resources: Providing campaigns with free tools, such as walk apps and data access, to enhance outreach and efficiency. These efforts are designed to create a cohesive, well-supported network of Republican candidates who can compete and win. The Power of County Parties County parties are the grassroots heart of the NEGOP. They play a critical role by: Organizing local Republicans to build community and momentum. Recruiting candidates for local races, ensuring strong representation at every level. Serving as a vital feedback loop, relaying the concerns and priorities of Nebraska voters to the state party. Unity is Our Strength When the NEGOP, county parties, and candidates work together, we achieve our greatest success. Collaboration creates economies of scale, fosters synergy, and amplifies our impact, leading to more Republican victories. However, if we operate in silos, we risk inefficiency and missed opportunities. By uniting our efforts, sharing resources, and aligning our goals, the NEGOP ensures that Nebraska Republicans are positioned to win elections and advance our shared values. Together, we build a stronger, more effective party for the future. Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party | | | What's Happening: Voter Registration & Constitution Day This week, we celebrate two profoundly patriotic occasions: National Voter Registration Day and Constitution Day. subject: My cries will echo around the world like a battle cry
body:
We will never surrender. Ever.

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdhj3dhheveh99novkvpvkb9uubhcrhme22qqv18_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s9h68p34cjh2bs)
---
Friend, I want to thank you for loving my husband. For standing with us in the worst days of our lives. For praying. For mourning. For remembering. But now, _I need you to listen closely..._ **Because the evildoers who took Charlie 's life? They have NO idea what they have done. ** They didn't just try to silence a man...
They tried to silence his message -- a message of patriotism, of faith, and of God's merciful love. Instead, they ignited something even greater. **If they thought my husband 's mission was powerful before... ****_They have NO idea what they have just UNLEASHED._** **Not just across this country...**_**_But in me_**** _._**_ They have no idea the fire they've lit inside this wife. And to those listening across America... Let me be clear: The movement my husband built will not die.
**_I refuse to let that happen._** And I know all of us will refuse to let that happen, too. Charlie's mission will grow: Stronger. Bolder. Louder. Greater than ever. I shared these words publicly, from my heart -- just two days after I lost the love of my life.
[**I want you to watch. I want you to hear what Charlie meant to me. And I want you to hear what comes next:**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9s3m21ki9u4n5ljelf9ge1emoafis7k1q3lis7g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s9h68p34cjh2bs)

Peter, I wanted to reach out personally to share this news with you:
**I’m officially running for reelection as Governor of Minnesota, because our work to make our state the best place in America to live, work, and raise a family isn’t finished.**

---
I grew up in Butte, Nebraska – a town of 400 people. There were 24 kids in my high school class. Living in a small town, you learn early on what it means to look out for your neighbors and to serve others.
That call to service is what led me to enlist in the Army National Guard just two days after my 17th birthday. I was proud to wear the uniform of this country for the next 24 years.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/95305?refcode=em20250918-9437&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=9437%2E614464%2EXfCn-0)
My drive to serve others eventually set me on a new path: teaching. My wife Gwen and I met while teaching high school. Kids carry their whole lives with them into the classroom and Gwen and I got to know our students and see the obstacles they faced. **It was my experience as a teacher and my passion for education that led me to run for governor.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/95305?refcode=em20250918-9437&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=9437%2E614464%2EXfCn-0)
Serving as Governor of Minnesota has been the honor of my life, and I couldn’t be prouder of the progress we’ve won. From providing universal free school meals for students, to protecting reproductive freedom, and cutting taxes for the middle class, we’ve secured tangible results that Minnesotans can actually feel.
The values that inspired me to serve our country in uniform, become an educator, and run for governor are the same ones I still carry with me each day as I work for the people of Minnesota. I still believe in helping our neighbors, protecting our freedoms, and investing in the future for our next generation. And I believe that, despite Donald Trump and MAGA’s attempts to tear us apart, we are still all in this together.
**Right now, we have an opportunity to continue delivering progress for Minnesotans – but only if we hold onto this Governor seat.** That’s why I’m asking you to have my back today, Peter.
**[Would you split a donation between my campaign and Heartland Patriots? Thank you in advance for your support.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/95305?refcode=em20250918-9437&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=12&akid=9437%2E614464%2EXfCn-0)**
**[DONATE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/95305?refcode=em20250918-9437&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=13&akid=9437%2E614464%2EXfCn-0)**
I’ll be in touch soon,
Tim Walz

Derek, like many of us in Southeast Pennsylvania, I rely on SEPTA for my commute – from eastern Chester County to Philly where I pick up Amtrak to Washington, D.C.

**Over 1 million people use SEPTA every day – it’s the backbone of public transit in our region - which is why I’m grateful to our governor, Josh Shapiro, for stepping in to stop massive service cuts from becoming permanent.** This is just a two-year fix but it gives the state legislature – and all of us who rely on SEPTA – some breathing room to figure out a long-term solution.
As an engineer and entrepreneur, I know firsthand how important our infrastructure is – it helps people get to work and school, increases the vitality of our communities, helps businesses get the supplies they need and deliver their finished products faster, and creates more jobs and vital improvements across our region.

And as a strong advocate in Congress for U.S. Department of Transportation support for SEPTA and regional transportation networks like it around the country, I promise to always fight for funding, modernization, and expansion.**[Will you chip in $5 right now so that I can continue delivering on the issues that matter most to you, build on the momentum of wins like these, and help elect Democratic leaders who are willing to do what's best for our community?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115455308/570377775/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1175-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYTkwOTAyNy1hMDk0LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ozb6hKRQOv3oPbNfmJWsgYCwsX3B8iTTHwLkj-rvnhk=)**

And as a strong advocate in Congress for U.S. Department of Transportation support for SEPTA and regional transportation networks like it around the country, I promise to always fight for funding, modernization, and expansion.= If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Funding SEPTA is a major win for all of us here in PA-06, because now every commuter, student, and family who depends on it for transportation can get around our vibrant district. subject: Kirk’s voice is only getting louder

---
Peter, This week, I find myself experiencing both the fog of sadness _and_ greater clarity than I’ve had in some time. You may have shed tears this past weekend watching Erika Kirk, Charlie’s widow, give a truly powerful and emotional speech about her husband’s legacy. I know I did. Her words are particularly fitting to describe how this abhorrent shooter not only failed to silence Kirk’s voice _but actually amplified it tenfold._ **_“You have no idea the fire that you have ignited within this wife, the cries of this widow will echo around the world like a battle cry...They should all know this: if you thought that my husband's mission was powerful before you have no idea, you have no idea what you just have unleashed across this entire country and this world."_** Here at Common Sense Club, we’ve long believed that those who hold common sense beliefs are the _majority_. While the Left may have a monopoly on the cultural microphone, they aren’t resonating with everyday New Jerseyans. But the thing is, most Common Sense Americans are busy living their lives in common sense ways until some event awakens them to look around and say, ‘wait, what happened?’ In recent years, events both small and large have awakened us from our collective slumber. COVID-19 and 2020 were seismic. But if you weren’t awake yet – or if you’d grown complacent – the assassination of Charlie Kirk, one of the boldest, most unapologetic voices of our generation, has likely shaken you to your core. It has not only awakened silent members of the Common Sense Majority, but it has spurred us _all_ to grab the nearest microphone and plant our flag. And not just in defense of fiscal, immigration, or law enforcement policies that make sense, but in defense of faith, foundational values, and the family. It has been stunning how many individuals of all walks of life I’ve spoken to who share almost an identical sentiment about this man’s death: shock, grief, fire, and resolve. That is exactly the impact to which Charlie devoted his life, and so it’s fitting that this is the impact he is still having in death. As I’ve rewatched some of Charlie’s legendary university debates, podcast episodes and interviews this past week, I’ve been struck by the ease, clarity, and courage with which he communicated. His voice will not be replaced by one individual. He was a singular, once-in-a-lifetime figure. But, he can and _must_ be succeeded by a choir of voices, ignited by his courage, who will carry the truth into large and small arenas, online, in workplaces, schools, and communities. Let’s be among those voices. May Common Sense – _truth, really_ – be louder than ever through us. For New Jersey,

President

You may have shed tears this past weekend watching Erika Kirk, Charlie’s widow, give a truly powerful and emotional speech about her husband’s legacy. I know I did. Her words are particularly fitting to describe how this abhorrent shooter not only failed to silence Kirk’s voice but actually amplified it tenfold. “You have no idea the fire that you have ignited within this wife, the cries of this widow will echo around the world like a battle cry...They should all know this: if you thought that my husband's mission was powerful before you have no idea, you have no idea what you just have unleashed across this entire country and this world." Here at Common Sense Club, we’ve long believed that those who hold common sense beliefs are the majority. While the Left may have a monopoly on the cultural microphone, they aren’t resonating with everyday New Jerseyans. But the thing is, most Common Sense Americans are busy living their lives in common sense ways until some event awakens them to look around and say, ‘wait, what happened?’ In recent years, events both small and large have awakened us from our collective slumber. COVID-19 and 2020 were seismic. But if you weren’t awake yet – or if you’d grown complacent – the assassination of Charlie Kirk, one of the boldest, most unapologetic voices of our generation, has likely shaken you to your core. It has not only awakened silent members of the Common Sense Majority, but it has spurred us all to grab the nearest microphone and plant our flag. And not just in defense of fiscal, immigration, or law enforcement policies that make sense, but in defense of faith, foundational values, and the family. It has been stunning how many individuals of all walks of life I’ve spoken to who share almost an identical sentiment about this man’s death: shock, grief, fire, and resolve. That is exactly the impact to which Charlie devoted his life, and so it’s fitting that this is the impact he is still having in death. As I’ve rewatched some of Charlie’s legendary university debates, podcast episodes and interviews this past week, I’ve been struck by the ease, clarity, and courage with which he communicated. His voice will not be replaced by one individual. He was a singular, once-in-a-lifetime figure. But, he can and must be succeeded by a choir of voices, ignited by his courage, who will carry the truth into large and small arenas, online, in workplaces, schools, and communities. Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=091825_1&amount=25]
We're going to keep hammering this home, Team, because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever.
President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail.
For background: After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day.
So of course, this order directs Attorney General Pam Bondi to “take all necessary action” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day.
This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
We've got to keep fighting and work to protect our elections and our fundamental right to vote. Step up with $25 or whatever you can today and help us defend vote by mail across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=091825_1&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail.
Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure, mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ”
Opponents of voting rights have proven they'll go to any length necessary to stop people from voting and make sure that they stay in power. And today, MAGA billionaires just launched their surprise attack--in complete anonymity:

body:
We will never surrender. Ever.

Friend, I want to thank you for loving my husband. For standing with us in the worst days of our lives. For praying. For mourning. For remembering. But now, _I need you to listen closely..._ **Because the evildoers who took Charlie 's life? They have NO idea what they have done. ** They didn't just try to silence a man...
They tried to silence his message -- a message of patriotism, of faith, and of God's merciful love. Instead, they ignited something even greater. **If they thought my husband 's mission was powerful before... ****_They have NO idea what they have just UNLEASHED._** **Not just across this country...**_**_But in me_**** _._**_ They have no idea the fire they've lit inside this wife. And to those listening across America... Let me be clear: The movement my husband built will not die.
**_I refuse to let that happen._** And I know all of us will refuse to let that happen, too. Charlie's mission will grow: Stronger. Bolder. Louder. Greater than ever. I shared these words publicly, from my heart -- just two days after I lost the love of my life.
[**I want you to watch. I want you to hear what Charlie meant to me. And I want you to hear what comes next:**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zomgr25lc05293fcvc62mqn4d39ar4sal8hcp0qo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s9h64o32chh2bs)

#### e-newsletter (our 100th Edition!)

## Sept '25
---
|
* **Take a hike for loneliness**
* **County recognizes Recovery Happens & Suicide Prevention Month**
* **San Bruno remembers on 15th anniversary**

* **Passage of Senate Bill 63 puts Caltrain and SamTrans’ future in voters’ hands**

* **County rallies to support Proposition 50**

---
| | |
---
|
# “This is a stand against election rigging and a signal to the entire world that we here in the Golden State are ready to fight for democracy and fight against authoritarianism with every tool we have, including the ballot box.”
# **\- President David Canepa**
---
| | | | **2025 Sept e-newsletter** **Special 100 th Edition** **Thank you for subscribing to our monthly newsletters and for your invaluable feedback over the past 9 years. Here’s to 100 editions and to keeping you informed, inspired and connected to our office.** **County rallies to support Proposition 50** Dear friends, At its Sept. 9 meeting, the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors approved a resolution I sponsored, along with Supervisor Lisa Gauthier, supporting Proposition 50, the Election Rigging Response Act. This measure, on the 2026 ballot, would allow California voters to adopt new congressional district maps for elections between 2026 and 2030. Texas cannot silence California. Proposition 50 is a stand against election rigging and a declaration to the world that we in the Golden State will defend democracy and resist authoritarianism at the ballot box. If passed, new maps would be drawn by the Legislature in response to Texas’ mid-decade gerrymandering, which changed district boundaries to favor one party and threatens the balance of representation in Congress Special thanks to Sen. Josh Becker, Assemblymembers Marc Berman and Diane Papan, local elected leaders, and dozens of supporters who joined Supervisor Gauthier and me at the Sept. 8 rally at 500 County Center. **Passage of Senate Bill 63 puts Caltrain and SamTrans’ future in voters’ hands** The Legislature delivered a historic win for San Mateo County this past weekend by passing Senate Bill 63. With strong bipartisan support, SB 63 gives voters the chance in 2026 to approve a regional sales tax to sustain and improve public transit. As Legislation Committee Chair on the Metropolitan Transportation Commission, I’ve worked nearly two years to secure a fair deal for San Mateo County. Without new funding, Caltrain faces deep deficits that would force service cuts, strand riders, worsen traffic, and harm air quality—just when we most need greener options. Thanks to SB 63, the future looks brighter. A stable funding stream would keep Caltrain, SamTrans, BART, and other transit systems running and improving. I’m deeply grateful to bill authors Sen. Scott Wiener and Sen. Jesse Arreguin for their leadership in bringing this measure to voters, who deserve the final say.

**San Bruno remembers on 15th anniversary** San Bruno marked the 15th anniversary on Sept. 9 of the gas pipeline explosion and fire that killed eight and destroyed 38 homes in the Crestmoor neighborhood. KTVU reporters Jesse Gary and Betty Yu covered the remembrance of the nation’s worst public utility disaster. The story featured resident Rick Silverman, who recalled the night vividly, and Mayor Rico Medina, who spoke about progress since the blast and how a $70 million PG&E settlement funded a new community and aquatics center. “Because of that tragedy, the U.S., California, and communities across the nation changed how pipelines are installed and monitored,” I shared in the segment. The photo above, taken by my staff member Bill Silverfarb while working at the San Mateo Daily Journal, shows resident Fumie Tanaka being rescued by firefighters after fleeing her burning home and collapsing on Glenview Drive. It is a haunting image and a reminder of both tragedy and resilience. View the KTVU story here: [https://www.ktvu.com/news/san-bruno-continues-heal-15-years-after-deadly-pge-pipeline-explosion](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=33e31c7e4d&e=c0babbc643 "https://www.ktvu.com/news/san-bruno-continues-heal-15-years-after-deadly-pge-pipeline-explosion"). **County recognizes Recovery Happens & Suicide Prevention Month** At the Sept. 9 Board of Supervisors meeting, I sponsored a joint proclamation recognizing Suicide Prevention Month and Recovery Happens Month. Both observances are rooted in hope, healing, and the power of community. In 2024, 69 county residents died by suicide, while more than 13,000 reached out to our Crisis Line, showing both urgent need and the importance of support. This year’s Suicide Prevention theme, “Support, Your Way,” reminds us that everyone’s path is unique, and prevention is a shared responsibility. Recovery Happens Month highlights that recovery is real. Every day, people overcome mental health and substance use challenges with care that is inclusive, peer-supported, and culturally responsive. I was especially moved by Victor Barfield’s story. After battling addiction for 30 years and losing his marriage and job, Victor sought help through a local nonprofit. Now, reunited with his family, he serves as a Recovery Coach with Voices of Recovery San Mateo County. Special thanks to Dr. Jei Africa, Director of Behavioral Health and Recovery Services, for leading the presentation. [](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=0c8438c854&e=c0babbc643) **Take a hike for loneliness** Let’s hike together and turn loneliness into connection! Join us at 9 a.m., Saturday, Oct. 4 at Sawyer Camp Trail in San Mateo for Take a Hike for Loneliness, a community event bringing neighbors and friends together. San Mateo County was the first in the nation to declare loneliness a public health crisis in January 2024. Loneliness and suicide are both public health challenges that demand bold action. Sometimes the simplest acts, sharing a meal or walking with a neighbor, make the biggest difference. So, bring friends, enjoy nature, and meet new people as we stroll the trail with beautiful view of the Crystal Springs Reservoir. RSVP using the QR code or contact Mike Richardson at (650) 363-4572 or email to [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org "mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org"). Hope to see you there!

**Interns wanted to join our team ** We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=9e502af72b&e=c0babbc643 "https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9?fbclid=IwAR3YFH0mH828rtAUru5EFOO9GsMCasQYe1N7AUrmwAwBf30JTtXOSeCzKjs"). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org "mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org"). In friendship,
**DAVID J. CANEPA**
President, San Mateo County Board of Supervisors

name: Erika Kirk
subject: My cries will echo around the world like a battle cry
body:
We will never surrender. Ever.

| | | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zt7hnqj6estmskjn63t3qlntkl1udv02rln7dek8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s9h64p72cth2bs)
---
Friend, I want to thank you for loving my husband. For standing with us in the worst days of our lives. For praying. For mourning. For remembering. But now, _I need you to listen closely..._ **Because the evildoers who took Charlie 's life? They have NO idea what they have done. ** They didn't just try to silence a man...
They tried to silence his message -- a message of patriotism, of faith, and of God's merciful love. Instead, they ignited something even greater. **If they thought my husband 's mission was powerful before... ****_They have NO idea what they have just UNLEASHED._** **Not just across this country...**_**_But in me_**** _._**_ They have no idea the fire they've lit inside this wife. And to those listening across America... Let me be clear: The movement my husband built will not die.
**_I refuse to let that happen._** And I know all of us will refuse to let that happen, too. Charlie's mission will grow: Stronger. Bolder. Louder. Greater than ever. I shared these words publicly, from my heart -- just two days after I lost the love of my life.
[**I want you to watch. I want you to hear what Charlie meant to me. And I want you to hear what comes next:**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zoitjmamc949pm7d8h26dauvo27drr88138cl9rg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s9h64p72cth2bs)

---
Charlie gave everything for this country. And I will never stop speaking his name. We will not let the light he lit go out. Not now. Not ever. For Charlie,
---

---
Erika Kirk On behalf of the Turning Point USA Family

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol3zaxust5j2fn739qojmhcvus5o5mnsauwscmdtcl23xnmkp1j2bhtyierte6ve8z7n56c622l1ri71p4ifim01m5xeid85ih3znuh3cp0qo9p7jcyqgbsibp48r1df2z8uwrhmzmxv&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t2sjoi&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t2sjoi&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t2sjoi&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t2sjoi&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol3zaxust5j2fn739qojmhcvus5o5mnsauwscmdtcl23xnmkp1j2bhtyierte6ve8z7n56c622l1ri71p4ifim01m5xeid85ih3znuh3cp0qo9p7jcyqgbsibp48r1df2z8uwrhmzmxv&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t2sjoi&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t2sjoi&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Last week, Republicans introduced a censure resolution against me for demanding our government stop enabling war crimes.
**This week, they’ve introduced a censure resolution against my sister-in-service Ilhan Omar, along with a resolution seeking to kick her off of her committees—all because she spoke out against white supremacy.**
Republicans don’t bat an eye when their fascist President sends troops into Black-led cities or sends masked federal agents to snatch immigrants off our streets. They’re happy to rip healthcare and food away from vulnerable people, attack our trans neighbors, and continue to send weapons of war to Israel for the genocide against the Palestinian people.
**But, when women of color speak up about racism and call out violence against marginalized people, they police our words and attempt to censure us.**

body:
https://maxinefororegon.com/ [https://maxinefororegon.com/]
Peter,
With all the noise and chaos Donald Trump stirs up, he’s hoping you won’t notice he’s profiting off us getting sicker, hungrier, and poorer.
Starting soon, six states will launch a pilot program called the “Wasteful and Inappropriate Service Reduction Model.”
It’s a name that makes a lot of promises. In reality, this program will target people 65 and older on Medicare, contracting out their care to private companies.
It will force doctors through endless “prior authorizations” before they can get certain care for their patients. Treatments that used to be straightforward will now be buried under red tape and AI overreach. Doctors will have to jump through endless hoops before treating our loved ones.
And it gets worse: The less these private contractors approve, the more they’ll be paid. That means medical decisions will be driven by profit instead of patients.
Our seniors are not committing waste, fraud, and abuse—they’re trying to get the care they need and deserve.
As a physician and a member of the Congressional Doctors Caucus, Maxine Dexter knows firsthand what it means to fight for patients. She’s one of the only members of Congress who has actually treated people in exam rooms and at hospital bedsides . And in Washington, she’s been a consistent voice against efforts to restrict care—voting against the Big, Ugly Betrayal and every other scheme that puts profits over people.
While Donald Trump and his allies sell off Medicare to private contractors and AI-driven denials, Maxine is standing up for seniors and families.
If you believe health care decisions should be made by doctors and patients, not corporations looking to make a buck, then we need your help. Chip in whatever you can today to support Maxine’s fight to protect Medicare and make sure our health care works for people, not profiteers. | Dear Fellow American,

As a concerned citizen, I thought you'd appreciate this new [interactive election integrity map](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76659&L=36091&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL2ludDI1bmRlMDkzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycw==&hash=e3d1ab82338a01d46fccda9ffe281298730405e634ede8ca276058d908a000ed) our team created. It's an easy and informative way to see the election integrity victories our supporters have helped us achieve, state by state and also where we are fighting today!
I want to again _thank you for your interest in_ this critical work that is so essential to the preservation of our republic.
Judicial Watch's lawsuits fighting against the Left to ensure the honesty of American elections may well be our most important litigation...especially as we head into 2026.
It is an impressive record...cleaning voter rolls, supporting voter ID and other commonsense electoral safeguards, and challenging states that are violating federal law by "extending" Election Day!
None of what we have accomplished in the past and that we are doing today would be possible without your help and support.
Thank you again, for your interest in Judicial Watch’s work and mission!
Sincerely,
Thomas Fitton

subject: Charlie gave it all. We owe him this.
body:
Right now, Charlie would say, “Don’t you dare quit”

| | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e16380824/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90dXJuaW5nLXBvaW50LXVzYS8wMmFmM2I4Zi0wNjI3LTQ0ZDctOGU5NS05OWNkODgwNjk1ZmUv/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsa05CU3Y1Mw/qP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPVdBUlI3MDEzNyZ1dG1fdGVybT1XQVJSNzAxMzc/gaMwxoA/s5k1c690891)

Patriot
---
I don’t write emails like this often. But right now? After what happened to Charlie... _I can’t stay quiet._ **Charlie Kirk was my friend.** Not just someone I admired, but someone I loved and respected deeply. Losing him was devastating.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e16380824/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90dXJuaW5nLXBvaW50LXVzYS8wMmFmM2I4Zi0wNjI3LTQ0ZDctOGU5NS05OWNkODgwNjk1ZmUv/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsa05CU3Y1Mw/qP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPVdBUlI3MDEzNyZ1dG1fdGVybT1XQVJSNzAxMzc/gaMwxoA/s5k1c690891)
---
In many ways, all of us share in this loss. Charlie fought every day of his life for each one of us... fighting to keep America as great, free, and prosperous. No one I know ever fought for that harder than Charlie. America won't ever be the same. **No one can ever replace him — but we can make sure his legacy continues on.** _We owe him that._ Because if you knew Charlie, you would know exactly what he would say to us right now: _**"Don’t you dare quit."**_ Charlie poured his heart into building a movement to save America. He believed in young people. He believed in ordinary Americans. And he believed that even in our darkest hours, America was the beacon of goodness, freedom, and truth. That’s what the Turning Point movement was all about — and Charlie gave everything he had to that fight. **And our task now is not only to protect what he built — it’s to grow it bigger, stronger, and bolder than anyone ever thought possible.** More students. More churches. More families. More courage from everyday Americans to stand up and fight for what is right. Turning Point USA was Charlie’s vehicle to save America. **He didn’t just start a movement... _he started a revival._** And now, Patriot, we must carry that forward. If you share the same sense of responsibility that I do to honor Charlie’s work and press on with his vision... **_Then please join me in keeping his fight alive by making a gift to Turning Point USA today._** **[Let’s make Turning Point USA the biggest thing that this nation has ever seen... bigger than Charlie ever thought possible. Friends, we need to talk about the Supreme Court’s recent decision to allow discriminatory racial profiling in Trump’s immigration raids.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Here’s the background:
After ICE ramped up its cruel and aggressive tactics in Southern California, the ACLU sued Kristi Noem and DHS, arguing that ICE’s racial profiling violates the 4th Amendment.
The 4th Amendment protects everyone in this country — regardless of immigration status — from unreasonable search and seizure. The government can’t just arbitrarily detain people without probable cause.
A federal court issued a temporary restraining order (i.e. a pause) on ICE’s use of racial profiling while the suit is litigated. But the Trump Administration asked for a special exception, and last week, the Supreme Court used its emergency docket to grant it.
The emergency docket basically fast-tracks requests to bypass the lower court system and allows the Supreme Court to hand down decisions without hearing arguments — and without offering any explanation.
So what now? Well, with this Supreme Court decision, ICE has the green light to continue using the color of your skin, the language you speak or accent you speak with, your job, or even just where you happen to be at any given moment (seriously) as cause to detain you.
It should go without saying, but I’m going to say it loud and clear: This is wrong. It’s un-American, it’s discriminatory, it’s cruel, and it’s illegal.
So what now?
First of all, it’s critical that everyone knows their rights. The National Immigrant Justice Center has a great Know Your Rights section on their website [https://immigrantjustice.org/for-immigrants/know-your-rights/] with materials in several languages. Print these out, read them, and share them.
If you’re a citizen who feels safe, one of the most helpful things you can do is spread awareness about these rights. And if you witness ICE or CBP in public, you have the right to document what you see — from a safe distance. We’ve seen in countless videos this summer that ICE is not acting with restraint. They’re forcibly pulling people from cars, holding them at gun point, or shoving them to the ground. Safely documenting these actions can help.
It’s also valuable to share the stories of people who have been wrongfully targeted and detained by ICE. Public outrage *does* have the power to make a difference in policy — we’ve already seen it several times during this administration — so raising awareness and helping those around you understand the human impact of this cruel targeting is incredibly important.
Bottom line: the Supreme Court may have greenlit racial discrimination, but we don’t have to just stand by and accept it.
In Congress, I’ll keep demanding accountability — pressing DHS for answers, showing up at detention facilities, calling out ICE’s illegal tactics, and working on legislation to ensure our constitutional rights are upheld.
But I need you with me. It’s on all of us to push back by knowing our rights, standing up for our neighbors, and refusing to stay silent.
Thanks for reading,
Sara

body:
Hi Peter,
We’ve got only 4 days left to gather as many public comments as we can to keep the Endangerment Finding and the Environmental Protection Agency’s (EPA) vehicle standards intact. Our staff will be out tabling this weekend to collect more comments. Will you help them gather as much support for clean air as possible with a generous $20 contribution today? [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2]
Give $20 now [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2?am=20&amtOpts=&recurringAm=20&recurringAmtOpts=&is_optimized_ask=true&contactdata=JdUqdi1QuusAJwPOgJZK7/1+LpBrK2v7R4nKm2b39D0i4U8p6t678W5Ev2DraZKHIIajnSzqjzJIv3CsispxAGpm/mPJdpP5IRAL9czL0kxbip+j8ncf6t2k6Ep/xP9B]
With gratitude,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Sarah%20Signature.png]
Sarah Kline (she/they)
OLCV Communications & Membership Coordinator
P.S.: If you haven’t already taken action on this, send in your email here! [https://secure.everyaction.com/hEbNUE5J60izMdxOMcKbAQ2]
Hi Peter,
The Trump administration is attacking our climate once again, attempting to roll back the Endangerment Finding, which gives the EPA authority to regulate climate pollution. This change will undo standards that limit pollution from cars and trucks, power plants, and other sources of climate pollution, worsening the climate crisis and increasing the risk of severe health conditions like asthma and lung cancer. Put bluntly, they are trying to roll back the legal bedrock for climate action and in doing so will make all of us sicker, our air dirtier, and leave communities facing even more climate disasters.
The deadline for public comments on Trump’s Climate Chaos Plan is coming up on September 22nd and we need your help again! Will you make a generous contribution right now so we can safeguard our future and clean air before it’s too late? [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2]
Give now [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2?am=20&amtOpts=&recurringAm=20&recurringAmtOpts=&is_optimized_ask=true&contactdata=JdUqdi1QuusAJwPOgJZK7/1+LpBrK2v7R4nKm2b39D0i4U8p6t678W5Ev2DraZKHIIajnSzqjzJIv3CsispxAGpm/mPJdpP5IRAL9czL0kxbip+j8ncf6t2k6Ep/xP9B]

OLCV is fighting hard against the proposal to eliminate the Endangerment Finding, that authorizes the EPA to regulate climate pollution, as well as the additional proposal to roll back federal minimum vehicle standards for greenhouse gas emissions ( read more here [https://www.epa.gov/regulations-emissions-vehicles-and-engines/proposed-rule-reconsideration-2009-endangerment-finding] ). Our members alone have sent nearly 600 messages to the EPA.
But it still may not be enough. That’s why we need your gift now so we can double that number! Your support truly makes all the difference in this fight. [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2]
The clock is ticking – we need to get as many public comments against the proposal to eliminate the Endangerment Finding as we can! Can you give what you can now? [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2]
Give now [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2?am=20&amtOpts=&recurringAm=20&recurringAmtOpts=&is_optimized_ask=true&contactdata=JdUqdi1QuusAJwPOgJZK7/1+LpBrK2v7R4nKm2b39D0i4U8p6t678W5Ev2DraZKHIIajnSzqjzJIv3CsispxAGpm/mPJdpP5IRAL9czL0kxbip+j8ncf6t2k6Ep/xP9B]
These are all attacks we’ve seen before from the fossil fuel industry: from the uphill battle to pass a climate and justice focused transportation package, to the attack on Clean Vehicle Waivers and state-level vehicle emission standards. We’ve done this before, and we can do it again, but not without you.
It’s more important than ever that Oregon continues to lead on climate. We cannot let Trump's Climate Chaos Plan win. Make your gift now to fight for clean air, before it’s too late! [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2]
Thank you for your support,

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Breaking news, Peter:

Yesterday, a Louisiana immigration judge ordered Palestinian activist and
legal permanent U.S. resident Mahmoud Khalil to be deported to Syria or
Algeria.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em-20250918-mahmoud-khalil/?source=em20250918-37033&akid=37033%2E1203867%2EX21O0I ]Zeteo: Immigration Judge Orders Mahmoud Khalil to Be Deported to Syria
or Algeria. The Palestinian activist’s lawyers say he remains protected
for now by a federal judge’s previous order preventing his removal while
his case proceeds, writes @prem_thakker.

This comes after Mahmoud was abducted by ICE and detained for months,
forcing him to miss the birth of his firstborn child, all because of his
pro-Palestinian and anti-war protests on Columbia University’s campus.

Though Mahmoud didn’t commit a crime, the Louisiana judge is trying to
deport him and separate him from his family for allegedly filling out his
green card application incorrectly.

Thankfully, there is another court order protecting Mahmoud from
deportation while his legal case continues — but this is a disturbing
development and a sign that this authoritarian administration isn’t
letting up.

Trump’s regime is weaponizing the courts and relentlessly trying to make
an example out of Mahmoud and others in its crackdown on not just
pro-Palestinian speech and activity, but on seemingly any political
dissent.

# Iryna Zarutska murderer is indicted on first degree murder charge
A grand jury **[indicted career criminal](https://substack.com/redirect/23cb0c99-13ae-4140-84fb-a3c96136e535?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/23cb0c99-13ae-4140-84fb-a3c96136e535?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Decarlos Dejuan Brown Jr. on first-degree murder charges for randomly stabbing Ukrainian refugee Iryna Zarutska to death on a light rail train last month, as a wave of assaults and robberies now grips the city's transit system.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/23cb0c99-13ae-4140-84fb-a3c96136e535?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **Victim's Tragic Escape Shattered** Zarutska who was fleeing Ukraine's war, worked at a pizzeria and studied English before the fatal random attack on her way home.
* **Mental Evaluation Delays Trial** The court ordered a 60-day assessment for Brown's competency with his next hearing set for October 16.
* **Security Surge Addresses Attacks** Charlotte Mayor Lyles has deployed 30 extra guards on the Blue Line after a surge in violent incidents including bites, beatings, and armed robberies since late August.

# Elon calls for the release of suppressed Austin Metcalf surveillance video after Iryna Zarutska murder
Nearly five months after 17-year-old track star **[Austin Metcalf was fatally stabbed](https://substack.com/redirect/15537cd5-7d7d-4fa0-b54c-03c96826721a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at a Texas high school meet, the release of Iryna Zarutska's train attack video has ignited fresh fury, with **[Elon Musk demanding authorities](https://substack.com/redirect/b0012700-a352-4717-9920-a2a885fe8020?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** unveil the withheld surveillance footage of the teen's killing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b0012700-a352-4717-9920-a2a885fe8020?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Victim's Fatal Altercation Detailed** : On April 2, Austin Metcalf confronted Karmelo Anthony over a team tent during a rain delay at Frisco's track championship, leading Anthony to allegedly stab him fatally.
* **Suspect's Legal Status Updated** : Eighteen-year-old Karmelo Anthony faces first-degree murder charges, posted $250,000 bond after an initial $1 million set, and awaits trial on June 1, 2026, under home confinement.
* **Footage Withholding Explained** : Frisco school district halted public access after viewers violated protocols by livestreaming sessions and exposing stadium security cameras, prioritizing student privacy amid ongoing Texas Attorney General review.
* **Musk's Call Fuels Momentum** : Elon Musk's X post urging video release propelled the issue to trend online, drawing parallels to transparent handling of the recent Charlotte train stabbing footage of Iryna Zarutska and amplifying demands for accountability.

# Charlie Kirk's social empire explodes in popularity in the wake of assassination
In the week following conservative activist Charlie Kirk's shocking assassination, his **[social media empire exploded](https://substack.com/redirect/7f65ec78-c793-4ad0-bbb6-edef9e9752c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with millions of new followers and subscribers across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, amplifying Turning Point USA's reach and raking in estimated YouTube earnings of $1.38 million.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7f65ec78-c793-4ad0-bbb6-edef9e9752c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **YouTube Subscribers Skyrocket Dramatically** : Kirk's personal channel jumped from 3.8 million to 5 million subscribers, while TPUSA's grew to 3.9 million, boosting weekly video views by 94.1 million.
* **Instagram Followers Nearly Double Overnight** : Kirk's main account added 5.6 million followers, reaching 12.5 million total, expanding his influence among younger conservative audiences.
* **TikTok Engagement Bursts Forward** : **["The Charlie Kirk Show"](https://substack.com/redirect/d5d77282-f963-4288-a7dc-eb5fe3374af5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** account gained 2 million followers with 49.7 million additional likes, as Kirk's personal clips channel added 1.2 million.
* **Facebook and Beyond See Massive Uptick** : **[Kirk's page](https://substack.com/redirect/3d444dd7-50fe-48d6-95ec-6def0bde9f7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** surged by 3.4 million followers, alongside top Amazon book rankings and his podcast hitting No. 1 in key categories.

# Cracker Barrel CEO confesses to investors on disastrous earnings call
In a **[stunning admission](https://substack.com/redirect/3dd1ef6b-be82-4984-a8b4-60425fbefdb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during Cracker Barrel's latest earnings call, CEO Julie Masino confessed to underestimating customers' fierce loyalty to the chain's nostalgic logo, triggering an 8% traffic plunge and a 10% stock nosedive after reversing the controversial modern redesign.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3dd1ef6b-be82-4984-a8b4-60425fbefdb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Revenue Dips Sharply** : Total quarterly revenue fell 2.9% to $868 million year-over-year, exacerbated by backlash against the August text-only logo rollout that erased over $140 million in market value.
* **Remodel Plans Scrapped** : Only four of 660 locations underwent modern store updates before the company abandoned them, opting to restore traditional Americana decor amid guest outcry.
* **Nostalgia Marketing Surge** : New campaigns now spotlight "Uncle Herschel" iconography across ads and social media, boosting loyalty program by 300,000 members in recent weeks.
* **Optimistic Path Ahead** : Masino emphasizes renewed focus on food quality and guest experience in multi-year strategy, signaling confidence in reclaiming positive growth trajectory.

# Powell has difficult road ahead after quarter percent cut to rates
Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell **[warned Wednesday](https://substack.com/redirect/d51ac70d-44cf-42c7-bbe0-084909a0bdff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that there's no easy way forward in the economy, as the central bank navigates clashing goals of curbing inflation and bolstering a weakening job market amid recent policy easing.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5c87e9ea-8690-4e43-be20-15c4e43041fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Dual Mandate Tension Emerges** : Powell described the Fed's inflation and employment goals as unusually at odds, requiring careful weighing of distances to targets and timelines for achievement.
* **Labor Market Signals Weakness** : Recent data shows slowing job growth and rising unemployment, prompting the Fed to shift from a restrictive stance for the first time since December.
* **Rate Cuts Gain Momentum** : Policymakers now project two additional quarter-point reductions this year, up from June estimates, although the the board of governors remain split on future forcasts.
* **Independence Faces Scrutiny** : Amid political pressures, Powell stressed that voter influence on the Fed works only through persuasion, not direct control, to maintain policy autonomy.

I led troops in combat overseas--never in my life did I think I'd have to fight to keep our military from being used against our own people here at home. I'm running for Congress to stop her, defend our Constitution, and make sure our military is never turned into a political weapon. subject: I’m reaching out on behalf of my friend Wes Moore
body:
Hey Peter, it’s Senator Cory Booker.
Today, I’m reaching out on behalf of my friend Wes Moore, who just launched his reelection campaign for Governor.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250918-1?refcode=em-20250918-1&refcode2=639_1086043_r6pKb9&akid=639%2E1086043%2Er6pKb9)
At a time when Donald Trump and Republicans in Congress are stoking fear and division, ordinary Americans are struggling. **That’s why it’s so important to keep Democratic governors like Wes fighting for the people.**
**Will you join me in supporting his reelection campaign today? Here’s a direct link to chip in:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250918-1?refcode=em-20250918-1](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250918-1?refcode=em-20250918-1&refcode2=639_1086043_r6pKb9&akid=639%2E1086043%2Er6pKb9)**
Wes has been on a mission for Maryland. He has led historic funding of public schools. Invested in public safety. Stood up for federal workers impacted by the Trump administration’s reckless cuts.
And when disaster struck and the collapse of the Francis Scott Key bridge closed the Port of Baltimore, he led the way in reopening it in just _11 weeks._
Wes is fighting to leave no one behind — and I’m proud to support him in that work. But Donald Trump and his fellow Republicans are attacking Wes day in and day out to try to stop him. Wes needs all of us to come together to succeed in 2026.
**[So Peter, if you can, please chip in to Wes Moore’s reelection campaign today to help him fight back against Republicans and stand up for the people.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250918-1?refcode=em-20250918-1&refcode2=639_1086043_r6pKb9&akid=639%2E1086043%2Er6pKb9)**

With love and gratitude,
Cory Booker
U.S. Senator from New Jersey

By Illinois Review

A Chicagoland family’s Starbucks run went viral after their order of Charlie Kirk’s favorite drink was handed back with the word “Loser” scrawled on the cup – prompting the multinational coffeehouse chain to issue a public statement and shut down the store for the day.

In a post on X accompanied by a video, Jacqueline Garretson wrote, “My [mother-in-law] ordered Charlie Kirk’s favorite Starbucks drink (Mint Majesty + honey) – but the cup came back with ‘Loser’ written on it.”

clean_body: What to know about the Fiscal Year 2026 National Defense Authorization Act | | | | Last week, the House of Representatives passed the Fiscal Year 2026 National Defense Authorization Act (FY26 NDAA). It's a massive bill that sets defense policy and future funding levels for our own Department of Defense. = = Rick co-authored an amendment for the FY26 NDAA that would help Island Health Hospital in Anacortes receive significant cost savings. Island Health serves a significant number of local servicemembers, and Rick's amendment would help the hospital maintain current services. Unfortunately, the Chaos Caucus is uninterested in helping the people of Skagit County, and the amendment did not pass. But our fight does not stop here. Rick is continuing to work on improving health care access in Anacortes and the broader region. Ultimately, Rick voted "no" on the House-passed NDAA. He opposed the NDAA because his Republican colleagues turned a bipartisan bill into extremist legislation targeting healthcare for servicemembers, their kids, and the LGBTQI+ community. Even under the attacks of this administration, Rick continues to speak out for the values of Northwest Washington.
