subject: Charlie Kirk: A life of faith. A legacy that endures.
body:
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.

http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t2sou2&__onlt=t

Friend,

Charlie Kirk didn’t just live a full life...

He showed us what it meant to live boldly, love deeply, and lead with truth.

With every ounce of his strength, he worked tirelessly to wake up a generation... To tell the truth... To save our country... And, above all, to point people back to God.

And in the end — Charlie gave it all.

No one can replace him. But all of us can carry forward with what he started.

Friend, we want to give you a glimpse into the legacy he left behind — and the calling that now belongs to us.

We made this tribute to honor the man who gave everything... And to remind the world that his mission will press on:

http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t2sou2&__onlt=t

Watch Our Tribute to Charlie Here
http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t2sou2&__onlt=t

All of us will miss Charlie. None of us will ever forget him.

For Charlie,

- The Turning Point USA Family

body:
My friend Deb is an unapologetic fighter for the rights, freedoms, and futures of working people.
Hi — Tom Udall here.
I had the honor of serving New Mexico as your Congressman and as U.S. Senator for many years, so I know firsthand what it takes to lead New Mexico. That’s why **I’m deeply proud to endorse my friend Deb Haaland to be our next Governor.** She has the compassion, toughness, vision, and experience we need right now.
I’m reaching out to you personally to ask if you’ll join me in supporting Deb right now by **[making a $5 donation to her campaign.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250918_1_udall?amount=5&refcode=em20250918-4500&refcode2=4500_400544_6Hp8Mi&akid=4500%2E400544%2E6Hp8Mi)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250918_1_udall?amount=5&refcode=em20250918-4500&refcode2=4500_400544_6Hp8Mi&akid=4500%2E400544%2E6Hp8Mi)**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250918_1_udall?amount=5&refcode=em20250918-4500&refcode2=4500_400544_6Hp8Mi&akid=4500%2E400544%2E6Hp8Mi)
I had the chance to work alongside Deb in Congress, where she made history as one of the first Native women elected to the House. I saw her fight tirelessly for the rights and futures of working people in New Mexico.
Together, arm in arm, we worked to protect America’s lands and waters. Deb understands the urgent need for conservation—to safeguard public lands, wildlife, and address the threat of climate change. She’s built a reputation as a leader who listens, brings people together, and delivers results—strengthening our economy, supporting families, and protecting New Mexico’s natural resources.
Which is why for the first time I am endorsing a candidate in a gubernatorial primary – _the stakes are too high._ We need a strong Governor who has our backs and whose focus has never strayed from championing working families, healthcare, protecting our natural treasures, and keeping our public lands out of private hands.
**The truth is: Deb is the only candidate running in this race who will be ready to stand up to the Trump Administration on Day 1.**
**[I’m throwing 100% of my support behind Deb Haaland in her campaign to be the next Governor of New Mexico. Will you please join me by contributing $5 or any amount you can right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250918_1_udall?amount=5&refcode=em20250918-4500&refcode2=4500_400544_6Hp8Mi&akid=4500%2E400544%2E6Hp8Mi)**
I know how much Deb appreciates your support.
Yours in the fight,
Ambassador Tom Udall (Ret.)
New Zealand
Former U.S. Senator for New Mexico

Jason Crow For Colorado [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/Screenshot%202025-08-21%20at%2010.50.41%E2%80%AFAM.png]
Friend,

It is an honor to represent and work for Coloradans in Congress. But in all honesty, running for Congress was never about me. It was about us.

As a community, we were tired of partisan politics. For nearly a decade, the GOP incumbent in Colorado’s 6th District was too busy raking in thousands from the NRA and supporting Donald Trump’s far-right agenda to care about the issues impacting Coloradans most.

We needed real representation.

We deserved a new generation of leadership in Congress.

So together, we did the unthinkable. Voters in CO-06 flipped the district blue and elected a Democratic representative for the first time in history.

That’s no small feat — and it certainly couldn’t have been done by just one person. It took all of us, knocking on thousands of doors, putting up hundreds of yard signs, and chipping in a few dollars at a time to emails like this one, that made the difference.

I’m writing all of this because now, more than ever, Americans are ready for a new generation of Democratic leaders who will stand up to wannabe dictators like Trump and his MAGA allies in Congress who prioritize profits over people.

I don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, so our campaign is counting on your support to get ahead these last few weeks.

subject: Free speech is under attack. We must fight back.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
Trump and his allies are scared. So they are trying to silence their opposition — us.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=2422%2E582294%2EhIkfuQ)
I wanted to write you a personal note about an alarming attack on free speech.
The FCC, which is controlled by Trump’s appointees, pressured ABC affiliates to remove _Jimmy Kimmel Live!_ from the air. ABC caved to the Trump Administration and suspended his show entirely.
**This should raise alarm bells for everyone in this country.**
Meanwhile Trump is restricting major news organizations’ access to press briefings and has replaced their dedicated offices in the Pentagon with those for the likes of The Daily Caller and Breitbart.
**When those in power seek to silence any voices that disagree with them, it is a threat to the First Amendment freedoms we in New Hampshire and people across America hold dear. We have not seen this level of censorship since the McCarthy era.**
**This is not how our democracy should work.**
I took an oath to uphold the Constitution — and that includes defending the First Amendment, which protects our rights to free speech and protest. Donald Trump and his allies cannot be allowed to bulldoze our freedoms and bully Americans into silence.
We need to act now to make sure he can’t. That means flipping the Senate, defending our rights and freedoms, and ensuring that our democracy — which only survives while we have free and vigorous debate — can live on.
[**Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can today to help us fight back before it’s too late?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_20250918_1_kimmel?refcode=em20250918-2422&amount=5&refcode2=2422_582294_hIkfuQ&akid=2422%2E582294%2EhIkfuQ)

This campaign is about more than politics — it’s about protecting the rights and freedoms that define who we are as Americans. **With your help, we will flip the Senate and provide a crucial check on this administration’s power.**
Let’s stand together in this moment,
Chris

But now, _I need you to listen closely..._ **Because the evildoers who took Charlie 's life? They have NO idea what they have done. ** They didn't just try to silence a man...
They tried to silence his message -- a message of patriotism, of faith, and of God's merciful love. Instead, they ignited something even greater. **If they thought my husband 's mission was powerful before... ****_They have NO idea what they have just UNLEASHED._** **Not just across this country...**_**_But in me_**** _._**_ They have no idea the fire they've lit inside this wife. | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115474003/570437291/1082117603?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_PathForward_250918_T1_1_a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YmQ4MzJjZS1iZDk0LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yzlP30-_Sqnp_mDv4DIvC6XbHY7JSlEuydUyFtkmzgQ=) Derek,

I think we can all agree: the last few weeks have been incredibly challenging for our country.

**It’s time to turn down the temperature, come together as a country, and start getting things done.**

Today I’m calling on my colleagues and this administration to join me in charting a better path forward. That starts with:
* **Extending the Obamacare tax credits _now_** – rather than let health care premiums rise 75% for Americans who get their coverage from the Obamacare marketplace. Donald Trump got elected on the promise of bringing down prices for Americans, and I don’t think _anyone_ wants to see the cost of health care go up.

We can’t afford to be silent. If Trump and his allies think they can dictate which voices are heard in America, then we will have to raise ours louder than ever.

subject: Stand with Jimmy Kimmel

body:
As a Senator, I am standing with every American who believes in free speech, dissent and accountability.
Our First Amendment rights are under attack. ABC just suspended _Jimmy Kimmel Live!_ at the Trump administration’s demand. Various ABC-affiliated stations dropped the show, and the FCC chair threatened regulatory consequences for ABC for refusing to penalize speech he didn’t like. **This is not just about one show.** CBS canceled _The Late Show_ after Stephen Colbert called out their $16 million settlement with Trump, and Trump has sued several other media organizations for criticizing him. It sets a dangerous precedent when media companies are pressured into silencing critical voices. When the president decides what is and is not permissible speech, our democracy gets weaker. As a U.S. Senator, I am standing with every American who believes in free speech, dissent and accountability. The Trump administration’s war on the First Amendment is an attack on the foundation of our democracy. **That’s why I’m calling on you to join me in demanding action.** [**_Will you add your name now to stand with Jimmy Kimmel and defend the First Amendment?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115474149/570437699/723906385?refcode=LOC_EM_PET_2025.09.18_Kimmel_B1_F1_S1_C1_45AC_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhODUzOTgzMS1iZTk0LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0-lnv-MVlt_0iY1CLjw0TsosoRSPnFyjE4MQZo6oDEI=&emci=37f4b08a-ab94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=a8539831-be94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=7659029) | | [ADD YOUR NAME >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115474150/570437700/723906385?refcode=LOC_EM_PET_2025.09.18_Kimmel_B1_F1_S1_C1_45AC_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhODUzOTgzMS1iZTk0LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0-lnv-MVlt_0iY1CLjw0TsosoRSPnFyjE4MQZo6oDEI=&emci=37f4b08a-ab94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=a8539831-be94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=7659029)

Donald Trump is attempting to disenfranchise voters in a blatantly illegal power grab — and California is fighting back.

I won’t stand by while our rights are trampled on — I will fight like hell in court to stop him, and I’m grateful to have you by my side while I do it.

subject: What's the deal with Democratic socialism?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Since Alexandria was first elected, a lot of people have worked overtime to fear-monger about Democratic socialism. **Do you know what it means?**
It means we value the integrity of our democracy and society over the love of capital — which is what we have right now.
This week, **a new poll shows that 74% of Democrats prefer Democratic socialism over capitalism** :
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250918.nfdx8D&refcode=em20250918-9776-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9776%2E2526796%2EuPC0jR)
The poll shows that even 58% of Republicans agree that our economic system is “rigged in favor of corporations and the wealthy.”1
It seems more and more people agree: in the wealthiest nation in the history of the world, when a person gets sick, they shouldn’t go bankrupt.
**Common sense**.
That a minimum wage should cover the minimum cost to live. Common sense.
**People like to paint Alexandria as extreme, but the reality is that we’re fighting to protect what should be basic rights — things like healthcare and voting**.
[Will you make a $5 contribution today to power Alexandria’s fight?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250918.nfdx8D&refcode=em20250918-9776-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9776%2E2526796%2EuPC0jR)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250918.nfdx8D&refcode=em20250918-9776-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=9776%2E2526796%2EuPC0jR)**
Although Alexandria is a Democrat, your support allows her to operate independently from either party’s establishment or the influence of corporate donors.
She doesn’t believe in the extreme pursuit of profit at any and all human or environmental cost. She believes in guaranteed healthcare for all and tackling the climate crisis with a much more serious mobilization than what we’re doing now.

clean_body: Since Alexandria was first elected, a lot of people have worked overtime to fear-monger about Democratic socialism. Do you know what it means? It means we value the integrity of our democracy and society over the love of capital — which is what we have right now. This week, a new poll shows that 74% of Democrats prefer Democratic socialism over capitalism : The poll shows that even 58% of Republicans agree that our economic system is “rigged in favor of corporations and the wealthy.”1 It seems more and more people agree: in the wealthiest nation in the history of the world, when a person gets sick, they shouldn’t go bankrupt. Common sense. That a minimum wage should cover the minimum cost to live. Common sense. People like to paint Alexandria as extreme, but the reality is that we’re fighting to protect what should be basic rights — things like healthcare and voting. Although Alexandria is a Democrat, your support allows her to operate independently from either party’s establishment or the influence of corporate donors. She doesn’t believe in the extreme pursuit of profit at any and all human or environmental cost. She believes in guaranteed healthcare for all and tackling the climate crisis with a much more serious mobilization than what we’re doing now. Whether or not you can contribute today, thank you for standing with this movement in our fight for economic justice for all. name: Sarah McBride
subject: We are not as divided as the internet algorithms make it seem.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
Sarah here.
#
Sarah here.
The news is heavy right now, so I thought I’d reach out with a message that gives me hope:
**We are _not_ as divided as the internet algorithms make it seem.**
One of the blessings of public service is that I get to engage with Americans of all political backgrounds.
Yes, real disagreements exist and yes, politics can bring out the worst in all of us – but I truly believe most people are decent and kind.
**When we give up on each other, we give up on democracy.** That’s why I’ll never stop fighting – for you, for Delaware, or for our democracy.

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8987%2E5257348%2EZ8nMZg ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek —

Soon, government funding will run out, which means that if there is no
agreement between Democrats and Republicans on a spending bill, the
government will shut down.

Now, maybe that's what the Republicans want. Maybe they want to shut it
all down. After all, they've been shutting down the government every day.
Already, the GOP is impounding funds that we have approved on a bipartisan
basis. They're withholding these funds in violation of the law.

Derek, let me
tell you a little bit about what is at stake. When the negotiations take
place — if they happen at all — they're taking place at a time when
millions of Americans are poised to lose access to health care.

This is due to a number of causes. We're gonna lose health care because of
massive cuts Republicans are making to the VA and its staff, cuts they're
making at the National Institute of Health, and the removal of expert
scientists and researchers at the CDC.

But most significantly, in the GOP’s Big, Ugly Bill, they made a trillion
dollars of cuts to Medicaid and the ACA. As a result, millions of people
are gonna lose access to health care completely, and millions more are
going to pay premium increases of up to 75 percent.

Derek, I will
not agree to a budget that continues these types of cuts and premium
increases to health care.

Republicans have already said they won’t honor any budget we would agree
to, and they plan to renege on it. That cannot happen. There must be a
mechanism to protect against the continuing illegal use or non-use of
government funding.

And if they want my vote for a funding bill, they’re going to have to
agree to restore health care for people who are going to be losing it by
the millions. They’re going to have to agree to reduce the cost of
healthcare insurance.

Instead of having 75% healthcare costs imposed on the American people,
they're going to have to agree to end the use of federal government money
for lawless, corrupt purposes. Taxpayer dollars shouldn’t be paying for
Trump-branded propaganda.

| | September 18, 2025
The assassination of Charlie Kirk has struck a chord across the country. For those of us who have followed the evolution of the New Left and the machinations of ANTIFA since the 1960s, this is a day we each feared would arrive. They've caused more than enough violence and disruption, and threaten the very existence of our Constitutional Republic. It seems President Trump realizes the threat and is about to address it. I recount their sordid history, and made the case today in an article published in [The Connecticut Centinal](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e5imfNCzqTKGQljUUQ8Ffm21wFELQ5nBxZm8a6jcQ59Uu9MOFtGXybEmh5HlIaWs5qx5-zhLqv22lL0HsPJPd1pNrbXs1JOslryT8ApBzjaJMO138U_A_I6PwLnfAa2z1prRkwcvphj_gE8G2yPmmu6cp_mzt64yfC7l5p6DZgyzVF_qcMa9RrVdbg5Pkp7xSomXTdhKCB4=&c=QOYuNKemrxEVO9iYPI2n8gCUcDMORXtVBREmySy2VHKYOHhVSTk3kg==&ch=27soPdvRvzSpl9R9WHqu16UruOQTGNMpJE0SPgo0iEQ9Y47TYSb0Cw==). The article also appears below:
It's Time to Roll-Up ANTIFA
* After six decades, its culture of violence has boiled over

By Bob MacGuffie
ANTIFA in America is a group widely misunderstood, and that is by design - their design. Decoded it means Anti-Fascist. It got rolling in Germany in the early 1930s, and was affiliated with the German Communists, which Hitler hated and therefor disbanded them, and expelled ANTIFA and the Communists from Germany.
---
|
---
A solid cadre of them crossed the pond and alighted in some of America's finest universities, most prominently and infamously - Columbia University in NYC. Once WWII was over, they kicked into gear, proselytizing and indoctrinating the "flower" of America's post-WWII youth. Their intellectual progeny of the '50s then, in turn, became the professors in the colleges and universities, particularly of the major cities in the '60s. Those a bit less "intellectual" moved into the grimier endeavors of community organizing and street activism. These people are straight-up Communists, secular socialists with power being absolute with no opposition tolerated, especially the religious brand. There is no belief in natural rights - only those which they choose to dispense. They believe America is an illegitimate country, built on the backs of slaves, racist to its very core where common citizens, especially those of color, have no chance at a decent life. They have, long ago, been agitated into a perpetual state of hatred of everything traditionally American. They use the moniker 'anti-fascist' to keep you confused as to their intentions. But make no mistake - they are a global Communist movement, which for decades have been breaking up private meetings, public rallies, destroying and burning property, beating-up and often murdering innocent people. The images and aftermath are familiar to us all. Their first successful nationwide project was instigating and directing the campus anti-Vietnam war rallies, riots and confrontations. By the end of the '60s, the American Left operating through the universities and media, and ANTIFA operating in the streets had successfully divided the country, stoking the atmosphere within which several infamous political assassinations occurred. Next, they grafted themselves onto the Feminist movement to the extent they could, always instigating confrontation. After that was the Gay Rights movement, where the movement took to the streets, resulting in many injuries and arrests over the years. The ANTIFA playbook is to align with the grievance-group of the day, exacerbate the situation and instigate public violence whenever possible, sow division.... and simply move on to the next opportunity. During this period, we would also see their street-theatre and violence on display at the annual meetings of the World Trade Organization (WTO). Their objective is to take down our society into ruin so they can seize power in the aftermath. Twenty years ago, they added fuel to the fire of anti-Iraq protests during the Bush administration with the objective of defeating his reelection, and when that failed, they salted the political ground over which the 2008 election was run. The Iraq protests immediately stopped upon the ascension of Barack Obama. Finally, it was the rise of the Tea Party, organically assembling in massive numbers in the streets, which formed a powerful counter-narrative to the America-hating Leftists of all stripes. In their sordid history they had never been challenged so powerfully, effectively, and peacefully in the streets. In a sense, the street-Left had finally met its match. The Tea Party was on the march, positively influencing elections and the Left had nothing to graft onto, so for the first time they had to completely fabricate a group and the façade of a "movement" - enter Occupy Wall Street (OWS). They ran some marches, made some news, and camped in the parks of lower Manhattan. Because they were pure Astro-turf, they fizzled in a year. Then, again seeking out a situation to exacerbate, they alighted on the Trayvon Martin case in Sanford, Florida. Problem was that as the facts developed, they went entirely against the Leftist arguments. However, a new vehicle to ride was born of the affair - Black Lives Matter (BLM). BLM was launched by three women - their Marxist allegiances were clearly stated on its website... for a while. BLM provided the Left the opportunity to deploy both the "intellectual" front through the culture preaching about both systemic and implicit racism in schools, churches, and local public forums. And, deploy ANTIFA in the streets, burning Fergusson, MO on national TV. Then came the George Floyd incident in 2020 - Minneapolis and a dozen other cities burned, and many citizens died in the action. All over a fraudulent tale. George Floyd was a convicted criminal who died of a fentanyl overdose. The entire affair was the biggest fraud played on the country in at least a half-century. Yet that despicable human being is venerated by the Left, and the naive, today. This brings us up to the current climate and recent events. In the past several years ANTIFA has wrapped its tentacles around the Trans movement, and has apparently radicalized and militarized a segment. There have been many shootings in recent years perpetrated by radicalized Trans-activists. See a summary of just some of these here: [Trans shootings](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e5imfNCzqTKGQljUUQ8Ffm21wFELQ5nBxZm8a6jcQ59Uu9MOFtGXybEmh5HlIaWs06y5rvzZfVUHuOPXqbQAjYpALECR_9S26yYf0cmspEt--SQfaD455jgfuq1tiaupjV0NZbN2mVukbiqOF4FUVf8SFFrXO3h8wsW0caqMVTm0ces0PQr057cFNNkGmPfX__pfqTQjHz4oBKbwLYhLvWx4e0JUDuzVeulKbGHD738RBepnSzAS1EMTbnlEu4ZV&c=QOYuNKemrxEVO9iYPI2n8gCUcDMORXtVBREmySy2VHKYOHhVSTk3kg==&ch=27soPdvRvzSpl9R9WHqu16UruOQTGNMpJE0SPgo0iEQ9Y47TYSb0Cw==). The most recent was the August 27th shooting at the Annunciation Catholic School in Minneapolis, where a Trans woman killed two children and wounded 17 others. Although the shootings get covered in mainstream press, when it's revealed the shooter was Trans, as in the Annunciation school case, coverage quickly evaporates. In recent years, President Trump's Administrations and official team throughout the past decade, plus his MAGA supporters have been subject to a relentless sequence of lawfare, investigations, arrests, imprisonment, physical attacks, murders, doxing, swatting, de-banking, firing, career-destruction, de-platforming, cancelling, libel, slander, and every imaginable form of public intimidation. This has all been conceived and directed by the agenda-setters of the organized American Left. All the formal efforts have been executed through its arms of institutional influence in government, courts, the military, academia, corporations, NGOs, and non-profits. All the dirty-work on the streets is run through ANTIFA, its various chapters, and its many shadowy related violent, loosely-affiliated groups. They advocate "direct-action", which is weak code words for violence. They employ many of the Molotov and firebombing techniques from the European playbook, where they've been tried and tested over the past century. This network of subversion has no headquarters - neither physical, nor virtual - all by design, of course. But were the American public to see the communications, resources, people and financial exchanges between the thousands of academic, government, NGO, non-profit, and paramilitary organizations, they would be completely aghast. And it's all financed through vast, camouflaged financial channels leading back to, no-surprise, the labyrinth of George Soros organizations, and his like-minded financial peers. Soros gets some 'publicity' for it because he is the only one willing to be seen and acknowledge his clearly Marxist political ideology. We are left to deduce that he is beyond the reach of law, because he has the enforcement arm fixed. Hundreds of millions of dollars are funneled ANNUALLY through his subversive network, which by its nature continually seeks to avoid detection. Soros is occasionally referenced as a funder of dark networks in the press and on cable media. There was once a cable host, Glenn Beck, who in 2011 on repeated episodes on FNC, accurately outlined Soros' dark funding network in critical detail on large blackboard diagrams. In short order, the Murdock family (Fox's owners) was suddenly personally embroiled in a London court case charging their London-based newspaper empire with illegally hacking into private voicemails. Glenn Beck was quickly sent packing from the Fox network. Which brings us up to the Charlie Kirk assassination. Kirk was arguably one of the top five Patriot leaders in the country. He was the first person in 80 years to effectively lead America's youth to the political Right, en masse. The organized American Left simply could not stand for the exodus. They saw to it that he was taken off the playing field. We're not likely to find written instructions to the assassin - again, by design. Instead, the preliminary investigation shows his presence on ANTIFA-related websites, such as Anti-Fascists of Reddit (I'm not providing a link). It is within such networks that youth are radicalized to the point of murder. The assassin's mother has attested to his complete radicalization over the course of just a year. Such machinations cannot only be predicted, but provide Leftist mouthpieces plausible-deniability. That is their design and purpose. The entire ANTIFA network, and its operative tentacles spread throughout American society, are thoroughly insidious. The ANTIFA network is behind most all of the political violence our country, and many other Western nations, have experienced in the past half century. This entire subversive network needs to be dismantled, root and branch, in the manner of an organized crime network - which it most assuredly is. ANTIFA with all its related affiliates and networks is an existential threat to the continuation of the Republic of the United States of America. President Trump understands this reality. He believes the most direct path to commence the dismantling operation is to declare ANTIFA a terrorist organization. He realizes that getting such a measure through the Congress would be too time consuming and would be fought and tied-up by the Democrats. Instead, as is his style in Trump 2.0, he chooses action, and is going direct to an Executive Order. It will no-doubt be challenged in the courts. But we must get rolling on penetrating and dismantling this subversive cancer on the country. The Kirk assassination has struck a chord throughout the country. We who've followed in detail the evolution of the New Left in all its forms since the 1960s, sense that this is a moment where we must shift-gears. It seems Trump also senses this. What that means for us is, that we in the broader Conservative-MAGA movement can no longer accommodate the delusions and intimidations of Leftists and public Democrats. The insanity which regularly comes out of their mouths in public and online town forums needs to be countered with clear statements of reality, every time - e.g. "boys cannot become girls." We don't have to listen to this rot. We'll remain peaceful, as always - no one was ever arrested at a tea-party rally. 'Silent-no-more' as it is said. President Trump and his field-generals will handle the roll-up of ANTIFA. Here on the ground, we can be force-multipliers by standing up for our nation's founding principles, individual liberty, religion, and traditional values - and support all those that do. And not be afraid to simply proclaim reality in the midst of evil and insanity.

body:
Faith under fire: Grief, risk—and the legacy Charlie left behind
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Charlie Kirk loved Colorado—and tonight we honor his legacy. I’ll be speaking at the CSU vigil alongside Isabel Brown, Will Witt & Andrew Wommack. Join us as we stand for faith, freedom & truth. [Learn more here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
🎙️ Check out today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** GOP Congress members are demanding an [emergency session on the state’s crime wave](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while Denver’s [school board races](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) could reshape district leadership. Former Senate President Kevin Grantham is running for [state treasurer](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), RTD faces [mounting safety concerns](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after violent incidents, and Western Slope officials want to delay a key [Shoshone water rights decision](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). In Teller County, a couple is [battling commissioners in court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to save their 2,800-square-foot greenhouse, arguing it’s protected by Colorado’s Farm Stand Act and tied to their ministry, while officials say it violates zoning laws and subdivision covenants. Meanwhile, police in Northern Colorado arrested a suspect for [burning a Charlie Kirk tribute](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Loveland, investigated as arson.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** China praised its [TikTok deal with the U.S.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as a “win-win,” with ByteDance’s stake cut below 20% as American firms take control under Trump’s national security push. Meanwhile, Trump used Constitution Day to urge new citizens to [honor their “sacred duty,”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as DHS tightened vetting and citizenship requirements.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** In the wake of Charlie Kirk’s assassination, Pastor Chris Goble and Heidi Ganahl urge conservatives to [turn grief into courage](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and carry his mission forward. Pastor Drake Hunter examines [end-times theology](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), contrasting “escape plan” Dispensationalism with Amillennialism’s focus on living faithfully here and now.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, September 18, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Faith under fire: Grief, risk—and the legacy Charlie left behind](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Grief is an ember. Handled well, it can light a thousand torches. Pastor Chris Goble put it plainly—Charlie “died because he was willing to do things that we weren’t”—then pictured that spark rising into a bonfire of new voices.
The scene in Orem set the tone, the flight to Phoenix confirmed it—and the work ahead now belongs to those willing to carry the heat without burning out.
For Heidi Ganahl, the loss feels like “a gaping hole” in the conservative movement. “Freedom can be dangerous,” she said. “And it took a dear friend’s life.”
Goble anchored that grief in scripture, drawing parallels to the early church. “We live in a spiritual cosmic war,” he said. “We have to expect both real and spiritual bullets to be whizzing by our heads constantly.”
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[GOP Lawmakers Push for Emergency Session on Colorado Crime Wave](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX 31 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* GOP Reps. Gabe Evans, Lauren Boebert, and Jeff Crank are demanding Governor Polis call a special session to repeal what they call “soft-on-crime” laws fueling Colorado’s crime wave.
* Their letter cites cases like the Weld County Sheriff’s Office being forced to release a potentially dangerous man deemed incompetent to stand trial under 2024 laws.
* Polis has admitted the release was unacceptable and acknowledged that the new competency restoration laws may need to be revisited by the legislature.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Religious Freedom and Property Rights Collide in Teller County over “Illegal” Greenhouse](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Virginia and Zac Loop are in a legal battle with Teller County, which wants their 2,856-square-foot greenhouse torn down, fining them $200 per day since July for zoning violations.
* The Loops argue the 2019 Farm Stand Act allows their structure and say it supports their nonprofit ministry, God’s Way, which would distribute food to neighbors as a charitable mission, not a commercial venture.
* County officials, including Commissioner Robert Campbell who lives in the same subdivision, contend the greenhouse violates residential zoning, subdivision covenants, and permit requirements.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[The Apocalypse—Are You Ready?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 17** _When it comes to the “end of the world,” I’ve sat in both seats, dispensationalism & Amillennialism. For years, I was firmly in the Dispensationalist camp. Charts, timelines, raptures, and the seven-year tribulation — it all made perfect sense to me. After all, my pastors, mentors, and seminary professors taught it as gospel truth. Why question what’s been handed down by respected voices?_ __

**[Colorado mourns Charlie Kirk with vigil on Sept. 18–same day he was to speak at CSU](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | SEPTEMBER 17** _Instead of a speech by Charlie Kirk at CSU, a vigil will be held in his honor. At 5:30 pm on Thursday, Sept. 18, a student-led gathering will begin at CSU’s Canvas Stadium. The stadium can seat 36,000 and is located at 751 W Pitkin St., Fort Collins._
__

**[Is the Colorado Economy More of a Train Wreck than it Currently Appears?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY MIKE O'DONNELL | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 16** _Given all the sad news last week, a September 9 press release from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) announcing a major downward revision in job numbers for March 2024 to March 2025 was understandably overlooked. The serious implications the announcement had for the national and especially the Colorado economies still, nonetheless, remain today._ __

body:
Next year, we have a real shot at flipping Congress, but I need your help to get it done |
#
---
Folks, When I first ran for governor, I was stepping into the biggest challenge of my life. I had two girls at home, a lot of people telling me to wait my turn, and no roadmap for how to make it all work. Back then, I didn’t know all the answers, but I knew how to fight, and I knew I wasn’t in it alone. I learned that **real progress takes community, persistence, and people who believe in each other.** That’s why I started Fight Like Hell PAC. Because I believe in what’s possible when we come together, organize, and fight for something bigger than ourselves. **Next year, we have a real shot at flipping the House and Senate — and I need your help to get it done.** We’re backing strong Democrats in key races, running trainings to support new candidates and their staff, and fueling the grassroots movement we need to win tough fights. Hi Peter, Stephany here. Today, on International Equal Pay Day, we should all be outraged: Women are still being robbed of their fair share EVERY. SINGLE. DAY.
Everyone is always talking about how the "rent is too d*$n high," and sustainable living feels out of reach. But under these conditions we know who is truly feeling the brunt—women, especially women of color, who are consistently being underpaid.
More than 300,000 Black women have been forced out of the job market under this administration.
Peter, on average, women earn 77 cents for every dollar earned by men for work of equal value— with even wider disparities for women with children and Black and Brown women...
That’s not fairness. That’s not equality. It is systemic injustice designed to keep women, especially women of color, out of positions of power and leadership.
While corporations and right-wing extremists benefit from keeping women underpaid, underfunded, and underestimated, we know the truth: women’s labor is the backbone of our families, our communities, and our economy.
Movement for Freedom is fighting back. Your support helps us train and uplift women organizers, invest in grassroots campaigns–many led by women, and build a future where paychecks and opportunities are equal.
Will you chip in $3, $13, or $33 today to help close the gender wage gap and build true equality? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_m4f_email-25q3?refcode=x_250918_equalpay_act]

Peter —
I’ve heard from a lot of Texans this summer. And after a great deal of reflection and prayer, I’ve made a decision:
I’m running for the U.S. Senate.
**[I’m asking you to make one of the first donations to my campaign. Split it between my campaign and State Democrats Committee. This is a massive undertaking, and it would mean the world to me to know you have my back.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/94908?refcode=em20250918-9438&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9438%2E614464%2EalKI3P)**
**[DONATE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/94908?refcode=em20250918-9438&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=9438%2E614464%2EalKI3P)**
Right now, there’s something broken in America. Our economy is broken. Our politics are broken. Even our relationships with each other feel broken.
**That’s because the most powerful people in the world want it that way.**
The biggest divide in America is not left versus right — it’s top versus bottom.
Billionaires want us looking left and right at each other instead of looking up at them.
The people at the top work so hard to keep us angry and divided because our unity is a threat to their wealth and power. So their cable news networks and their social media algorithms tear us apart.
They divide us by party, by race, by gender, by religion so we don’t notice they’re defunding our schools, gutting our healthcare, and cutting taxes for themselves and their rich friends.
It’s the oldest strategy in the world: divide and conquer. But we will not be conquered.
**The fight ahead will not be easy. We’re the underdogs.**
We’re going up against these billionaire mega-donors and their puppet politicians. We’re going up against a rigged system. And we’re going up against a lot of money.
But I’m a former middle school teacher — I don’t scare easily. And Texans don’t scare easily.
**Big Money is powerful, but it's nothing compared to people power.**
That’s why this is going to be a campaign fueled by people like you. I’ve never taken a dime of corporate PAC money, and I refuse to start now. So I need you with me.
**[Please split a contribution between my campaign for the U.S. Senate and State Democrats Committee today to become a Founding Donor. We need as many people as possible chipping in on day one to prove our movement is strong enough.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/94908?refcode=em20250918-9438&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=9438%2E614464%2EalKI3P)**

subject: [Your Comment Needed] Join us in telling Trump: HANDS OFF OUR NATIONAL FORESTS!
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTI5NTExMzkS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjMwMDI1MjMxNwS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
OUR FORESTS ARE UNDER ATTACK:

STOP Trump from Rescinding Forest Protections!

The Trump administration proposed eliminating protections for 45 MILLION ACRES of our national forests.If they succeed, it would mean more logging, more roads in pristine, undeveloped
wilderness, and the destruction of old-growth forests that are essential to our
climate and wildlife habitats.

Submit your comment today to keep our forests protected from Trump’s dirty energy agenda before it’s too late >> https://links.messages.lcv. HANDS OFF OUR NATIONAL FORESTS >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/6Lg6BPqKE8S_ For over a decade, the Roadless Rule has protected millions of acres of national forests in 36 states and Puerto Ricofrom destructive development. But now, the Trump administration is pushing a
reckless plan to eliminate these protections and hand over our forests to corporate polluters. This isn’t just a policy change — it’s an all-out assault on our forests, our
climate, and our communities. The Roadless Rule is one of the most important safeguards we have to protect
critical wildlife habitats and intact landscapes. It preserves critical buffer
zones for increasingly catastrophic wildfires, keeps the water that millions of
people rely on clean and free from pollution, and prohibits timber production in
old-growth forests like the Tongass and forests from North Carolina to
California. We can’t let the timber industry and other polluters get the green light to tear down irreplaceable old-growth forests — and we need your voice, Peter, to fight back. Help us reach 5,000 comments opposing this attack on our forests >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Zzb0MqGLKDJ~ TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv. This rollback is a blatant, reckless giveaway to corporate polluters — and the
costs will be devastating: Old-growth forests destroyed, releasing massive amounts of carbon and worsening the climate crisis.
Drinking water poisoned or diminished for millions of Americans.
Wildlife habitat shattered, pushing vulnerable species to the brink.
Wildfires made more destructive, fueled by new roads and reckless development.
Our last wild places lost forever, sacrificed for corporate profits. The Department of Agriculture is taking public comments now — and they need to
hear from all of us. Add your voice today to defend our forests, our climate,
and our communities. Please, submit your comment today to protect our old-growth forests and fight Trump’s reckless plan to rescind the Roadless Rule >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ebDKc8Eze_ For the trees. Francesca Governali

subject: This FEC deadline is still important
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
As you read this, our political opponents are hard at work. They’re carrying out Donald Trump’s orders, they’re in the media every day getting their message out, and they’re raising a ton of money.
#

Friends — yes, we do still have an official FEC deadline on September 30th.
And, yes, even with everything going on right now, that deadline still matters.
Here’s why:
As you read this, our political opponents are hard at work. They’re carrying out Donald Trump’s orders, they’re in the media every day getting their message out, and they’re raising a ton of money.
What we do in response makes all the difference. I firmly believe that the only way we’ll see ourselves out of the situation we are in now, the only way we can bring back some real accountability, is by retaking majorities in the House and Senate. And that’s exactly what I’ve been working towards.
To do anything else would indicate that I have lost faith in democracy. And I am here to tell you, my faith has never wavered.
But securing that democracy takes constant work. It takes time, effort, and a significant amount of resources. I am committed to doing that work, but I can’t do it alone. From the Navy to NASA to my campaigns, I’ve always been lucky to have a strong team behind me.
Now is no different.

body:
J.D. Vance was in Michigan yesterday, trying to rebrand President Trump's "Big Beautiful Bill" ahead of the mid-term elections.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2348%2E135344%2EaIWBBL)

Friends -
J.D. Vance was in Michigan yesterday, trying to rebrand President Trump's "Big Beautiful Bill" ahead of the mid-term elections.
It’s no surprise – Michigan will again be the center of the political universe in 2026.
The Vice President talked a little bit about the bill, but there was a lot left unsaid.
The Vice President did not mention that manufacturing jobs are down for the 4th month in a row.
The Vice President did not mention that housing costs are up nearly 5%.
The Vice President did not mention that Michiganders have started to get letters that their healthcare costs are going up between 10-20% next year.
No matter how much Vance tries to rebrand President Trump’s “Big Beautiful Bill,” Michiganders know their own pocketbooks and how much they can or cannot save every month.
And the facts speak for themselves.
Getting that message out ahead of the next election will be critical to Democrats' chances of taking back the House and the Senate – both of which are in play here in Michigan.
Elissa needs your help getting it done:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to Elissa Slotkin's campaign in Michigan? We will put the funds we raise to work campaigning and turning out Democrats here in Michigan.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep25.bZDurS&refcode=em250918-1&t=2&akid=2348%2E135344%2EaIWBBL)

subject: We're urging Pelosi to block the bombs
body:
The genocide in Gaza can't be ignored

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/8178cbc3fbef/were-urging-pelosi-to-block-the-bombs?e=bf17056ae8)

# We’re urging Pelosi to block the bombs.
Speaker Emerita Pelosi has yet to join a growing list of Democrats in co-sponsoring H.R. 3565, the _Block the Bombs Act_ , which would halt the sale of major U.S. weapons to Israel.
---
[|
---](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=8ecc2bcb47&e=bf17056ae8)
| | Today, we released an ad urging Pelosi to use her power and do her part as a legislator to end the genocide in Gaza. As communications director for this campaign, I feel an immense amount of pride to work for a candidate like Saikat who speaks up against such blatant injustice and isn’t scared to demand more from our politicians.

As a San Francisco resident, I feel the soul of this city is one of progress and promise. Saikat likes to say that SF has been ‘the tip of the spear,’ often taking the first step toward justice before the country follows along.
I believe that, too, and know that now, the representative of San Francisco must amplify the voices of constituents when we say enough is enough. Silence is complicity, and we refuse to be complicit while millions of people in Gaza are being starved to death and bombed with U.S. weapons.
If you haven’t yet, we encourage you to watch our ad, share it with your network, and sign the petition asking Pelosi to take a stand.

Fellow Conservative,

The nation mourns the tragic assassination of Charlie Kirk, gunned down on September 10, 2025, at Utah Valley University for daring to speak truth to power. His fearless voice—championing freedom, faith, and the American Dream—was silenced in a brazen act of political violence that has shaken us all to our core. Charlie fought hate with educated debate, not guns, using sharp wit and unyielding principle to challenge radical agendas. **Yet, he was punished with a bullet for his courage to speak.**

My name is Adam Schwarze. **I’m a former Navy SEAL running for the United States Senate in Minnesota, and Charlie Kirk is an inspiration to me.** Over the course of my career, I’ve met some very special men and women willing to put their lives on the line for God and country in some of the most inhospitable places imaginable.

**_I never had the pleasure of meeting Charlier Kirk, but as a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran, I can say with authority that he has to be one of the bravest individuals ever to champion the values of the United States of America._**

Charlie’s candor, professionalism, and respect for everyone he encountered will stick with me as I work to earn the support of every Minnesotan voter during this campaign. **Charlie’s life should serve as an example to my opponents on the other side of the aisle on how to treat political opponents and people who share different viewpoints, with respect.**

I joined the Marine Corps after 9/11, served in over 70 countries, and fought chaos and extremism. I know what it takes to serve something bigger than yourself—just like Charlie did with every debate, every speech, every stand he took. This Senate race is my most challenging mission yet. Minnesota hasn’t gone red since 1976. I’m the underdog. _**[But with your support, we can honor Charlie’s legacy by stopping the radicals who enabled this tragedy](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4d8451bcde54407ab1056a48497356fa&_e=TKGYz4PAsVa1kmBfEz3QttNDXzgHyqddBLVFhZIGH0Xwkrk8f1odrmAG-qtf5_DsVsihuflgCF608HlhZhZL090RF_sQql9Goe8OfJOxoTmaFsPWl8vhR7PYDn96iGyCgvD2MeKQb-KBqZ8p_ldAImYo4mbj_rRMwwH6WcmgayjF61C8Qu7oBwNG47SMW-jzeM7gFYIj3I2AwmVoRjf49fHnMe6RPheHVw-tbw8vrcAwhVLJtFe49vkvsT0FXWnl-EE_ZEDiy1WGbrix-oIMxv6ZXdWWEKuq5BPdS8ZYdDFLyZdEauerEliosY_EYKnPG32E967NR_LCfN8igSToinYqAOQXYD7PFCoIZbMWeR9xOyU6h1z7SbRULsOZitFLABkqvt8QRKbLrq21Od7b6tRElBaK72NCIQByjo0PnTW7LbTZBwf1oanYM1gROBfb0iY2TOFG8YGu9keVvU8BlL7SSxz5ERcSHbT9DST5Fd-9W766ZDUlbIZ21Fycn3ROig64P9kTDwEGrbSj1WQnFT69sSKnX_2OPn-ok9-lomWl0Xf3v3fBmDyUJpVIPBlh3dxOfV-xg0-f2__ssdGp2xOUDTmAX7xlYZ41YAe9lMZdBmAFUVuLDMLoUeHkz129Xg8BaXCg4j861Po6qfAIhebCxXRSWsZQogRhj5wgLMCNL7wDGNCDBA6nJ17nNDAea86_TdDJiSeT7vSYZWYx1hBMKdjfj5JU9NtZBcotNmCJgox2YdwiWDnai-m9mLSVItq5ay2ceVqSIvdptHPEu655e4bdrdnskGfmPlUNcDM%3D)**_.

Unfortunately, I’m running against Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, who, like her boss, shares a long history of inflammatory rhetoric.

Days before Charlie’s untimely death, Tim Walz, speaking in front of constituents at a political rally, lamented that President Trump hadn’t yet died, making his scripted condolences for Charlie’s family ring all the more hollow as he _**failed to disavow the extremists celebrating this tragedy online.**_

_**I thank God that President Trump defeated Kamala Harris last November.**_****

**Can you imagine a vice president with so little moral clarity that he would tolerate the hatred that led to Charlie’s murder?** **
**
I can’t.

Tim Walz and my opponent in this Senate race personify everything Charlie Kirk stood against: **arrogance, deceit, and a progressive agenda that sees conservatives not as opponents, but as enemies to be crushed.** Their party’s years of demonizing voices like Charlie’s set the stage for this violence. Their silence on the specifics of this tragedy speaks louder than their words.

They both push to disarm law-abiding Minnesotans while radicals run rampant. They both pander with land acknowledgments, dividing us further. They both view Republicans as threats to be eliminated, just as Charlie was targeted for his beliefs. **The woman in the photo below is my opponent, by the way.**

His fearless voice—championing freedom, faith, and the American Dream—was silenced in a brazen act of political violence that has shaken us all to our core. Charlie fought hate with educated debate, not guns, using sharp wit and unyielding principle to challenge radical agendas. Yet, he was punished with a bullet for his courage to speak. My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a former Navy SEAL running for the United States Senate in Minnesota, and Charlie Kirk is an inspiration to me. Over the course of my career, I’ve met some very special men and women willing to put their lives on the line for God and country in some of the most inhospitable places imaginable. I never had the pleasure of meeting Charlier Kirk, but as a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran, I can say with authority that he has to be one of the bravest individuals ever to champion the values of the United States of America. Charlie’s candor, professionalism, and respect for everyone he encountered will stick with me as I work to earn the support of every Minnesotan voter during this campaign. Charlie’s life should serve as an example to my opponents on the other side of the aisle on how to treat political opponents and people who share different viewpoints, with respect. I joined the Marine Corps after 9/11, served in over 70 countries, and fought chaos and extremism. I know what it takes to serve something bigger than yourself—just like Charlie did with every debate, every speech, every stand he took. This Senate race is my most challenging mission yet. Minnesota hasn’t gone red since 1976. I’m the underdog. . Unfortunately, I’m running against Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, who, like her boss, shares a long history of inflammatory rhetoric. Days before Charlie’s untimely death, Tim Walz, speaking in front of constituents at a political rally, lamented that President Trump hadn’t yet died, making his scripted condolences for Charlie’s family ring all the more hollow as he failed to disavow the extremists celebrating this tragedy online. I thank God that President Trump defeated Kamala Harris last November.** Can you imagine a vice president with so little moral clarity that he would tolerate the hatred that led to Charlie’s murder? I can’t. Tim Walz and my opponent in this Senate race personify everything Charlie Kirk stood against: arrogance, deceit, and a progressive agenda that sees conservatives not as opponents, but as enemies to be crushed. Their party’s years of demonizing voices like Charlie’s set the stage for this violence. Their silence on the specifics of this tragedy speaks louder than their words. They both push to disarm law-abiding Minnesotans while radicals run rampant. They both pander with land acknowledgments, dividing us further. They both view Republicans as threats to be eliminated, just as Charlie was targeted for his beliefs. The woman in the photo below is my opponent, by the way. If they get their way, they’ll impose their warped vision on America, silencing patriots like Charlie Kirk forever—patriots who countered lies with reason, not violence. This fight isn’t just about Walz or Peggy Flanagan — it’s about the future Charlie Kirk died for. It’s about you, me, and everyone who believes in our nation’s founding values. They think we’re “buffoons.” They think we’ll stay silent. They think we’ll let Charlie’s murder fade. When elected to the United States Senate, I promise I won’t stay silent; I won’t let his memory or work fade into the history books. . Your contribution of $5, $10, or $25 today will fuel our fight to keep Charlie’s vision alive—building a Minnesota and an America where free speech is protected, not punished with bullets. You have a choice: let them sweep this under the rug, or join me to ensure Charlie’s sacrifice galvanizes us to reclaim our values through the same fearless, reasoned debate he embodied. I’ve fought tough battles before. With you by my side, we’ll win this one—for Charlie, for America. name: Nellie Pou
subject: This district is my home
body:
It’s a responsibility I take seriously

| |
---
Hi friend, I was born and raised in NJ-09, and I bring that with me every day that I am in Washington. I'm working to make sure families across New Jersey have access to affordable health care, safe neighborhoods, strong schools, and an economy that works for everyone. Our district is diverse, united, and strong, and I am proud to bring those voices, values, and experiences to Congress. ---
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.EtNV8HBC60Tl7UuGmXS3sYMMMCXQg6tLXTP6gYXpdfQungzafieIv5SxV3J6ts_ekakgYGXyGOATwbWLgu247TV6ghE8GkZTrbeoNbQUwX1tXliCjHl2NgNtcGzFC5Linab-MBBbYWLlMyFCfs6I9dNNZ6cQrkPlailEM82oYuO8Sn-IUmHErsvdtpKV903UBFl1fJFLpCt1tOFDI9v9txGtYzF0RyVbNsAXIw7Eb9mWbp59ylcFYhNbB0lzeYe0t3rBh4fWSnDsKkiXRGbzL6ZAwE2iprhyQojYvFvTD1jqBGk_Nsi6VtIs1QtlR5LU2lVtx_XDNbMtMdcEihi0rolE94TOrBcFu3H_FX9pwg_HuJB-29SNikPC9WaHu_6d65VElmDnIzsKj1eBH0sA7WgAvLpuWETR63fa-MWzd8s/4k0/OTGIMnAPTe679f90S7AoQQ/h0/h001.C9Q_Ybjdkw2J7hx7lni--56bF_L2o9m0iXpGq89y9VU)Hi Friend, Donald Trump just silenced one of his loudest critics — and ABC helped him do it. On Monday night, Jimmy Kimmel told the truth about how the Trump administration is exploiting the tragic death of right-wing activist Charlie Kirk to stoke its war on the left. Kimmel said, “They’re using Charlie Kirk’s death as a political weapon. That’s what they do — turn grief into propaganda.” He was right. And for that, Trump’s FCC Chair Brendan Carr publicly threatened ABC’s broadcast license. Within hours, ABC yanked Kimmel off the air. [Tell ABC: Air Kimmel Now](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.EtNV8HBC60Tl7UuGmXS3sYMMMCXQg6tLXTP6gYXpdfQungzafieIv5SxV3J6ts_ekakgYGXyGOATwbWLgu247TV6ghE8GkZTrbeoNbQUwX1tXliCjHl2NgNtcGzFC5Linab-MBBbYWLlMyFCfs6I9UQ0sj6ZV88jMk_6RH8RZp9y87DWImPrJ_TBz9ICXlGHRjkCYHd7SKzBGmr8qCsJcSYyCYRTRCxrCYSLRadJUSgkRvJBH2UOuMppLqpIqtq9iyj0F37383KGjQs5U_Lq3eZz83XhI6Am_KAGkH8BGCyUFr_nz7wHPA4_NeITt3CIk-x0K3qajNtVlAr7dYWDk2VVvlw8SiqMG9pxBaUJ9OE-5QW1k4k8o9dJK_rGa1MTDq5QPumkjzw_HwDYYPXCtyXqYfh1WlNj69lcJYXNruA/4k0/OTGIMnAPTe679f90S7AoQQ/h1/h001.5kodb8kmetA75XihmW5oeYCU0H9C-Sz94pD6PxiPoDo)
Presidents don’t get to decide who is allowed on TV. By bowing to Trump’s threats, ABC handed him a dangerous victory — proof that intimidation works. [**Tell ABC: “Don’t let Trump censor the media. Put Jimmy Kimmel back on the air IMMEDIATELY.”**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.EtNV8HBC60Tl7UuGmXS3sYMMMCXQg6tLXTP6gYXpdfQungzafieIv5SxV3J6ts_ekakgYGXyGOATwbWLgu247TV6ghE8GkZTrbeoNbQUwX1tXliCjHl2NgNtcGzFC5Linab-MBBbYWLlMyFCfs6I9efvVUMeFcTNJkh_1WZ5LqPacz839e8eIUmr4q9COVL9wB1wfoZUkUVPRNxgMX57cT5LNt418lMldaCBp6djir4WagoHNLi30Jzl1lOHBIWP79FKuvRVG8-u-etxLgZh2N3Sz61KsuUZrR4HR7LlTYS0ltK2tGlS8PzC38x8KX8BZ9NIC64jhLKN-VlX4S3mo6NDax6R8pg0WwUmvVKW-aawbwEjUmridBLJwQsDze2aq2CADfk2xLyuAJtDOb6i8ZCasTPQZcAepJKxp27o_Ts/4k0/OTGIMnAPTe679f90S7AoQQ/h2/h001.SzjxRvGcPdGubG3P9FeCkhxxWrijU1Ovn0NvHhAz-iM) This is not abstract. Carr is wielding the full power of the federal government to punish dissent — openly threatening ABC’s ability to broadcast nationwide if it doesn’t silence Trump’s critics. That is authoritarian censorship, plain and simple. This fight is bigger than Jimmy Kimmel. It’s about whether corporations like ABC will defend free expression — or help the president shred it. If they give in now, Trump’s FCC will soon threaten every media outlet that dares to criticize him. That’s how authoritarianism takes hold — one act of surrender at a time. We don't want to see any nonprofit bludgeoned and silenced for dissent -- especially not one dedicated to protecting and expanding our right to vote. This dangerous bill needs to be stopped before bad actors are empowered to weaponize the tax code against organizations they don't agree with.
Please, RUSH $25 or more today to stop this "chilling" bill and protect the ability to organize, protest, and advocate before it's too late >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091825_2&amount=25]

Truthout: House Passes Chilling “Nonprofit Killer” Bill [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091825_2&amount=25]
We've got to let you know, Team, that a bill that would give President Donald Trump broad powers to target his political foes passed in the U.S. House of Representatives last Congress and is sure to come up again.
The bill, last known as H.R. 9495, would empower the Treasury secretary to unilaterally designate any nonprofit as a “terrorist supporting organization” and revoke its tax-exempt status, effectively killing the group. The bill could give presidential administrations a tool to crack down on organizations for political reasons.
“ Authoritarianism is not born overnight — it creeps in ,” Rep. Lloyd Doggett said on the House floor. “ A tyrant tightens his grip not just by seizing power, but when he demands new powers and when those who can stop him willingly cede and bend to his will .” “ A sixth grader would know this is unconstitutional ,” added Rep. Jamie Raskin.
Unconstitutional and authoritarian or not, this bill has passed the House once and has a good chance of passing both houses of Congress now that opponents of voting rights have total control of our government. That's why we need to start working now to prevent this bill from ever becoming law.
Will you chip in $25 or whatever you can right now to help us stop this bill and protect the ability of people-powered groups to advocate for our rights? We need every supporter of voting rights with us >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091825_2&amount=25]

Please, RUSH $25 or more today to stop this "chilling" bill and protect the ability to organize, protest, and advocate before it's too late >> [] Voter Action Project [] Truthout: House Passes Chilling “Nonprofit Killer” Bill [] We've got to let you know, Team, that a bill that would give President Donald Trump broad powers to target his political foes passed in the U.S. House of Representatives last Congress and is sure to come up again. The bill, last known as H.R. 9495, would empower the Treasury secretary to unilaterally designate any nonprofit as a “terrorist supporting organization” and revoke its tax-exempt status, effectively killing the group. The bill could give presidential administrations a tool to crack down on organizations for political reasons. “ Authoritarianism is not born overnight — it creeps in ,” Rep. Lloyd Doggett said on the House floor. “ A tyrant tightens his grip not just by seizing power, but when he demands new powers and when those who can stop him willingly cede and bend to his will .” “ A sixth grader would know this is unconstitutional ,” added Rep. Jamie Raskin. Unconstitutional and authoritarian or not, this bill has passed the House once and has a good chance of passing both houses of Congress now that opponents of voting rights have total control of our government. That's why we need to start working now to prevent this bill from ever becoming law. Will you chip in $25 or whatever you can right now to help us stop this bill and protect the ability of people-powered groups to advocate for our rights? We need every supporter of voting rights with us >> [] If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [] GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [] Other Amount [] [] [] [] [] [] Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country. Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities. Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? body:
Party news you can use!

| Hello Forward Friends- I have missed writing to you! It has been quite a year, and is now campaign season once again. Forward has many endorsed candidates to support, even in this off cycle election year. We've also increased our number of affiliated elected officials across the country to 54! With so many of you wanting to get involved but not having a state party developed yet, I have decided to launch a **National Volunteer Program** at the begining of next month, with four main areas of focus to start off:
* Welcome Team
* Elected Official Outreach
* Community Events Organizer
* Campaign Helper

Each program will come with training and you will earn a pin for participating! If you're eager to sign up you can fill out this [form](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=WArSXe-hufzYEjhaXmZeHWj-u36sV3JmN27GzLTXQHYyGiTPfYoN9EgapwKbfaOZvxwnOENBFEcN3m4124VPHKD_RZSay_4imr11gviZQ7x90djo8UaYrPV2kMw2GhpjgEb9cnMPoRxLPBJoqUZKsWiQBkS2yG7Wm6Clj_DPg0UQ9nab95-LNdM_-sntCYHj&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_nvp_kickoff&n=2). Otherwise, we will go over all the details and more at our **National Volunteer Program Kickoff Party** on**Thursday October 7th at 8pm ET.** Please go ahead and reserve your spot! We will have a special surprise guest and merch giveaways- you don't want to miss it. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/nvp_kickoff_party?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_nvp_kickoff&n=3 "REGISTER NOW") [REGISTER NOW](https://home.forwardparty.com/nvp_kickoff_party?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_nvp_kickoff&n=3)
---
_Current Endorsed Candidates:_
Check out our 2025 roster so far.
_Volunteer Spotlight:_
Our volunteer of the month for September is **TJ Birkel from Oregon**! He attended a National Volunteer Intro call and then dived right in, even without active leadership in his state. TJ reached out to mayors and got two of them to meet with Forward representatives to talk about joining the Party. Way to go, TJ!
_Keeping in touch:_
Join our [Volunteer Slack Channel](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=OO1xB82Dwc0SwW5xslNAtwt7PTetSMCyw-nedLBDPmef1qA3M1FMeeWxJSFy3DiyzrOpVEzARq9FXPnjMizoqhlEaejCG9IOCrdS6JIrEePsCnY65TfjeVV8I6L13hVBGFw9EZowxFtLboRsIgjUNw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_nvp_kickoff&n=4) for more frequent updates on upcoming events, space to share stories from your volunteer work, and a place to get your questions answered. This newsletter will be sent out bi-weekly, so stay tuned.
Thank you so much for volunteering with Forward Party, I appreciate all of you!
Carrie Anne Templeton

It’s not official yet — but it’s extremely likely to become law soon.

That would mean we have three fewer months to campaign.

That timeline doesn’t just hurt grassroots campaigns like ours. It
benefits the forces we’re up against: AIPAC and corporate PACs with
bottomless checkbooks.

They’d love nothing more than to give their handpicked candidates a head
start while people-powered campaigns like ours are forced to sprint.

Peter, I’m the
only candidate in this race that has never — and will never — take a dime
from corporate PACs or AIPAC.

Whether we win comes down to whether grassroots supporters step up.

Every dollar you give powers our organizers, fuels canvassing across

If the primary moves up to May 5th, having extra support in the bank will
be critical to scale up our organizing immediately.

So I’ll ask again: [ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20250918-1-ak?amount=10&refcode=em20250918-950&refcode2=951_251025_D9whdy&akid=951%2E251025%2ED9whdy ]Will you make a donation today so we’re ready for

Whether our primary is in May or August, this fight is ours to win so long
as we stick together.

In solidarity,

Abdul

Friend, I want to thank you for loving my husband. For standing with us in the worst days of our lives. For praying. For mourning. For remembering. But now, _I need you to listen closely..._ **Because the evildoers who took Charlie 's life? They have NO idea what they have done. ** They didn't just try to silence a man...
They tried to silence his message -- a message of patriotism, of faith, and of God's merciful love. Instead, they ignited something even greater. **If they thought my husband 's mission was powerful before... ****_They have NO idea what they have just UNLEASHED._** **Not just across this country...**_**_But in me_**** _._**_ They have no idea the fire they've lit inside this wife. And to those listening across America... Let me be clear: The movement my husband built will not die.
**_I refuse to let that happen._** And I know all of us will refuse to let that happen, too. Charlie's mission will grow: Stronger. Bolder. Louder. Greater than ever. I shared these words publicly, from my heart -- just two days after I lost the love of my life.

**Charlie Kirk** 's Celebration of Life service will be streamed at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=24963351.12924.1.4acac40cc25311190af32515add1b32f) this Sunday after our morning worship service and you are welcome to join others in celebrating his legacy. **Sunday Service** = 10am CT w/**Dr. Randy Caldwell** **Charlie Kirk's Legacy Service** = 1pm CT

Join me tonight on **Newsmax** with **David Harris Jr** at 8:45pm EST / 7:45pm CT!
Watch it here: [https://www.newsmax.com](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=24963351.12925.1.d42ecfa9b90571ab5ab5fd63b54eb700)

**WOW**... this Sunday at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=24963351.12927.1.bb4d723de045cf6ad83be18e48b67d55) was unlike anything I have ever seen. The auditorium was **completely FULL** 15 minutes before service even started. There was a long line of people trying to get into the auditorium. People who had not been to church in years and even decades decided to come to church. This did not just happen at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=24963351.12928.1.d5b104b9e9186c3b0d6b697af8d69550) but churches all across America. Many are calling this the **Charlie Kirk Effect**. Not only are Pastors recognizing a spiritual hunger in Americans but so did **CNN**. For CNN to see and report on it means God is REALLY moving. Yesterday, I preached a sermon dedicated to my friend, **Charlie Kirk** , entitled, "[TURNING POINT](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=24963351.12929.1.4567c3c57ec039780f65b190e93fd3a3)."
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=24963351.12930.1.3372f992a5ebb3aa427cb71616f99d11)
---
I want to encourage you to watch this as it made a tremendous impact upon those who received it yesterday.
You can watch it here: [https://youtube.com/live/VThy9lMd7ec?feature=share](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=24963351.12931.1.54a36a0ff8720ec84bb3167c90427e15)
May the fires of revival continue to spread across America.
Thank you
Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=40163%2E3422442%2EwAZBWE)
Peter,
Last night, ABC pulled Jimmy Kimmel off the air after he dared to exercise his First Amendment right of free speech.

# Illegal Immigration "destroys countries from within" \- Trump urges Prime Minister to handle UK's issue during joint press conference
President Trump and United Kingdom Prime Minister Keir Starmer spoke together at a press conference in London Thursday. The two shared flattery before they did opposing views about a number of foreign policy issues.
* **Trump 's Israel Stance Stands Strong:** Trump maintained **[strong support for Israel's military campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/f8270422-07d3-4fcd-8f1f-bed40cb1b3e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while British Prime Minister Starmer stood firm on the UK's intention to formally recognize Palestinian statehood.
* **Major AI Deal:** President Trump and the Prime Minister signed a**[$350 billion technology deal](https://substack.com/redirect/cf024c34-88c5-4015-ac3e-ca3329a7a548?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** covering artificial intelligence, nuclear energy and quantum computing that officials say could create 17,500 jobs across both nations, calling it the Technology Prosperity Deal.
* **Trump Says UK Immigration Needs USA-Style Handling:** Trump urged the Prime Minister to stop the massive record of immigration wreaking havoc on the UK, saying it "it doesn't matter what means you use" because it "destroys countries from within," as he recounted the administration's success in demolishing US illegal immigration. According to recent reports, the United Kingdom received **[over 100,000 immigrants](https://substack.com/redirect/1960777c-0dc7-46e8-bbb4-5d17bb6bef21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from countries like Pakistan, Afghanistan, and Iran in the year 2024.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9f0e6001-9ccb-49c6-a264-9efc11cae061?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Trump Puts Down Putin:** Trump also said he was **["let down"](https://substack.com/redirect/25479222-7fe6-4306-9a47-42f03d1610ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by Russian President Vladimir Putin, stating that resolving the Ukraine conflict was supposed to be easier given his "relationship with President Putin" before acknowledging that "war is a different thing."
* Ukraine is set to receive $3.5 billion in U.S. weapons including Patriot and HIMARS missiles through a new allied funding program. The renewed arms flow comes after the Pentagon halted Ukraine weapons shipments in July.
* **Hopes to Regain Afghanistan Airbase:** Trump also revealed that his administration is working to **[regain control of a major Afghanistan airfield that fell to the Taliban](https://substack.com/redirect/e9b2ef67-0826-4087-9867-5fd109acae99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in 2021 following the Biden's disastrous U.S. withdrawal. Trump cited the location's proximity to Chinese nuclear facilities as a key motivation for the move.
* The effort to reclaim the stronghold comes amid tentative diplomatic contacts with the Taliban, including a March meeting between White House envoy Adam Boehler and Taliban officials that focused on hostage negotiations and potential bilateral cooperation. It remains unclear how the administration plans to actually secure the airbase's return.

# Syracuse University next up to fire educators spewing violent remarks in wake of Charlie Kirk's assassination
Educators nationwide are getting intense wake up calls as their indoctrinated words face real consequences.
Syracuse University places two professors on administrative leave after they celebrated conservative activist Charlie Kirk's assassination on social media.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd8f6b0-c3d4-4bce-a582-ac7ec1ffaf7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* Assistant Political Science Professor Jenn Jackson posted that Kirk's death seemed **["both ironic and in line with his own politics,"](https://substack.com/redirect/f3d74bc3-487d-4576-87da-a3f51678f5d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and called him "trash," while Geography Professor Farhana Sultana wrote "rest in piss" and called Kirk a "white supremacist."
* **[Kirk was shot](https://substack.com/redirect/40b00620-3b6b-4792-aa99-11212756d563?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and killed Sept. 10 at Utah Valley University while addressing a large crowd at an outdoor debate, with officials describing it as a "targeted attack" and "political assassination."
* The Syracuse case is part of a nationwide wave of **[educator discipline](https://substack.com/redirect/ede1bdcd-df67-4468-9793-37d4909655fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , with teachers and professors from Texas to Tennessee being fired or suspended for celebrating Kirk's death on social media.
* Tyler Robinson, 22, was arrested Friday on charges of aggravated murder, obstruction of justice and felony discharge of a firearm, with prosecutors planning to seek the death penalty.
* The Texas Education Agency alone is investigating **[roughly 280 complaints](https://substack.com/redirect/15eaaf38-17aa-4f5d-84e3-b431d1d5a849?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** against teachers over alleged inappropriate comments about Kirk's death, while universities in multiple states have terminated faculty members.

Rep. Claudia Tenney, R-N.Y., demanded Syracuse forfeit federal funding if the professors remain employed, calling their conduct "reprehensible" with "no place in any institution of higher learning."
