# Child vaccination debate sparks heated congressional fight as Republicans challenge the CDC
Sen. Rand Paul went head to head with Sen. Bernie Sanders and former CDC Director Susan Monarez during a heated Wednesday Senate hearing over infant vaccine recommendations, **[challenging the scientific basis for immunizing children.](https://substack.com/redirect/f5e6c045-c03f-438c-ae79-d4f19eaffa0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f5e6c045-c03f-438c-ae79-d4f19eaffa0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* Paul questioned Monarez about her refusal to fire CDC officials who recommend vaccines for infants as young as six months, arguing there are no proven benefits regarding hospitalization or death prevention while potential risks exist. He specifically targeted recommendations for COVID-19 vaccines and hepatitis B shots for newborns whose mothers test negative for the virus, demanding scientific justification for these protocols. "You want to make all kids take this? The burden is upon you," Paul said to Monarez.
* The confrontation escalated when Sanders repeatedly interrupted Paul's questioning to defend Monarez, leading to an intense exchange where Paul snapped, saying "You had your time Bernie, I've got mine." Monarez avoided directly answering Paul's specific questions about medical evidence supporting infant vaccination schedules, instead deflecting his inquiries about the scientific rationale behind current CDC recommendations.
* The hearing centered on Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s decision to remove Monarez from her position last month, with the former director claiming she was ousted for protecting CDC staff responsible for vaccine guidance.

# FBI director Kash Patel faced Democrat hysterics during congressional hearing
Democrat officials accused the FBI Director of covering-up the Epstein case, lying about federal investigations, and other slander as Patel stood his ground. FBI Director Kash Patel faced**[intense questioning](https://substack.com/redirect/d83de286-b1ee-4d9b-aa7e-967280471233?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Wednesday from the House Judiciary Committee about the Jeffrey Epstein case, facing heated accusations from an array of Democrat officials.
**[Related Video:](https://substack.com/redirect/b7f08425-2eab-4b6b-b8a1-21a89d18f531?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b7f08425-2eab-4b6b-b8a1-21a89d18f531?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* Rep. Thomas Massie alleged that victims provided the FBI with a list of 20 powerful men who allegedly participated in the late financier's sex-trafficking operation, including a Hollywood producer, royal prince, music industry figure, prominent banker, government official, former politician, Italian car company owner, rock star, magician and six billionaires.
* Patel told lawmakers that prosecutors across multiple administrations had "investigated those same materials" and the FBI was "not in the habit of releasing in-credible information," while noting there is no federal statute of limitations for underage sex trafficking.
* Democrats accused Patel of participating in a cover-up, with Rep. Pramila Jayapal shouting whether he would "continue to cover up for the rich and powerful men" and demanding he meet with Epstein victims who were allegedly abused as minors, while Rep. Jamie Raskin criticized Patel for dining at a Manhattan restaurant during the Charlie Kirk assassination manhunt and spreading false information about the suspect being in custody.
* The FBI director defended his record during five hours of testimony without breaks, saying "I don't give a damn what they say about me as long as I'm succeeding in the mission" while touting nationwide crime declines, historic rates of capturing child predators and murderers, and other administrative wins.

# Former vice president gets a new job in higher education
Former Vice President Mike Pence will join George Mason University's Schar School of Policy and Government as a distinguished professor of practice, the northern Virginia institution announced Tuesday.
* Pence will **[begin teaching undergraduate courses](https://substack.com/redirect/cedf8e51-34d6-47e8-b102-11a95763ffec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and public-facing seminars during the spring 2026 semester. He will also participate in moderated discussions and mentor students in political science, law, public administration and related fields.
* "Higher education plays a **[vital role in preparing Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/c26ba077-8c01-4032-b57e-b6b415049a06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** not only for career success, but also for lives of service and integrity," Pence said in a statement. "Now more than ever we should be investing our time and resources into civil discourse on campus, and I'm honored to contribute to that mission."
* Schar School Dean Mark Rozell praised Pence for his "disciplined approach to communication and his deeply rooted conservative philosophy provide a principled framework to discussions of federalism, the separation of powers, and the role of values in public life."
* The appointment comes after Pence served as Trump's loyal vice president from 2017 to 2021, but broke with his former boss after he refused Trump's pressure to overturn the 2020 election results during the Electoral College certification process. Despite receiving praise from anti-Trump Republicans for his constitutional stance, Pence's own 2024 presidential campaign failed to gain traction and ended after four months.

Tyler Robinson, 22, was arrested Friday on charges of aggravated murder, obstruction of justice and felony discharge of a firearm, with prosecutors planning to seek the death penalty. The Texas Education Agency alone is investigating against teachers over alleged inappropriate comments about Kirk's death, while universities in multiple states have terminated faculty members. Rep. Claudia Tenney, R-N.Y., demanded Syracuse forfeit federal funding if the professors remain employed, calling their conduct "reprehensible" with "no place in any institution of higher learning." Child vaccination debate sparks heated congressional fight as Republicans challenge the CDC Sen. Rand Paul went head to head with Sen. Bernie Sanders and former CDC Director Susan Monarez during a heated Wednesday Senate hearing over infant vaccine recommendations, | | ---|---|--- Paul questioned Monarez about her refusal to fire CDC officials who recommend vaccines for infants as young as six months, arguing there are no proven benefits regarding hospitalization or death prevention while potential risks exist. He specifically targeted recommendations for COVID-19 vaccines and hepatitis B shots for newborns whose mothers test negative for the virus, demanding scientific justification for these protocols. "You want to make all kids take this? The burden is upon you," Paul said to Monarez. The confrontation escalated when Sanders repeatedly interrupted Paul's questioning to defend Monarez, leading to an intense exchange where Paul snapped, saying "You had your time Bernie, I've got mine." Monarez avoided directly answering Paul's specific questions about medical evidence supporting infant vaccination schedules, instead deflecting his inquiries about the scientific rationale behind current CDC recommendations. The hearing centered on Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s decision to remove Monarez from her position last month, with the former director claiming she was ousted for protecting CDC staff responsible for vaccine guidance. FBI director Kash Patel faced Democrat hysterics during congressional hearing Democrat officials accused the FBI Director of covering-up the Epstein case, lying about federal investigations, and other slander as Patel stood his ground. FBI Director Kash Patel faced Wednesday from the House Judiciary Committee about the Jeffrey Epstein case, facing heated accusations from an array of Democrat officials. Rep. Thomas Massie alleged that victims provided the FBI with a list of 20 powerful men who allegedly participated in the late financier's sex-trafficking operation, including a Hollywood producer, royal prince, music industry figure, prominent banker, government official, former politician, Italian car company owner, rock star, magician and six billionaires. Patel told lawmakers that prosecutors across multiple administrations had "investigated those same materials" and the FBI was "not in the habit of releasing in-credible information," while noting there is no federal statute of limitations for underage sex trafficking. Democrats accused Patel of participating in a cover-up, with Rep. Pramila Jayapal shouting whether he would "continue to cover up for the rich and powerful men" and demanding he meet with Epstein victims who were allegedly abused as minors, while Rep. Jamie Raskin criticized Patel for dining at a Manhattan restaurant during the Charlie Kirk assassination manhunt and spreading false information about the suspect being in custody. The FBI director defended his record during five hours of testimony without breaks, saying "I don't give a damn what they say about me as long as I'm succeeding in the mission" while touting nationwide crime declines, historic rates of capturing child predators and murderers, and other administrative wins. Former vice president gets a new job in higher education Former Vice President Mike Pence will join George Mason University's Schar School of Policy and Government as a distinguished professor of practice, the northern Virginia institution announced Tuesday. Pence will and public-facing seminars during the spring 2026 semester. He will also participate in moderated discussions and mentor students in political science, law, public administration and related fields. "Higher education plays a not only for career success, but also for lives of service and integrity," Pence said in a statement. "Now more than ever we should be investing our time and resources into civil discourse on campus, and I'm honored to contribute to that mission." Schar School Dean Mark Rozell praised Pence for his "disciplined approach to communication and his deeply rooted conservative philosophy provide a principled framework to discussions of federalism, the separation of powers, and the role of values in public life." The appointment comes after Pence served as Trump's loyal vice president from 2017 to 2021, but broke with his former boss after he refused Trump's pressure to overturn the 2020 election results during the Electoral College certification process. Despite receiving praise from anti-Trump Republicans for his constitutional stance, Pence's own 2024 presidential campaign failed to gain traction and ended after four months. name: Erika Kirk
subject: My husband’s voice will ring out louder and clearer than ever.
body:
We will never surrender. Ever.

#
[https://secure.anedot.com/turning-point-usa/f8f86882-401a-4702-8c9b-df5abce81f1f?source_code=MAWCO69576&utm_medium=email&utm_source=hardask_acq&utm_campaign=ek&utm_term=MAWCO69576]

Friend,

I want to thank you for loving my husband.

For standing with us in the worst days of our lives. For praying. For
mourning. For remembering.

But now, _I need you to listen closely..._

BECAUSE THE EVILDOERS WHO TOOK CHARLIE’S LIFE? THEY HAVE NO IDEA
WHAT THEY HAVE DONE.

They didn’t just try to silence a man...

They tried to silence his message — a message of patriotism, of
faith, and of God’s merciful love.

Instead, they ignited something even greater.

IF THEY THOUGHT MY HUSBAND’S MISSION WAS POWERFUL BEFORE... _THEY
HAVE NO IDEA WHAT THEY HAVE JUST UNLEASHED._

NOT JUST ACROSS THIS COUNTRY... _BUT IN ME__._

They have no idea the fire they’ve lit inside this wife.

And to those listening across America... Let me be clear: The movement
my husband built will not die.

_I REFUSE TO LET THAT HAPPEN. _

And I know all of us will refuse to let that happen, too.

Charlie’s mission will grow: Stronger. Bolder. Louder. Greater than
ever.

I shared these words publicly, from my heart — just two days after I
lost the love of my life.

I WANT YOU TO WATCH. I WANT YOU TO HEAR WHAT CHARLIE MEANT TO ME. AND
I WANT YOU TO HEAR WHAT COMES NEXT:
[https://secure.anedot.com/turning-point-usa/f8f86882-401a-4702-8c9b-df5abce81f1f?source_code=MAWCO69576&utm_medium=email&utm_source=hardask_acq&utm_campaign=ek&utm_term=MAWCO69576]

Charlie gave everything for this country. And I will never stop
speaking his name.

We will not let the light he lit go out. Not now. Not ever.

For Charlie,

#
[https://secure.anedot.com/turning-point-usa/f8f86882-401a-4702-8c9b-df5abce81f1f?source_code=MAWCO69576&utm_medium=email&utm_source=hardask_acq&utm_campaign=ek&utm_term=MAWCO69576]

subject: Jimmy Kimmel
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
#

Peter,
The Trump Administration didn't approve of Jimmy Kimmel's political satire, so it threatened ABC's broadcast license, and ABC took Kimmel off the air.
**As you no doubt recognize: this is what happens in authoritarian states, where disfavored political speech is met with official punishment.**
You mustn't offend the king!
Shame on ABC and its owner Disney for capitulating to censorship. Their cowardly refusal to fight for the First Amendment will become infamous.
The Trump Administration’s intent is to chill political speech and repress critics — to send the message that if you offend Trump, his Administration will use official power to attack you.
This is the next step in Donald Trump’s growing, unprecedented, and deeply un-American campaign to punish and silence his critics by abusing the powers of state.
We cannot allow this man even more power. _And the thing he fears most is losing his rubber-stamp Congress._
It is more vital than at any time in modern American history that the political opposition has the resources to win.
**And to be very blunt, the big-money national GOP groups have more money than the big-money national Democratic groups right now.**
So it’s going to come down to grassroots supporters.
Are there enough Americans committed to opposing this assault on our Constitution to power a landslide Democratic victory in the midterms?
I am the Democratic Senator facing the toughest reelection campaign.
So if you are horrified by this latest abuse of power, one real thing you can do is send my campaign resources.
**[Send $10. Send $100.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-sep25.SYBMcx&refcode=em250918-1-f&t=1&akid=786%2E5691347%2EJ2R_no)
**[DONATE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-sep25.SYBMcx&refcode=em250918-1-f&t=2&akid=786%2E5691347%2EJ2R_no)**
Trust me: MAGA really, really won’t like it when we post a huge fundraising quarter.
Keep up the fight!
Senator Jon Ossoff

Freedom of speech and expression is one of the most sacred components of our democracy.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/115485527/570475258/1328794144?refcode=ea.945c99b2-de94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ms=ea.945c99b2-de94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk0NWM5OWIyLWRlOTQtZjAxMS1iNDg0LTYwNDViZGViNzQxMyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rvoqtxyryoi_eSouFFvvJG5XwlISziE3layoA9tIjXc=&emci=5d0b9ee8-b794-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=945c99b2-de94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=4823105)

**Jimmy Kimmel’s talk show was just yanked off the air for doing what he’s always done: making us laugh while speaking truth to power.** [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/115485528/570475259/-823355112?refcode=ea.945c99b2-de94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ms=ea.945c99b2-de94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk0NWM5OWIyLWRlOTQtZjAxMS1iNDg0LTYwNDViZGViNzQxMyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rvoqtxyryoi_eSouFFvvJG5XwlISziE3layoA9tIjXc=&emci=5d0b9ee8-b794-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=945c99b2-de94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=4823105) The decision came just hours after Donald Trump’s FCC chair, Brendan Carr, pressured ABC into pulling Jimmy’s show _indefinitely_. When a national broadcaster like ABC and Nexstar – the giant media company that controls ABC’s affiliates – silences a mainstream comedian, whether we agree with them or not, it shows just how fragile free expression has become. It sends a chilling message to journalists who question those in power, to activists demanding justice, climate scientists advancing real solutions, and to anyone who dares to speak up. The climate crisis is a huge and growing threat. We can’t confront it without a democracy that protects free speech, fair elections, and the rule of law. Freedom of speech and expression is one of the most sacred components of our democracy. Comedians, actors, and artists like Jimmy use it not only to entertain, but to hold the powerful accountable. Jimmy has never shied away from criticizing Trump. In fact, he’s been one of Trump’s loudest and most consistent critics. Jane has been on Jimmy's show herself, and she knows firsthand the way he infuses humor into politics and challenges us to think more critically about our leaders. That’s what a free press and free expression are meant to do. And that’s exactly why Trump is trying to silence him. **When presidents start censoring the media and repressing critics, that’s how authoritarians consolidate power.** **[We're all deeply worried about our future. But we also know that hope is a muscle — it gets stronger when we act. So today, we're asking you to flex your muscles a bit and take a small but significant action with us: Demand that Nexstar and ABC stand up to Trump’s FCC and their attempts to squash our First Amendment rights.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/115485529/570475260/-823355112?refcode=ea.945c99b2-de94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ms=ea.945c99b2-de94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk0NWM5OWIyLWRlOTQtZjAxMS1iNDg0LTYwNDViZGViNzQxMyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rvoqtxyryoi_eSouFFvvJG5XwlISziE3layoA9tIjXc=&emci=5d0b9ee8-b794-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=945c99b2-de94-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=4823105)** We need hundreds of thousands of us to raise our voices right now to show Trump, and anyone else who thinks they can bully and silence critics, that we will not stand by while they chip away at our freedoms. clean_body: Freedom of speech and expression is one of the most sacred components of our democracy. | Jimmy Kimmel’s talk show was just yanked off the air for doing what he’s always done: making us laugh while speaking truth to power. The decision came just hours after Donald Trump’s FCC chair, Brendan Carr, pressured ABC into pulling Jimmy’s show indefinitely. When a national broadcaster like ABC and Nexstar – the giant media company that controls ABC’s affiliates – silences a mainstream comedian, whether we agree with them or not, it shows just how fragile free expression has become. It sends a chilling message to journalists who question those in power, to activists demanding justice, climate scientists advancing real solutions, and to anyone who dares to speak up. The climate crisis is a huge and growing threat. We can’t confront it without a democracy that protects free speech, fair elections, and the rule of law. Freedom of speech and expression is one of the most sacred components of our democracy. Comedians, actors, and artists like Jimmy use it not only to entertain, but to hold the powerful accountable. Jimmy has never shied away from criticizing Trump. In fact, he’s been one of Trump’s loudest and most consistent critics. Jane has been on Jimmy's show herself, and she knows firsthand the way he infuses humor into politics and challenges us to think more critically about our leaders. That’s what a free press and free expression are meant to do. And that’s exactly why Trump is trying to silence him. When presidents start censoring the media and repressing critics, that’s how authoritarians consolidate power. We need hundreds of thousands of us to raise our voices right now to show Trump, and anyone else who thinks they can bully and silence critics, that we will not stand by while they chip away at our freedoms. clean_body: The United States is in the midst of a healthcare calamity. | | | | Earlier this month, HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. testified during a hearing with the Senate Finance Committee. He did so against the backdrop of an ongoing and worsening health care calamity in our country. At the end of August, most of the leadership for the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention were fired or resigned after refusing to bow to Kennedy's unceasing crusade against vaccines. (He's since indicated he wants to make the COVID-19 vaccine virtually inaccessible.) Kennedy refused to give our committee a clear answer when pressed about exactly what he believes about vaccines – and wouldn't offer any accountability for the chaos his actions unleashed upon hospitals and health research centers across the nation. Given the unprecedented nature of the witness's behavior, I requested that the committee formally swear in Kennedy as a witness — and in a revealing moment, Republican committee leaders rejected my request, essentially giving Kennedy the green light to lie to Congress and the American people with no consequences. = As I've traveled across Oregon this year, the message I've heard from every corner of our state, red or blue, rural or urban, is the same: people are scared and confused about the state of health care in America. Donald Trump and Robert Kennedy have done everything in their power to feed that mistrust. Every day that Robert Kennedy Jr. has been in office, the health and wellness of American families has been further endangered. >From doing away with access to vaccines to overseeing the largest blow to Medicaid in our nation's history, Robert Kennedy Jr. is making American families less safe with each passing day. He must resign immediately. I've been pressing all of Trump's nominees since day one to explain themselves and the damage they've caused, and I will not back down. It's never been more important that we strengthen our grassroots movement and hold Trump and his cronies accountable. ---
| [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e23522673/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsUnZQU2xMVw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMyMIw/s3u241483ac)
---
America is under attack as never before. Our culture, our Judeo-Christian values, our traditions, our freedoms — and our very country — are all under attack. We saw this attack in the most vicious and bloody way with the **public assassination of Charlie Kirk**. Charlie Kirk was a conservative leader. But he was more. _He was a believing Christian._ In his own way he was an evangelist. Charlie Kirk's last published words — his final words — are the Foreword for the new book, **[Pagan Threat: Confronting America's Godless Uprising](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e23522673/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsUnZQU2xMVw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMyMIw/s3u241483ac)**. **[Pagan Threat](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e23522673/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsUnZQU2xMVw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMyMIw/s3u241483ac)** was written by Charlie's close friend Pastor Lucas Miles. Pastor Miles, the author of several bestselling books, served as a leader in Charlie's Turning Point Faith. Charlie told Pastor Miles he wanted to write this Foreword because **"America was in grave danger."** _**Charlie is right.**_ In his powerful Foreword, Charlie wrote: | "Because in today's America, the Christian faithful are faced with a _terrifying and broad array of dangers and threats_. "We are menaced not by new false gods, but _by the return of demons from long ago_. "In the Pagan world, **the individual human life was of no importance**."
---
These words are chilling, considering what happened in Utah.
**About the Author** **Lucas Miles** is a trusted voice on faith, politics, and culture. He hosts _The Lucas Miles Show_ on Faithwire, cohosts _The Church Boys_ podcast, and has interviewed guests like Sean Hannity and Jim Caviezel. A bestselling author (_Woke Jesus, Good God_), Lucas has appeared on Newsmax, Fox News, and CBN. An ordained pastor, he leads Nfluence Church and has served on global missions and at national events like the National Prayer Breakfast.
---
Now, in his boldest book yet — **[Pagan Threat: Confronting America's Godless Uprising](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e23522673/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsUnZQU2xMVw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMyMIw/s3u241483ac)** — Pastor Lucas Miles rips off the mask and reveals the shocking spiritual war happening right before our eyes.
The very same war in which Charlie was a soldier — _he was also a victim_.
This is more than a book — it's a wake-up call for all Americans and for faithful Christians who want to take a stand against the spiritual deception sweeping across America.
**[Pagan Threat](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e23522673/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsUnZQU2xMVw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMyMIw/s3u241483ac) **serves as an insightful guide, a warning, and a call to action, urging readers to understand, confront, and ultimately defeat this enemy.
**[Pagan Threat](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e23522673/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsUnZQU2xMVw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMyMIw/s3u241483ac)** shows the connection between woke ideology and Paganism is not merely a coincidence but a natural progression.
Behind the emphasis on identity politics, intersectionality, wokeism, and radical inclusivity lie centuries-old ancient Pagan ideologies.
[ Claim Your Free Copy Here » ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e23522673/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsUnZQU2xMVw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMyMIw/s3u241483ac)
Pastor Lucas Miles does more than diagnose the threats we face; he aims to equip and inspire us to rise to the challenge and shows us how we can fight — and win — for our great cause.
He shows **how you can be like Charlie Kirk** — how you can fight and win.
We must stand resolute against the encroaching darkness.
The future of our great nation depends on our collective strength, faith, and our unwavering commitment to the truth.
### Pagan Threat's Final Battle Plan to Win
| **Deepen our faith rooted in our values.**
---|---
| Develop a road map for engagement in the public square.
| **Leverage technology for America.**
| Redouble efforts to reach today's youth.
| **Implement a practical strategy for evangelism.**
| Directly combat woke doctrines and pagan ideologies.
| **Renew interest in biblical truths.**
**[Pagan Threat](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e23522673/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsUnZQU2xMVw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMyMIw/s3u241483ac)** shows we must focus on these essential steps needed to combat the rise of woke Paganism so we can fortify believers' faith and return our nation to its founding principles.
[ Claim Your Free Copy Here » ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e23522673/VaHR0cHM6Ly93My5uZXdzbWF4LmNvbS9HZW5lcmFsL05NTS9PZmZlcnMvTk1NLVBhZ2FuLVRocmVhdC12Mg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MTg/LbmNsUnZQU2xMVw/qP2RrdF9uYnI9MDEwMzAxajBqNmR6/gaMyMIw/s3u241483ac)

Peter,
Yesterday, Trump’s FCC Chair Brendan Carr threatened ABC over a joke Jimmy Kimmel made — saying, “We can do this the easy way or the hard way.”
**Just hours later, Jimmy Kimmel was pulled from the air.**
Let’s be clear: this is about so much more than just a late-night comedian. It’s about control, and an escalating pattern of textbook authoritarian behavior, Peter.
Trump’s going after anyone who refuses to fall in line with his MAGA agenda. And if he’s able to silence well-connected, powerful voices like Jimmy Kimmel and Stephen Colbert, the rest of us are in serious trouble.
**This is how authoritarian states rise, Peter.** They silence dissent, eliminate opposition, make it so that only one viewpoint is tolerated — and punish anyone who dares to disagree.
The First Amendment, democracy, and the basic right to speak and live freely without fear of retribution are all on the line like never before. **That’s why I will continue to be one of the loudest voices calling out his authoritarian power-grabs because that’s what democracy relies on.**

Friend, this is not normal.
CBS canceling Colbert might be dismissed as a one-off. But ABC canceling Kimmel makes it clear: This isn’t a fluke — it’s a _**pattern**._
**_Here’s what happened:_** Yesterday, Trump's hand-picked Federal Communications Commission Chair threatened to take away ABC’s broadcast license over comments Kimmel made on air, saying, "_We can do this the easy way or the hard way._ "
Not long after, Nexstar Media – the biggest TV station owner in the U.S. – said it would pull Kimmel's show from the air on its ABC stations. Within hours, ABC announced Jimmy Kimmel Live! was cancelled indefinitely.
**Then, President Trump took to social media to celebrate, showing just how corrupt this truly is. **
This isn’t about one comedian or TV show. This is a dangerous attack on free speech. This is about whether _any one of us_ can speak freely without fear of government retaliation.

| | **🔥 MAYOR KELLER’S DEVASTATING POLL NUMBERS
** Here's what the leaked data reveals: Most voters think Albuquerque is heading in the wrong direction, and when asked directly if Tim Keller should be reelected, a whopping 60% say NO.
Even worse for Keller - his unfavorable rating has hit toxic levels, and crime dominates as voters' top concern. This spells disaster for a mayor whose biggest weakness is exactly what voters care about most.
Darren White currently trails Keller, but here's the kicker - nearly a third of voters are still undecided, and many have never heard of White. Translation: White has room to grow while Keller's already maxed out his negatives.
We break down why this race will come down to one question: Will voters choose the mayor they know has failed, or send a message despite Trump's deep unpopularity in Albuquerque?
---

---
| |
🚨 **IS THE DEMOCRAT GOVERNOR'S RACE IS OVER?**
New polling shows Deb Holland crushing Sam Bregman 55% to 19% - and it's even worse in the crosstabs. Liberal Democrats choose Holland 65% to 11%, but even "moderate" Democrats prefer her 45% to 29%.
Spoiler alert: We reveal why socialism's +36 favorability among Democrats nationally means Bregman's "centrist" strategy is DOA. The party has moved left, and primary voters aren't coming back.
💰 **ECONOMIC BRIGHT SPOT**
Mortgage rates dropped to 6.13% - the lowest in three years ahead of expected Fed cuts. This could be crucial for the Trump administration's economic messaging.
🎯 **CHARLIE KIRK CASE GETS WEIRDER**
Tyler Robinson's text messages to his roommate reveal a chilling disconnect. While confessing to the attack, his main concern was retrieving his grandfather's rifle from the bushes. Meanwhile, ABC's Matt Guttman called the messages "touching" because Robinson used the phrase "my love."
We explain why this completely misses the point about the suspect's disturbing lack of normal human emotion about committing violence.
⚠️ **FREE SPEECH WARNING**
Attorney General Pam Bondi said they'll "target you" for "hate speech" - but hate speech is constitutionally protected. We break down why this needs immediate clarification before we head down the UK's dangerous path.

I’m speaking out and fighting back — because that’s what this moment demands.
# [](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/203?t=1&akid=717%2E181023%2EB620LR)
Team —
As Michigan’s chief election official, I am proud to work with our 1,650 local election professionals to ensure all elections are secure and accessible, and that the results are an accurate reflection of the will of the people. Together we’ve defended the results of our elections against unprecedented attacks, while successfully administering, back to back, the highest turnout elections in Michigan’s history.
That’s why I can’t stay silent when lies and misinformation threaten the very foundation of our democracy.
President Trump recently attacked Colorado’s vote-by-mail system, saying:
**“The problem I have with Colorado... they do mail-in voting.”**
This comes just weeks after he met with Russian dictator Vladimir Putin, and echoed his lies about the security of voting by mail. “Vladimir Putin said something... one of the most interesting things. He said ‘Your election was rigged because you have mail-in voting. It’s impossible to have mail-in voting and have honest elections.’”
Can you believe this??
Voting by mail is how military service members and their families cast their ballots. It's how seniors vote, and college students away from home and citizens in rural communities ensure their voice is heard. And the President - on the advice of a foreign dictator(!) - wants to end that method, silencing critical voices in our democracy.
Why would the President of the United States parrot demands from Putin on how states should run our elections? Why would he seek to end a secure method of voting that citizens on both sides of the aisle embrace?
**Every day it is more and more clear: we are in a battle over the future of our democracy.**
And in moments like these, where an American President is taking advice from a Russian dictator on how to silence and ignore the voice of the people, one thing is clear: States can and must hold the line. Governors must **stand and fight.**
And here in Michigan,**you have my word** that I will stand up to this president, his administration, and anyone who tries to take our freedoms away from us.

**But I can’t do it alone.**
**[Pitch in right now to help me stand up to attacks on our democracy.](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/854?c0=jmb-em-q32025.OcO0Lx&refcode=AU_JMB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20250918_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=717%2E181023%2EB620LR)**

Trump’s — and Putin’s — continued efforts to destroy American democracy are unpatriotic, unAmerican, and go against everything that truly makes our country great. I won’t stand for it — and neither should you.

**High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.** **Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.** At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts. **By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch.** She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground.Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina. Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks. **She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.** Nancy is fighting to:
* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast
* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency
* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free
* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate
* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think
* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front. **South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.**

## MAGA's Mouseketeers: Disney Joins the Cult...Or Mickey's Drunk
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a1fb94e1-0ce8-48e1-9ce6-378fa90ecbd9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We had another edifying and yet humor-infused edition of _Amped Up_ this week with the ususal--me and David hosting--but our guest was the awesome Julie Roginsky.
Julie's done stuff. She's been a Fox & CNBC pundit, columnist, Democratic consultant, Russia analyst (her family left when she was young) and probably a bunch of other stuff we don't even know about.
The show kicked off with me--Cliff, your humble narrator--and David Schuster discussing murder. The murder, as David said, of our free speech rights.
It's killer? Disney/ABC--with Mickey Mouse himself standing over the shallow grave, ears intact.
I'm referring not to a Goodfellas scene, but how the House of the Mouse took Jimmy Kimmel off the air for the stupidest most nonsensical, non-offensive thing one could say about Charlie Kirk.
[Under his eye!](https://substack.com/redirect/50ae1a1c-b323-4310-9f21-276ebc2d6a93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Actually, because Kimmel _dared say things that are true_. And then he even proceeded to not mock Charlie Kirk, but instead our petulant, Pringles-is-a-food-group President.
Which everyone knew you weren't allowed to do if Charlie Kirk ever died.
So The Right melted down over a throwaway joke by Kimmel, and Disney--terrified of offending the gangrenous teletubby-in-chief--caved to the sociopath. When comedy is outlawed, folks, only Jesse Watters will have jokes left.
And I think we all know that's not a world worth living in.
On a slightly more serious note, I laid out why this matters. Because, ABC's biggest station owner, Nexstar, is just Sinclair with better dental.
These conglomerates with their conflicts of interest, inside their conflicts of interest, surrounded by their conflicts of interest, are why we should smash every f*king monopoly into 1000 pieces.
They aren't neutral referees; they're Glenn Youngkin. Trumpism in casual business attire, with more intelligent lies.
And Nextsar, the biggest owner of local stations in the country, who first said they wouldn't air Kimmel's show--arguably causing all of ABC to follow suit,--thinks they can walk between the rain drops without anyone noticing them.
Well I fucking noticed.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.YqF5xgYf2oeePYuZf5m_nmeMYHdKRye_iyJdrysEp3U?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=173951429)
So, call their corporate officers and simply ask them why they hate the 1st Amendment and democracy? Why do they bow down to a fascist? And make sure they know you'll be cutting the cord. Don 't yell. Don't curse. Just make sure the know we know.
Remember--we are non-violent. Calls. No touching!
You'll wanna start with their offices in Irving, TX. And remember, be nice to the people who answer the phones! They didn't do anything.
See if you can get through to _**Andrew Alford, head of their broadcast division**_.
Tell him you have a big merger in mind, that oughtta get him on the phone. You can call corporate at PHONE (972) 373-8800 and ask for him! Here's what he had to say about Kimmel, just for reference:
> Andrew Alford, president of Nexstar's broadcasting division, said in a statement, "Mr. Kimmel's comments about the death of Mr. Kirk are offensive and insensitive at a critical time in our national political discourse, and we do not believe they reflect the spectrum of opinions, views, or values of the local communities in which we are located _[Ed Note: corporate horse shit]_.
> Continuing to give Mr. Kimmel a broadcast platform in the communities we serve is simply not in the public interest at the current time, and we have made the difficult decision to preempt his show in an effort to let cooler heads prevail as we move toward the resumption of respectful, constructive dialogue."
Remember, when these cologne-drenched paycheck-sniffers fold under MAGA bullying, it's not just cowardice--**it 's complicity**.
If you're looking for a "spine," here, it's made of wet spaghetti, with a similar texture to [whatever that purplish shit is on top of Trump's hands](https://substack.com/redirect/2d7cd0bd-7473-4255-82b2-6142914d81a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Moving on--David and I also pointed out the absurdity that Kimmel gets punished for telling the truth, while Fox personalities can literally call for genocide of the homeless (Kilmeade) or demand protesters kneel in "repentance" or be "banished from society" (Watters) without losing their gigs.
Why?
Well obviously because Fox is a joke. But, also, because comedy cuts deeper than shouting. Authoritarians can handle anger--they can't handle mockery because it points out the clowns they truly are. That's why mockery is what we do at Blue Amp.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b9a19aa6-eb12-492b-8beb-dfdfde94e43f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.YqF5xgYf2oeePYuZf5m_nmeMYHdKRye_iyJdrysEp3U?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=173951429)
When, like over the past few days, Trump's baby-blimp flies over London or protesters beam Epstein photos onto Windsor Castle, it shakes him more than a thousand angry tweets ever could.
Julie Roginsky--writer (Substack: Salty Politics), pundit, Democratic consultant--then joined our chat to underline the danger: Trump is already framing "Antifa" as terrorism, even though Antifa isn't an actual organization.
It's a label he can slap on anyone--Bob Iger, Jimmy Kimmel, us, [hell, even Eric, if he's finally had enough](https://substack.com/redirect/2739ceb5-3340-44d3-a964-02b51c4c7642?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of that numb nuts.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1e5343a8-6aaf-4b49-a48b-52721a8371d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It's an all purpose classification to sic his Justice Department on anyone he wants.
That's how fascism works.
And when Disney or Paramount or CNN bow down instead of battling, they're not protecting shareholders--they're feeding the beast. **And the beast, as Julie put it, is never satisfied.**
We also dug into how corporate consolidation and Trump intimidation has been kicking every truth-teller off the air. From Kimmel to Colbert, Acosta to Krugman, [voices keep getting pushed out of corporate media](https://substack.com/redirect/b90dafe8-33ee-4d95-afe8-cc5138e454b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), replaced with sanitized mush.
The public is beginning to get it, though. **Polls show people trust independent outlets --Substacks, YouTube shows--far more than legacy media.** Why?
Because [we don't have billionaires whispering in our earpieces](https://substack.com/redirect/fea488d4-5cb6-4065-bc6d-04d786c71841?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). We don't sit there debating whether the Earth is flat to look "balanced."
And unlike Stephanopoulos clutching that bank account balance, we'd rather keep our integrity than get chauffeured to lie on air.
Finally, we ended the show where we always do: with action. Cut the cord. Cancel Disney+ if you can. Stop feeding the monopolies.
If you've got kids who "have to" see Moana 7: The Moana-ing, we get it. There are times we have to patronize monopolies.
But every time you can go to an independent bookstore instead of Amazon, Do It; every time you can stream something independent instead of going to Paramount, Do It.
And look friends, I'm just gonna say it, Disneyworld sucks. The hotels are crazy expensive and total shite, it's as humid as the armpits of Trump's shirts, the lines are ridiculous and...you're in freakin Florida!
Who the hell wants that? [Can you say "measles](https://substack.com/redirect/790d92cd-dcc6-48af-b5fe-8599702328f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" or "[stand your ground](https://substack.com/redirect/c6d0267d-e46c-4b81-8c4c-b223186bc831?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" or "meth'd up rattler attacking a crocodile."
FFS, take them to Legoland instead--it's Danish! And Denmark actually believes in healthcare! And told Trump F U on Greenland.
Also, support independent media like Blue Amp![ Your paid subscription here goes to helping us provide 5 more grants to independent creators](https://substack.com/redirect/0477ab66-6386-4ffe-a498-e5e03b372f8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to build up our ecosystem of non-right-wing, non-corporate media.
This is where truth lives now. Corporate media may have sold its soul for a 24-karat golden toilet or whatever Tim Cook's next bri..err gift is to Trump.
But we're here to say. And like our toilets decidedly un-gold.

body:
This is an attack on our First Amendment

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2647%2E4032634%2E4EnZck)
---
First Colbert, now Kimmel. The head of the FCC just threatened to revoke ABC’s broadcast license because they didn’t like what Jimmy Kimmel said. ABC quickly folded and took Kimmel off the air. Trump is using the government to stifle free speech — and it sure looks like giant media companies who have big mergers pending are enabling his authoritarianism. **Let’s be clear: This move will have ripple effects far beyond late-night television. It sends a chilling message that if our wannabe dictator-in-chief doesn’t like what you say, you could be silenced by corporate media companies all too willing to enable him.** This is part of a broader, alarming pattern. Pro-Trump billionaires currently own lots of corporate media. Elon Musk owns X, Mark Zuckerberg owns Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp, Jeff Bezos owns the _Washington Post_ , and David Ellison owns CBS/Paramount. And now, Trump is pressuring TikTok’s U.S. operations to be sold to more pro-Trump billionaires. Meanwhile, Trump and the Republicans are undermining public media. They clawed back funding for the Corporation for Public Broadcasting, which powers essential outlets like PBS and NPR. This is part of an intentional strategy to silence critics and punish people who don’t toe the line. No matter what your politics are, this is a five-alarm fire for free speech and the First Amendment. It’s not a question about whether you agree with Jimmy Kimmel or disagree with him.
